rows.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
rows.description:
Responsibilities:


  • QA Strategy: Define and implement the overall QA strategy, incorporating both manual and automated testing practices to ensure timely and high-quality releases.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA Engineers, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Test Planning: Oversee the creation of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and schedules, aligning with product roadmaps and project requirements.
  • Testing and Automation: Lead test execution, including functional, regression, and automated testing, to ensure full coverage and product quality.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Development, and DevOps teams to ensure QA processes are integrated across the development lifecycle.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously evaluate and enhance QA processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness, with a focus on automation.
  • Defect Management: Track, report, and prioritize defects, collaborating with the development team for resolution.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Establish and track QA metrics, ensuring transparency in quality and providing actionable insights for continuous improvement.


Your ideal profile:


  • Experience: 5+ years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in a lead role, and a strong track record in both manual and automated testing.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven experience managing and mentoring QA teams.
  • Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, JUnit), and proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python).
  • Agile Experience: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Communication: Strong ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to different stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in Thai and English both written and verbal

rows.title: Engineer, Well Operations Support (Intervention or Open-Hole Electric Line Logging)
rows.description:

  • Plan and develop operational programs, procedures and schedules assuring technical and cost justification with SSHE consideration.
  • Design well intervention in accordance with requirements from Assets; and with regard of well integrity.
  • Contribute to preparation of budget and the Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) including follow-up and control of expenditures

  • Coordinate with Superintendent/Supervisor, Well Operations during preparation of operations and execution phase
  • Manage and control the operations, and establish logistical needs in collaboration with concerned personnel/parties
  • Serve as Contract Holder to initiate bidding and/or negotiating for third party services as well as prepare and manage drilling contracts in compliance with Company's Procurement Process and SSHE Contractor Management Standard
  • Assist, advice, and support concerned parties on technical/operational aspects regarding to solve the problems and avoid delays in work schedule
  • Prepare end of well reports and capture lessons learnt at the end of the campaign or after troubleshooting for operations improvement
  • Supervise, coach and mentor the junior engineers on technical and operational issues
  • Review technical analysis/justification of recommendation to ensure proper engineering design and operation execution
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable legal and company’s SSHE MS requirements in all work under responsibility


Professional Knowledge & Experience:


  • Bachelor’s Degree of Engineering in Process/Petroleum/Mechanical or education certificate with 5-10-years experience in well intervention.
  • Knowledge of open-hole electric line logging and services or cased-hole electric line, pipe recovery and severing services with explosive during drilling operations, managing the explosive licenses, basic drilling operations and activities, other well intervention, etc
  • Well Control certificate for Well Intervention or drilling operations
  • Knowledge of contractual terms and conditions, contracts management, detailed operational structure, decision making process, and company/industry standards and practices, well integrity, and plug and abandonment
  • Good command of written and spoken English
  • Offshore experience
  • Contract management skills

company.name: Anantara Hotels & Resorts
company.introduction:
Anantara. The word in Sanskrit means "without end"​ and evokes the freedom, movement and harmony that are the spirit of the Anantara experience and culture.


Since the Anantara experience was born in 2001 in Thailand, operating within one of Asia Pacific’s largest lifestyle companies Minor International, we have successfully expanded to Anantara Hotels & Resorts across Vietnam, China, Indonesia, the Maldives, the Middle East and Africa. As a result of our evolution, we attract passionate people looking to discover a meaningful, rewarding career and capitalise on our continued growth.


Our promise to our guests is that Anantara will bring story collecting travellers closer to local cultures and experiences with luxurious and heartfelt hospitality in exotic destinations.


Our promise to our team members is that we will provide a professional and grounded environment, offering growth, development and inspiring future opportunities.


A passion for genuine, heartfelt hospitality is a prerequisite for working with Anantara, as is professionalism and a drive to succeed. Demonstrating just as much character as the hotels and resorts they work in, our team members are the heart and soul of Anantara – providing expertise and grounded hospitality that has made us renowned throughout the world.

rows.title: Accounting and Finance Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities:


1. Accounting

- Preparation of financial statements in Thai Financial Reporting Standards for Publicly Accountable Entities (PAEs)

- Monthly and quarterly financial results reporting

- Verify journal entries

- Verify payment slips and payment data for internet banking

- Credit Management


2. Tax

- Tax compliance

- Corporate income tax return filing including calculation of income amount and tax amount taking into account BOI benefits

- Filing and paying other taxes such as VAT, stamp duty and withholding tax


3. Finance

- Long/Middle term and annual financial planning including Funding Plan

- Cash management

- Coordinating and negotiating with banks, manage other bank related documents

- Foreign Exchange (FX) Management, Derivatives trading management


4. Management Accounting

- Preparation of Income and expenditure budget, update of income and expenditure forecast

- Analyze the actual performance in comparison with the budget and the previous year, and report the analysis results.


5. SAP Implementation

- Definition of Business Requirements

- Developing business procedures to align with SAP

- Conducting user testing and data migration.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related fields
  • At least 10 years of experience in accounting, tax (finance)
  • Accounting experience at a BOI-acquired company
  • Team management skill
  • Knowledge of accounting standards for PAEs
  • Knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, Withholding tax, and other taxes
  • Analytical skill
  • English skill (Business level)
  • Attention to details
  • Communication & Teamwork

rows.title: Supply Chain Data Analyst AP
rows.description:
In detail, you will:


Data Collection & Analysis:

  • Collect and interpret supply chain data across Demand & Supply Planning, logistics, inventory, warehousing, and distribution.
  • Analyze data trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, cost savings, and risk reduction.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards and reports to track performance.


Supply Chain Optimization:

  • Use data to model scenarios for inventory optimization, demand & supply planning, and supply chain performance.
  • Assist in capacity planning and forecasting, using data models to recommend adjustments in supply or demand.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for supply chain disruptions and develop actionable insights to mitigate risks.


Reporting & Visualization:

  • Prepare reports and visualizations that communicate complex data insights to supply chain and cross-functional teams.
  • Present findings to stakeholders and recommend solutions based on data analysis.
  • Automate data processes and reporting using modern data tools.


Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales Ops, supply planning, logistics, production, finance, etc.) to align data-driven insights with business strategies.
  • Partner with IT to ensure data quality, system integration, and the implementation of data governance protocols.


Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify and implement data-driven solutions that increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in data analytics and supply chain management, suggesting improvements to current processes and systems.


Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science.
  • A Master’s Degree is a plus
  • Data Analysis: Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Visualization: Strong experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker to present data insights effectively.
  • Statistical Analysis: Hands-on experience with statistical modeling tools (e.g. SPSS, SAS) and machine learning libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow) to build predictive models.
  • Database Management: Experience with rational databases and data warehousing platforms such as SQL Server, Snowflake, or Google BigQuery.
  • ERP/SCM Systems: Familiarity with enterprise resourcing planning (ERP) and supply chain management (SCM) tools like SAP, Oracle SCM.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the ability to turn data into actional insights.
  • Excellent communication skills for translating technical data into clear business decisions.
  • Attention to detail, with ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel with advanced skills in pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and data analysis toolkits.
  • Experience:
  • 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with supply chain analytics tools like Llamasoft, Kinaxis RapidResponse, or Blue Yonder is highly desirable.
  • Experience in predictive analytics and machine learning is a plus.
  • Certifications (Preferred but not required):
  • APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) or Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM).
  • Certifications in Data Science or Machine Learning (e.g., Google Data Analytics, Microsoft Certified Data Analyst).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a proven ability to solve complex problems.
  • Ability to manage and analyze large datasets from various sources.
  • Experience in process automation and optimizing workflows through technology.
  • A passion for continuous learning and staying updated with the latest industry trends.

rows.description:

  • New Business Development: Identify and target potential clients across industry within Thailand. Develop and implement a strategic sales plan to drive growth and achieve sales targets for Kyndryl’s offerings, including Applications, Data and AI, Cloud Services, Core Enterprise and zCloud, and Security and Resiliency Services


  • Client Relationship Management: Establish and cultivate strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders in Thai organizations. Understand their unique needs and challenges, positioning Kyndryl’s comprehensive solutions; i.e., Cloud, Digital Workplace Services, Security & Resiliency, and Data & AI Services—as the ideal fit.


  • Proposal Development and Negotiation: Create and present tailored proposals, negotiate contracts, and successfully close deals. Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure the seamless delivery of Kyndryl’s services across various sectors in Thailand.


  • Market Research and Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments in the cybersecurity and IT landscape specific to Thailand. Provide valuable insights and feedback to the management team to refine Kyndryl’s sales strategies.


  • Collaboration: Work alongside technical and pre-sales teams to ensure a thorough understanding of client requirements and deliver customized solutions that align with Kyndryl’s offerings.


  • Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities, opportunities, and client interactions in the CRM system. Provide regular sales forecasts and reports to management to track progress.


Skills And Experience Required


  • Experience: Minimum of 10-15 years in IT sales, with a proven track record of hunting for and closing deals in the across industry in Thailand.


  • Market Knowledge: Strong understanding of the IT and cybersecurity landscape, particularly regarding Kyndryl’s services such as Cloud Services, Data and AI, and Security and Resiliency Services in Thailand.

· Able to work at site locations (domestics / International), Fit to work offshore

· Minimum 5-8 years’ experience of Technical Safety Engineer or 10 years’ experience in related engineering disciplines

· Minimum 3 years’ experience in oil and gas industry onshore or offshore

· Good understanding of oil and gas exploration and production process

· Have a comprehensive knowledge in loss prevention process, safety study and safety analysis techniques

· Good knowledge of industry codes, standards and legislation on SSHE aspect

· Good command of spoken and written English

- Tax:

  • Closely monitor tax payment records to ensure timely tax payments before due date.


- Cash Management:

  • Manage banking relationships and optimize the use of credit facilities.
  • Prepare monthly cashflow forecast, cashflow analysis and monitor Company’s cashflow position.


- Compliance & Risk Management:

  • Ensure timely submission on all relevant tax returns to Revenue Department before deadline of submission.
  • Ensure timely submission of financial statements to DBD before deadline of submission
  • Ensure meticulous organization and documentation of accounting records to comply with accounting and tax regulations. Ensure the proper storage of all physical accounting documents.
  • Assist in implementation and improvement of accounting and internal control procedures and processes.
  • Liaise with external parties including auditors, government agencies, consultants, bankers and ensure in compliance with all financial statutory and filing requirements.


- Team Leadership & Development:

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and learning within the team.
  • Set performance objectives and conduct regular performance reviews.

rows.title: Solution Architect - Compute
rows.description:
Responsibility

1. Platform and Solution Design and strategy

  • Develop and maintain the organization's IAM platform architecture and solution design (Entra is the main platform), ensuring support for current and future business needs. Define platform standards, best practices, and guidelines.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Create detailed solution designs, considering architecture principles, scalability, security, and performance.
  • Technology Evaluation
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Evaluate and recommend technologies and tools that enhance solution effectiveness.
  • Technical Leadership
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure that technical designs align with established architecture standards.
  • Integration and Compatibility
  • Ensure that platforms and solutions integrate seamlessly with existing systems and applications.
  • Verify the compatibility of proposed solutions with hardware, software, and network environments.
  • Security and Compliance
  • Incorporate security best practices into platforms and other solution designs (SSO with Entra, MFA, PIM, PAM, RBAC…).
  • Ensure compliance with data protection and regulatory requirements.
  • Documentation and Communication
  • Document technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation guidelines.
  • Communicate solution designs effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Collaborate with quality assurance teams to define testing strategies and validate solution functionality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues as they arise during implementation.
  • Technical Direction and Coordination
  • Help define the technical direction for the product/group and coordinate across product teams to ensure that every team has defined architecture patterns.
  • Requirements Transformation
  • Transforms requirements into specific solution architecture design documents.
  • Architectural Governance
  • Governs the technical design against approved architectural standards and makes final decisions on any technology changes or exceptions to architectural standards.
  • Business Alignment and Integration
  • Understanding business processes and requirements, ensuring the platform aligns with business goals, and integrating various business functions into a cohesive system.
  • Scalability, Reliability, and Adaptability
  • Ensures that the platform is scalable, reliable, and adaptable to changing business needs, while maintaining data integrity and security. They work closely with stakeholders across different departments to facilitate smooth system deployment and continuous improvement.


Qualification

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineer, IT Engineer, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in solution architecture and technology vendors preferred.


Experience

  • 5 - 7 years+ of experience in Solution Architecture, with a focus on cloud transformation/migration for Digital Transformation
  • Proven track record in designing and delivering complex platforms and solutions.
  • Expertise in Cloud platforms like Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
  • Expertise in Virtualization technologies (e.g. Nutanix or VMware)
  • Work location base at Thai Union’s corporate office – SM Tower, Bangkok.

  • Lead performance management and succession planning, identifying critical roles and high-potential employees.
  • Oversee talent movement to ensure alignment with professional development and business needs.
  • Support managers in making objective, fair talent decisions, in line with Thai Union's talent management processes.

4. HR Solutions Implementation:

  • Use organizational insights to identify challenges and opportunities, delivering solutions that address issues while fostering long-term business partnerships.

5. Internal Communication:

rows.title: Group Treasury and Liquidity Management (Assistant General Manager )
rows.description:
About the job

1. Treasury Management:

• Manage and oversee all treasury operations, including cash positioning, intercompany loans, cash pooling, and debt management.

• Ensure efficient handling of payments, foreign exchange, and other treasury-related transactions while minimizing transaction costs.

2. Risk Management:

• Identify, assess, and manage financial risks related to liquidity, currency, interest rates, and market volatility.

• Implement and oversee hedging strategies for foreign exchange, interest rate exposures and other risk mitigation measures, including hedge accounting (with accounting team and consultants) to protect the group’s financial position, ensuring cost-effective risk mitigation.

3. Capital Management:

• Assist in developing the group’s capital structure strategy, ensuring optimal allocation of debt and equity.

• Participate in raising and managing short-term and long-term financing requirements, including debt issuances, credit facilities, and bond offerings.

4. Liquidity and Cash Management:

• Develop, implement, and manage liquidity management strategies to ensure that the organization maintains adequate funding and cash reserves.

• Monitor daily cash flow, liquidity requirements, and working capital credit facility utilization across multiple group entities and ensure efficient deployment of surplus cash and working credit facilities.

5. Regulatory Compliance and Reporting:

• Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements regarding liquidity and capital management, including Basel III/IV, IFRS, other applicable regulations, as well as the internal policies and audit requirements.

• Prepare and submit financial risk reports and other required regulatory filings on a timely basis.

6. Team Leadership & Development:

• Lead and mentor the treasury team, ensuring they are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and tools necessary to manage the group’s liquidity and treasury functions effectively.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.

• Professional certification in treasury or finance (e.g., ACT, CFA, CTP) is highly desirable.

• Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in treasury, cash management, or liquidity management roles, preferably within a large, multinational organization, or commercial banks.

• Strong knowledge of capital markets, financial instruments, and liquidity risk management frameworks.

• In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements impacting treasury operations (e.g., Basel III/IV, IFRS, etc.).

• Proven experience managing cross-functional teams and large-scale treasury operations.

rows.title: Head of Finance for Ambient Operations
rows.description:
About the job

  • Manufacturing Finance Strategy: Define and execute BU's financial strategy, creating a comprehensive financial plan for all geographical markets in which the BU operates. Ensure that BU's Financial strategy is in line with TU Group's overarching profitability and revenue targets. Oversee the management and prediction of BU-specific financial risks, such as volatility in commodity prices and general market volatility
  • Manufacturing Finance Policies, Frameworks, Processes & Programs: Drive continuous improvement in effectiveness and efficiency by managing and optimizing controlling and local accounting and finance transaction process frameworks used by BU in alignment with standards set out by the Group. Spearhead initiatives to improve BU operational efficiency and oversee the implementation of advanced financial systems. Oversee end-to-end BU performance and set finance function metrics for each manufacturing process step.
  • Manufacturing Controlling: Act as a trusted advisor for business leaders, advising the BU on areas of improvement and providing decision support to functions to drive informed business growth and development. Develop a comprehensive BU plan for Controlling, including the annual plan, budget, and forecast, ensuring alignment with Group Controlling standards. Oversee and evaluate the financial performance of BU against planned targets and KPIs, re-prioritizing initiatives based on business strategy as needed.
  • Localized Accounting & Finance Support: Oversee BU local accounting and financial transactions across markets, ensuring compliance with local and international standards and regulatory requirements and adherence to accounting standards set out by the Group. Oversee the preparation of financial reports according to local BU requirements, including P&L statements in the local language, local tax documents and balance sheet reports.
  • People: Motivate, lead and challenge team members to reach / exceed function and individual targets and objectives. Improve and sustain employee engagement scores across the Finance function, maintaining scores within the top quartile. Build a longer-term view/plan around people, enabling succession plans at different levels.


Qualification

rows.title: Ambient OEM R&D Lead
rows.description:
Main purpose of the role:

  • Global Ambient OEM R&D Strategy: Define and execute global Ambient OEM R&D strategy, driving effective execution of customer development and new product development projects globally
  • Best-in-class OEM R&D: Ensure optimized product development costs, increased speed to market, high quality product specifications that meet customer needs, a robust new product improvement & development pipeline. Develop good relation, understanding and way of working with Ambient Branded BU R&D and GIC, and develop / deploy best in-class OEM R&D practices
  • Commercial Collaboration: Ensure smooth and efficient coordination between project managers and R&D teams to ensure customer requirements are being met and consumer insights are flowing from commercial teams to NPD team. Find the right balance in customer driven projects, tenders, product improvements and NPD.
  • Operational Collaboration: Facilitate seamless coordination with local R&D at plants throughout product development process, ensuring on-time and on-spec delivery of products from sample through to full production scale-up phases and successful commercialization
  • Innovation Collaboration: Work closely with Global Innovation Center (GIC) and Branded R&D team for big-win, advanced, innovations and ensure constant communication cadence between GIC, Ambient Branded R&D, and Ambient OEM New Product Development team. Find clear big wins for value engineering product/production improvement to be more competitive on existing products and tenders coming up.
  • People: Motivate, lead and challenge team members to reach / exceed BU and individual targets and objectives. Improve and sustain employee engagement scores for R&D team to be within the top quartile. Build longer term view/plan around people; prepare succession plans at different levels. Set a positive working culture within R&D team and with teams across Thai Union. Be an ambassador of one Thai Union Group thinking


Key accountabilities:

Set strategic direction

  • Define and drive execution of Ambient OEM R&D strategy (incl. targets / KPIs) and strategic priorities, ensuring effective and efficient customer development projects and strong pipeline for new product development and value engineering of existing products.
  • Oversee all ongoing BU R&D projects, intervene as-needed to manage customer development resources in exceptional cases (e.g., Discuss with customer development leads and commercial teams to manage timelines)
  • Develop and own NPD R&D product roadmap; collect inputs from NPD team lead, GIC, Ambient OEM commercial team and Ambient Branded R&D as-needed to adjust roadmap targets and timings
  • Set budget for Ambient OEM R&D Lead’s approval, targets; define budget allocation and overseeing overall R&D budget management
  • Develop clear and compelling vision on packaging, with specific relevance for OEM, improving in either sustainability or cost competitiveness

Best-in-class OEM R&D

  • Work with Category Customer Development Leads to ensure developed products meet customer briefs, including product specifications, development timelines and unit-cost requirements
  • Work with NPD leads to proactively identify and deliver new products that fulfill customer needs within cost targets, are launched ahead of competition, and in alignment with Ambient Branded BU R&D
  • Build and deploy best practices on OEM R&D (e.g., optimizing R&D process between commercial and R&D teams, designing customer brief templates to pass through information from customers to R&D teams)

Commercial collaboration

  • Ensure smooth and fast coordination between project managers and R&D teams (e.g., through process mapping, clear RAPIDs, automation, etc.)
  • Continuously improve service level to commercial team by collecting level of satisfaction and potential areas of improvement; translate into initiatives and collaborate with R&D team leads to implement initiatives
  • Ensure clear and commercially aligned vision on big ticket value engineering EPD opportunities
  • Ensure NPD team proactively gathers external market insights and collaborates with commercial teams to test new product concepts
  • Drive sharing of best practices to be adopted and insights across all R&D specialists globally

Operational Collaboration

  • Facilitate seamless coordination with plant teams throughout product development process, ensuring on-time and on-spec delivery of products from sample through to full production scale-up phases and successful commercialization
  • Collaborate with plant team leads and R&D team leads to identify any pain points in the R&D and scale-up process, and develop solutions
  • Promote Right First Time (RFT) working culture to de-bottleneck and improve efficiency/productivity, while keeping in mind of quality, cost, speed, and simplicity
  • Develop programs focusing on production cost reduction

Innovation Collaboration

  • Work closely with Global Innovation Center (GIC) and Branded R&D teams to develop NPD R&D pipeline and ensure constant communication cadence and insights sharing across innovation teams

People and leadership

  • Motivate, lead, and challenge team members to reach/ exceed business unit targets and objectives
  • Build a cohesive and collaborative Ambient OEM R&D team comprising members based in different countries; drive a positive working culture within the R&D team and with other teams across Thai Union
  • Create culture to attract, develop and retain talent as well as drive employee satisfaction within the scope, in collaboration with HR
  • Coach team on daily activities; proactively identify high potential talents in the team
  • Drive to improve career development paths & performance mgmt. to enhance team motivation and retain quality talent
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and development to enhance employee skills and competencies
  • Build longer term view/ plan around people, prepare succession plans at different levels
  • Manage people budget for the Ambient OEM R&D function, in collaboration with HR


Desired candidate profile:

  • Ability to lead and motivate Ambient OEM R&D teams, build a diverse and trust-based leadership team, and develop talent across multiple regions and time zones
  • Strong proficiency in OEM R&D in terms of process and project know-how
  • Ability to identify and analyze complex problems and develop effective solutions, and develop long-term strategic plans
  • Demonstrates strong relationship management skills, ensuring all internal stakeholder needs (e.g., R&D and plant teams) are being met across different regions and categories
  • Excellent communication skills to effectively convey commercial and technical information to team members, internal, and external stakeholders
  • Proven capabilities to develop and promote a vision across Ambient OEM categories with respect to longer term development and the future development of sustainability needs on raw material as well as packaging within the R&D team
  • Strong interpersonal skills to foster a culture of collaboration and effectively drive cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience in managing large teams in multiple time zones and who are physically distant from each other
  • Interest and experience in value engineering through production adjustments
  • Travel required.
  • Proficient in English (and French)

rows.title: Sea Freight Procurer
rows.description:
หน้าที่และความรับผิดชอบ

  • สรรหาข้อมูล และเปรียบเทียบราคา เงื่อนไขที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการขนส่งของผู้ให้บริการรายใหม่ เช่น สายเรือ หัวลาก และ Freight Forwarder พร้อมกับนำเสนอเพื่อการพิจารณาคัดเลือกผู้ให้บริการ
  • ตรวจสอบราคาค่าขนส่งสินค้าของเมืองท่าปลายทาง (Port) สำหรับการส่งออก (Export) ตามวงรอบการตรวจสอบ และตามความต้องการของ MK, Procurement และหน่วยงานอื่นๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • จัดทำข้อมูลเปรียบเทียบราคาค่าขนส่งสินค้าของแต่ละสายเรือ และ /หรือ Freight Forwarder เพื่อการขออนุมัติการใช้งาน และ / หรือจัดทำ Marketing Cost
  • ตรวจสอบความถูกต้องราคาและค่าใช้จ่ายของค่าขนส่ง สำหรับกรณีที่สายเรือ / Freight Forwarder เรียกเก็บไม่ตรงกับข้อมูลที่ได้แจ้งให้กับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง (ทั้ง Export และ Import)
  • ประสานงานกับบริษัทหัวลาก และโรงงาน เพื่อแจ้งบริษัทประกันภัยในการตรวจสอบความเสียหายของสินค้า
  • จัดทำและรวบรวมข้อมูล ความคลาดเคลื่อนในการส่งออก ประจำเดือน จาก Daily Sum Load และสรุปรายงานให้ ผู้จัดการฝ่าย/ผู้ช่วยผู้จัดการฝ่ายรับทราบ เพื่อใช้ในการปรับปรุง/ควบคุมการทำงาน
  • งานอื่นๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


คุณสมบัติ

  • วุฒิการศึกษาปริญญาตรีในสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์ทางด้าน Sea Freight หรือ Freight Forwarder อย่างน้อย 1-2 ปีขึ้นไป
  • มีความสามารถในการอ่าน-เขียน-เข้าใจภาษาอังกฤษได้
  • สามารถใช้เครื่องคอมพิวเตอร์ MS Office ได้ดี
  • มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์และประสานงานกับผู้อื่นได้ดี
  • มีทักษะในการเจรจาต่อรอง แก้ไขสถานการณ์เฉพาะหน้าได้
  • มีความละเอียดรอบคอบ และสามารถทำงานภายใต้ภาวะความกดดันได้ดี

rows.title: Admissions Counsellor (Thai Speaking)
rows.description:
What success looks like:


  • Provide overarching admissions strategies to students by creating individualized plans and executing them in collaboration with the rest of the students’ Crimson team (Educational Coordinators, Academic Tutors, Application Consultants, and ECL Mentors)
  • Maintain expert knowledge of high school curricula, extracurricular and leadership choices, summer program applications, and standardized test planning to make recommendations regarding admissions strategies

What skills and experience you’ll need:


  • Bachelor’s degree from a top 20 US university or Oxbridge (special considerations may be given to those with undergraduate admissions consulting backgrounds)
  • Strong preference for experience with US/UK admissions consulting for the undergraduate level at top universities
  • Passion for coaching young adults and appreciation of global perspectives
  • Superior planning and organisational skills; experience in project management, event coordination, and product management a plus
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Stakeholder management (collaborating with a range of internal stakeholders, students, and parents)
  • Resilience when working independently under pressure, flexible and adaptive to working in a fast-paced growing organisation
  • Experience in education, coaching, tutoring, and admissions consulting preferred

rows.title: Energy Trading and Financial Risk Management Engineer
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Model Development: Design and implement quantitative models for pricing, risk assessment, and trading strategies specific to energy markets, including derivatives and structured products.
  • Loss control : Provide loss control framework and monitoring how to prevent losses caused by economic factors or hazards. Implementing principles driving effective loss control, such as risk avoidance, loss prevention or business/product diversification.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights related to market trends, price forecasts, and risk management.
  • Simulation and Forecasting: Utilize simulation tools to perform power system simulations and conduct forecasting analyses related to energy prices and credit loss.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with traders, risk managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on trading strategies and risk management practices.
  • Client Interaction: Engage with clients to understand their needs, provide insights on market conditions, and validate models and pricing structures.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that all trading activities comply with relevant regulations and internal policies.
  • Technical Development: Write and maintain high-quality code for financial applications, primarily using programming languages such as Python and Java.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities to enhance existing financial models and systems, adapting to changing market conditions.


Qualifications

  • Education: A Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field such as Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years in a quantitative finance and risk management role, preferably within energy trading or related sectors.

  • Be the bridge between Marketing and E-Commerce.

  • Drive strategic relationships and accelerated growth, while operating within approved trade marketing parameters, and balancing trade and media investment effectiveness and efficiency in trade spending.
  • Develop promotional strategy for e-commerce channel by understanding the model as well competitive and business trends.
  • Conceptualize, design and implement launch campaign (and its subsequent results tracking) across select e-commerce portals by working closely with local commercial team to drive visibility and business.
  • Understand the market forces and benchmark with other FMCG companies and Industry (including share, new entrants and category performance) and constantly evaluate the models and adapt to current as well as future scenario.
  • Monitoring campaigns across multiple e-commerce channels to deliver GMV by analyzing performance and activities (always-on, mega and lead campaigns) alongside the E-Commerce Commercial team to understand channel e-retailers purchase behavior.
  • Work closely with commercial and supply chain team to ensure stocks sufficiency for the channel through accurate product forecasting by platform
  • Preparing business reviews and sharing best practices to ASEAN countries.
  • Follow the execution of E-Commerce Campaign Calendar with regional guidance on promo mechanics and category focus.


Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business or related fields
  • At least 3 years’ experience in trade marketing, experience in FMCG/E-Commerce
  • Good understanding of E-Commerce formula and digital landscape, eShelf Matrix, Consumer Journey, Digital Funnels and consumer journey.
  • Excellent time management – able to stay clam under pressure whilst working quickly and delivering to dynamic, challenging, and fast paced environment
  • Good communication in both in English for business conduct level
  • Data-driven comfortable with MS excel and analysis, in able to take to decisions
  • Creative thinker and problem solver – enjoys generating innovative ideas and solutions, devising new and exciting ways to engage audiences
  • Passion in E-Commerce industry with strong logical and analytical skills.

rows.title: VAS Execution Executive
rows.description:
Your Tasks

VAS Execution Executive will be responsible for the material requirement planning and VAS FG for a specific set of products and/or material group. VAS Execution Executive will manage material and suppliers to ensure material availability in order to support VAS Production to achieve the finished goods availability and service level target.

  • Review material requirement from the system and manage ordering process based on requirements and suppliers’ order lead-time
  • Coordinate with Material Team at Production Center to manage common packaging materials demand
  • Coordinate with Supply team to manage and semi-FG for VAS
  • Communicate material availability (scheduling plan) to Co-packer, escalate potential issues and propose action plans
  • Own supplier’s performance tracking and lead regular performance review with suppliers
  • Monitor aging/obsolete/left-over packaging material and VAS and propose action plans
  • Maintain Master Data and ensure Master Data accuracy and timeliness
  • Monitor and manage material inventory to ensure optimal level to meet changing business needs while not having high surplus
  • Participate in stock reconciliation and physical stock count process
  • Participate or lead process improvement/development work as assigned by team leader
  • Coordinate with Co-packer to ensure VAS FG availability and resolve issue if any
  • Connect with demand and customer response manager to understand the requirement priority and allocation
  • Ensure Service Level target deliver on VAS FG
  • Ensure VAS product available on time per launch commitment.
  • Prioritize Semi-FG deliver from WH or port to Co-packer
  • Minimize LOR to product RL and discontinue to deliver waste KPI


Your Profile

  • University degree in Supply Chain or related fields
  • 1-3 years experiences in planning
  • Knowledge of MRP and/or other planning-related field. SAP knowledge is a plus
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft excel. Advance excel is preferable.

rows.title: QSHE Supervisor (1 year contract)
rows.description:
Duties And Responsibilities

  • Be Certified Safety Professional (CSP) and Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) in workplace
  • Evaluate and coordinate with responsible functions comply with the related law on Occupational Health, Safety and Environment.
  • Give advice to employees and responsible functions to follow the regulatory requirement and guidance.
  • Conduct the hazard identification and risk assessment to minimize the risk as low as reasonably practicable (ALARP) in workplace.
  • Analyze and indicate potential hazard and high risk to provide the corrective and preventive action based on Hierarchy of control (HOC) properly.
  • Initiate SHE plans and projects as well as recommendations and advise the control measures.
  • Inspect and assess the operations to comply with the SHE plans and projects.
  • Conduct and monitor the working environment and submit the related evidence to the Government agency.
  • Investigate and analyze the root cause of incidents and illness in order to action taken.
  • Promote the SHE activities in company under Occupational Health, Safety and Environment law and regulations.
  • Initiate and coordinate the Emergency Response Plan and conduct the drill in accordance with the local regulatory requirement and other relevant standards.
  • Maintain Integrated Management System (IMS) and relevant international standards
  • Conduct the Opportunity risk, Environmental aspects and initiate the control measures.
  • Support, implement and maintain the IMS, RC, and relevant international standards.
  • Conduct the Internal and External Audit comply with IMS & relevant Internal standard requirements.
  • Drive the operational standards and certifications for continual improvement.
  • Ensure that the certificates are actively promoted to our suppliers, customers, and employees.
  • Ensures that all business activities are preceded according to the Working Instructions as specified in the Integrated Management System.
  • Arrange the QSHE knowledge for responsible functions
  • Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) to teach and train the specific courses comply with QSHE requirements.
  • Organize the orientation and mandatory courses to newcomers and contractors.
  • Organize the chemical safety handling to customers, if required.
  • Assist QSHE Manager and functional team
  • Support, coordinate and implement QSHE policies, guidelines and procedures to meet the objective and target effectively.
  • Promote, support and follow up QSHE activities and recognition program e.g., Near miss, PSAP, Safety Talk, BBS, etc.
  • Track and provide QSHE statistics report and performance to Government agency and fuctional team.
  • Review and provide the important information in case of new project launch for operational site, contractors and customers e.g. Management of Change (MOC), Contractor Safety Management, Customer requirements, etc.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor.


YOUR PROFILE

Education : Bachelor or master’s degree in Occupation Health, Safety, Environment or related field.

Experience : 3-5 Years’ experience in related field.

Others

  • Good command of written and spoken English.
  • Computer literates.
  • Occupation Health, Safety, Environment acknowledgement under the law requirements.
  • Prior experience in Quality Management System, OH&S Management System & Environmental Management System.

company.introduction:
Established in 2006, we are now having more than 5,500 service points in all provinces in Thailand. Our next-day (ND) delivery service covers 99.9% of Thai population, and 97% of the parcels are delivered at the first attempt.


Everyday, KEX Express delivers more than 1,100,000 of parcels to offices, warehouses, retail shops and households. Our key customers include international express firms, e-commerce companies, home shopping channels, banks, technology firms, telecom companies, financial institutes, schools, as well as local retail chains.


Since 2013, KEX Express started to provide over-the-counter parcel service (C2C) by opening Parcel Shops in local communities. We also operate Parcel Lockers in offices and condominiums. These service locations help thousands of individuals and SMEs in Bangkok sending parcels at ease to their families, friends, customers and business partners across the nation.


KEX Express is also Thailand’s biggest cash-on-delivery (COD) operator and in terms of overseas — Kerry Express has its presence in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Vietnam, Cambodia and Malaysia.

Draft audit reports and provide remedial recommendations for management actions

Undertake new audit techniques and tools, and update audit manuals to prevent loopholes in internal control system

1.Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Accounting, Finance & Banking, Data Science or related fields

4.Preferably with professional certificate, e.g. CIA, CPA and CRMA

5.Basel ll IRBA knowledge and data analytics experience would be an added advantage

6.Excellent analysis and communication skill

7.Good command of English

  • Brilliant communication skills
  • Sets stretch goals and holds self and others to high standards of performance.
  • Consistently acts with integrity and invests in building trust with all colleagues and clients

company.introduction:
Sustainability is our business.


As the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, ERM partners with clients to operationalize sustainability at pace and scale, deploying a unique combination of strategic transformation and technical delivery capabilities. With more than 50 years of experience, ERM’s diverse team of 8000+ experts in 40 countries and territories helps clients create innovative solutions to their sustainability challenges, unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

rows.title: Corporate Sustainability & Climate Change Partner
rows.description:
ROLE PROFILE:


  • Primary focus on client account development, sales, and delivery of the full spectrum of ERM’s consulting services to deliver strategic value to our clients. In particular, play a key role in growing ERM’s Sustainability & Climate Change business across its broad portfolio of service offerings: Climate change strategies; Net zero consultancy/ Acceleration of decarbonization; Climate change adaptation; and ESG/ Sustainability Frameworks.
  • Actively develop commercial strategies to pursue and win new business opportunities that result in significant revenue growth with target clients aligned with ERM’s global strategy.
  • Provide business value selling at the senior levels of client organizations, raising the profile of ERM’s capabilities within key client organizations, to identify and shape clients’ needs for ERM services.
  • Develop new client relationships and/ or expand existing relationships by delivering strategic consulting advice, excellent value, and quality service.
  • Contribute to leadership of major climate change & sustainability programs and projects for ERM’s clients in Thailand and South East Asia (i.e. Malaysia, Indonesia).
  • Manage capture efforts utilizing technical understanding to develop proposals, including written content, pricing, and presentations.
  • Build, grow, and manage a high-performance team, serving as a leader and mentor to consultants. Identify emerging talent and work with them to reach their full potential; ensure rising stars are nurtured, developed and given new areas of responsibility.
  • Drive innovation within the service area to stay ahead of client needs and to differentiate ERM in the market.
  • Work in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment to build ERM’s global business, as well as to lead client and technical teams.
  • Meet business financial targets, overall project budget and schedule, client satisfaction/ expectations, and internal and contract requirements.


QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Post-graduate degree in environmental engineering, climate change or related discipline.
  • Extensive experience in consulting with strong abilities to lead and convert opportunities with C-suite and key decision makers
  • Business acumen to understand business risk and challenges; and recognize corporate opportunities.
  • Demonstrable track record in delivering multi-million dollar sales results annually, including successfully winning large and strategic projects.
  • Offer recognized technical expertise and an established reputation in the local marketplace.

rows.description:
Responsibilities:


  • Supporting/leading in project management activities under direction from Partners (e.g. manage budget, identification of follow up opportunities, monitoring client satisfaction, managing risks).
  • Project coordination and client management including overseeing deliverables and facilitating meetings;
  • Delivering projects across a range of sectors, clients and countries across Southeast Asia/ Asia Pacific. Areas of project focus include:
  • Development of corporate sustainability and ESG reports, corporate sustainability and target-setting;
  • Analysis of sustainability risks, opportunities and trends for clients, as well as conducing policy/regulatory analysis;
  • Gap analysis and benchmarking of client sustainability programs and performance;
  • Supporting clients in responding to assessment questionnaires and disclosure requirement, such as DJSI CSA, CDP, TCFD.
  • Climate strategy development and related services, such as analysis of climate risks and opportunities, decarbonization strategy;
  • Portfolio Sustainability Assessment
  • Supporting management and delivery of corporate sustainability- and climate-related proposals.
  • Supporting interactions/commercial activities, developing relationship with current and potential clients.
  • Actively contributing to effective project teams through collaboration;
  • Collaborating with ERM sustainability and social technical community across the region;


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, economics, engineering, or similar discipline. (Master's is a plus.)
  • 6 - 8 years of experience, including 2 - 3 years of consulting, in climate change, corporate sustainability, business strategy, or other related fields.
  • A good grasp of any of the following is an advantage: renewable energy, decarbonization strategies / Net Zero planning, and Low Carbon Economy Transition, Sustainability Product.
  • Ability to work independently, strong organization and time-management skills.
  • Team management skills, ability to mentor junior consultants and help develop their capabilities.
  • Effective presentation and communication skills in Thai and English
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive brand plans, integrated marketing communications (IMC), and activations to achieve business goals, including sales targets and brand equity growth for the Ovaltine portfolio.

rows.title: ACSS Compliance & Risk Management
rows.description:
Key responsibilities:


  • Study and analyze laws that related to ACSS's business, including the Code of Ethics and various policies of AFS and AEONTS, and apply them to ACSS.
  • Manage various departments to assess Compliance risks and monitor, review the results of such risk assessments to ensure that there are no significant violations of laws or internal regulations.
  • Investigate employees, investigate facts and evidence, participate in framing the investigation process in each case, provide advice and be a key member of the Disciplinary Working Team.
  • Prepare Whistle Blowing reports, coordinate and provide complete information according to the form specified by AFS.
  • Provide any opinions on legal and Compliance issues regarding the Company's activities and operations.
  • Review, review and provide opinions on the Company's legal documents as assigned, such as contracts, letters, explanatory letters, power of attorney, etc.
  • Act as a mediator to coordinate with representatives of relevant parties on issues under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, as well as control and monitor the risks of various issues and propose risk mitigation guidelines.
  • Manage basic risks PDCA, plan budgets. and departmental annual plan for Risk Management and analyze the efficiency of risk management by internal audit or related departments and evaluate the efficiency
  • Monitor and control the unit to record violations.
  • Manage special projects as assigned by the department head.


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Law or other related fields.
  • Experience in legal work, compliance and risk management (Compliance & Risk Management) for at least 6 years
  • Have good communication skills, communication skills and problem solving skills.
  • Have experience in management and supervise work of Team Members.
  • Can communicate in English (Business level)

company.introduction:
Olympus is passionate about creating customer-driven solutions in the field of medical technology.


For more than 100 years, Olympus has focused on making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling by helping detect, prevent, and treat disease, furthering medical research, and ensuring public safety.


Olympus APAC, the regional subsidiary of Olympus Corporation in Tokyo, Japan, employs approximately 2,100 operations (non-manufacturing) staff across Asia Pacific. rows.title: Corporate Strategy Manager
rows.description:
Job Descriptions:

• Review and develop the organization's strategy based on a strategic planning process that considers and addresses strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and challenges, including the sustainability and special capabilities of the organization both presently and in the future, aligning with the organization's capabilities. This process involves fostering good participation throughout the organization.

• Set directions and oversee the development of the strategy implementation plan for execution across the organization and business units (Company, Subsidiaries, & Consolidated), ensuring resource adequacy. This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and tracking the outcomes and effectiveness of the execution plan, whether it's for internal or external assessment. Also, provide suggestions and recommendations for improvements.

• Formulate, guide, plan, control, and oversee risk management for various units throughout the entire organization and business units (Company, Subsidiaries, & Consolidated). Define Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to monitor operational outcomes and reduce the risk level of the organization's main objectives to an acceptable level.

• Additionally, present suggestions and solutions.Monitor, control, guide the analysis, tracking, and prediction of future business changes for each driver, to assess the risk level and predict the outcomes of the organization and business units (Company, Subsidiaries, & Consolidated), adapting swiftly to the changing business environment. This aids in refining the execution plan, ensuring that the outcomes align with the objectives.

• Define, guide, and support the development of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and annual Action Plans.

• Oversee, control, set guidelines for relevant data management and supporting activities for various departments and the organization to align with the business direction and strategy (both internal and external), as well as the requirements of executives.

• Coordinate with relevant units to track progress and drive improvements in the execution plan to meet the objectives.

• Develop and improve operations within units, including developing and advising unit personnel to be knowledgeable, capable, and efficient, aligned with the goals.


Qualifications :

• Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering and a Master's Degree in Business Administration.

• At least 10 years of corporate strategy experience focused in the energy sector. Experience in strategic planning, business transition, and adapting businesses from an experienced consulting firm.

• More than 5 years of leading or playing a core role in analyst roles, driving change, or transforming programs—owning the project process for the company—is a plus.

• Strategic analysis and new business opportunities analysis skills. Knowledge of finance, business data, organizational risk, and financial model development.

  • Organizational skills and a proactive approach.
  • Proficiency in SQL, HTML, Python, and JavaScript

rows.title: Communications Centre Supervisor
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Communication Centre Supervisor, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Actively seeking verbal feedback from customers and team members at every opportunity.
  • Agree on and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.
  • Promote Hilton Honors and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton Honors members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.
  • Positively deal with and learn from customers’ complaints and comments with follow-up and feedback to the related Communication Manager / Guest Service Manager.
  • Handle complaints promptly and efficiently, taking the necessary action and informing the Communication Manager / Guest Service Manager to follow-up where appropriate.
  • Follow-up with guests to ensure satisfaction with problem resolution (service recovery).
  • Maintain guest history records to assist with returning guests.
  • Make sure all customer requests and queries are responded to promptly and effectively while assisting on the floor during peak periods each day.
  • Be available to assist on duty in the hotels during any busy days or special events.
  • Be proactive towards customers, assisting them with any reasonable requests, and training all team members to see these things before the customers ask.
  • Handle all internal and external guest enquiries promptly with minimal delay, directing them to the correct parties with which they wish to speak to and provide information where necessary.
  • Effectively manage all hotel communications, telephone, fax, mail, in a prompt, courteous and efficient manner, ensuring that guests feel welcome when they contact the hotel.
  • Be up to date with information on facilities, attractions, places of interests, sights and activities in and around the hotel.
  • Handle and deliver all messages in a private and confidential manner, ensuring privacy for guests and ensure that the messages are received and delivered clearly, accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Provide and ensure that all team members provide on time wake-up call services for hotel guests.
  • Knowledgeable of Hilton’s departmental standards and run the Communication Centre as a MAGIC Centre according to brand standards, explaining standards to the team, assess their performance against these standards and monitor standards through regular standards review checks.
  • Familiar with operating the telephone, FCS, OnQ PM and Micros system.
  • Take on an active role in the team by being kind, cooperative, and helpful and never forgetting the person behind the guest.
  • Take on an active role in the Guest Service Centre.
  • Transfer all internal and external guest calls to the appropriate parties correctly, with minimal delay.
  • Develop action plans to address shortfalls in standards and identify shortfalls before they affect customer service, implementing and following through with improvements identified.
  • Manage all equipment and be familiar with the system and functions, resuming the role as the person in charge of the section during the absence of the Communication Manager.
  • Describe, assign and delegate duties and authorities for the operation of the department at all times.
  • Understand what’s going on in other departments and its implication for your own department.
  • Plan ahead and ensure adequate resources are available.
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping and Engineering department to ensure cleaning is followed-up, ensuring that follow-up procedures are maintained.
  • Communicate effectively with the F&B and Kitchen teams to ensure in-room dining quality and effectiveness.
  • Be completely familiar with all emergency procedures and the fire system, ensuring that all Communication Centre team members are familiar with the procedures too.
  • Ensure the shift is reviewed, and handovers and briefings are carried out.
  • Maintain in-depth technical knowledge and skills required for the job.
  • Maintain guest histories to assist with returning guests.
  • Attend and participate in regular operational and hotel meetings.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as requested by the Communication Manager.
  • Understand the goals of the hotel and the department’s role in achieving them, communicating the goals to the team.
  • Set and agree to departmental objectives for self and team, representing the needs of the team to others in the hotel and getting members of the team to work cooperatively with others.
  • Keep the team up to date about departmental, hotel and company activities through regular communication meetings and memos including special events and promotions in the restaurants and bars.
  • Take on an active role in the team, ensuring effective communication and work as a team in order to reach goals and targets.
  • Be aware of potential highs and lows in the business.
  • Create and implement sales promotions and team member incentives as per discussion with the Communication Manager.


What are we looking for?

A Communication Centre Supervisor serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the same position in a 5-star international branded hotel or comparable industry related experience.
  • Understand basic spoken English to meet business needs.
  • Maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
  • Positively impact, take personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, communicating clearly with both customers and colleagues.
  • Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.
  • Maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
  • Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational / environmental procedures in the hotel.
  • Good organization and coordination skills.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.
  • Patient and responsible to solve all problems.
  • Able to maintain excellent relations with team members.
  • Able to work under great physical and mental pressure.
  • Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton brands to guests and suppliers of the hotel.
  • Perform all duties and responsibilities in a manner that ensures your safety and that of others in your workplace.
  • Familiar with computer systems preferred.

rows.title: Supply Chain Data Analyst AP
rows.description:
In detail, you will:


Data Collection & Analysis:

  • Collect and interpret supply chain data across Demand & Supply Planning, logistics, inventory, warehousing, and distribution.
  • Analyze data trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, cost savings, and risk reduction.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards and reports to track performance.


Supply Chain Optimization:

  • Use data to model scenarios for inventory optimization, demand & supply planning, and supply chain performance.
  • Assist in capacity planning and forecasting, using data models to recommend adjustments in supply or demand.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for supply chain disruptions and develop actionable insights to mitigate risks.


Reporting & Visualization:

  • Prepare reports and visualizations that communicate complex data insights to supply chain and cross-functional teams.
  • Present findings to stakeholders and recommend solutions based on data analysis.
  • Automate data processes and reporting using modern data tools.


Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales Ops, supply planning, logistics, production, finance, etc.) to align data-driven insights with business strategies.
  • Partner with IT to ensure data quality, system integration, and the implementation of data governance protocols.
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Identify and implement data-driven solutions that increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in data analytics and supply chain management, suggesting improvements to current processes and systems.


Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science.
  • A Master’s Degree is a plus
  • Data Analysis: Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Visualization: Strong experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker to present data insights effectively.
  • Statistical Analysis: Hands-on experience with statistical modeling tools (e.g. SPSS, SAS) and machine learning libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow) to build predictive models.
  • Database Management: Experience with rational databases and data warehousing platforms such as SQL Server, Snowflake, or Google BigQuery.
  • ERP/SCM Systems: Familiarity with enterprise resourcing planning (ERP) and supply chain management (SCM) tools like SAP, Oracle SCM.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the ability to turn data into actional insights.
  • Excellent communication skills for translating technical data into clear business decisions.
  • Attention to detail, with ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel with advanced skills in pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and data analysis toolkits.
  • 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with supply chain analytics tools like Llamasoft, Kinaxis RapidResponse, or Blue Yonder is highly desirable.
  • Experience in predictive analytics and machine learning is a plus.
  • Certifications (Preferred but not required):
  • APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) or Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM).
  • Certifications in Data Science or Machine Learning (e.g., Google Data Analytics, Microsoft Certified Data Analyst).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a proven ability to solve complex problems.
  • Ability to manage and analyze large datasets from various sources.
  • Experience in process automation and optimizing workflows through technology.
  • A passion for continuous learning and staying updated with the latest industry trends.

  • Work closely with other departments, including sales, marketing, operations, to ensure alignment and synergy in delivering exceptional MICE experiences. Foster a collaborative and supportive team environment.

หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ

  • ทำการซื้อขายเงินตราต่างประเทศ (FX และ Bank Note) ระหว่างธนาคารและลูกค้านิติบุคคลรับอนุญาต / บุคคลรับอนุญาตจากธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย รวมถึง นิติบุคคลรับอนุญาตและสถาบันการเงินในต่างประเทศ
  • ติดตามข่าวสารการเคลื่อนไหวของตลาดเงิน รายงานความเคลื่อนไหว และวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลข่าวสารระหว่างวัน และแจ้งข่าวสารความเคลื่อนไหวของตลาดให้แก่ลูกค้า พร้อมทั้งดูแลวิเคราะห์ปัญหาและการนำเสนอผลิตภัณฑ์ทางการเงินที่เหมาะสมกับสถานการณ์และความต้องการของลูกค้า
  • วางแผนการตลาดเพื่อเพิ่มยอดธุรกรรมและฐานลูกค้า และทำกำไรจากการขายผลิตภัณฑ์ทางการเงินตามเป้าที่ธนาคารกำหนด โดยติดตามผลการดำเนินงาน (Business Volume และ Profit) ในแต่ละเดือนเพื่อการวางแผนและปรับเปลี่ยนกลยุทธ์ในการดำเนินธุรกิจตามเป้าหมาย
  • ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง เพื่อเสนอแนะผลิตภัณฑ์ทางการเงินที่เหมาะสมกับลูกค้า
  • ควบคุมการใช้วงเงินที่เกี่ยวข้องกับธุรกรรมที่ลูกค้ามีอยู่กับธนาคารให้อยู่ภายใต้กรอบที่ได้รับอนุมัติ


คุณสมบัติและประสบการณ์ที่จำเป็น

  • มีความรู้ด้านตลาดทุน ตลาดการเงินเป็นอย่างดี
  • มีความรู้ด้านการบริการการขาย การบริหารสภาพคล่อง และการบริหารเงิน หรือมีประสบการณ์ในงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีความรอบรู้ในธุรกิจธนาคาร และผลิตภัณฑ์
  • สามารถบริหารจัดการ วิเคราะห์ปัญหา และแก้ปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี
  • มีทักษะในการสื่อสารได้อย่างมีประสิทธิผล
  • มีทักษะในการนำเสนอ การให้คำปรึกษา และการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลทางการเงิน
  • มีความสามารถในการวิเคราะห์ความต้องการของลูกค้า และนำเสนอผลิตภัณฑ์ที่เหมาะสมกับลูกค้าได้
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้ภาษาอังกฤษ

หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ

  • กระบวนการอื่น ๆ ของธุรกิจเครือข่ายรายย่อยตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย

2. กำหนดกลยุทธ์และแผนงานในการบริหารจัดการข้อมูลของระบบงานหรือโครงการที่ได้รับมอบหมาย เพื่อสนับสนุนการทำงานของหน่วยงานต่าง ๆ

3. ออกแบบกระบวนการต่าง ๆ ในการย้ายธุรกิจไปยัง Digital Platform (Process Design for Digital Migration)

4. ให้ Solution หรือให้คำปรึกษาในการปรับปรุงกระบวนการและการพัฒนาระบบงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง ภายใต้ขอบเขต กฎเกณฑ์ กฎหมาย และ Best Practice

5. ดูแล ควบคุม และออกแบบกระบวนการ User Journey และ User Experience ให้มีความเป็นหนึ่งเดียวกันทั้งระดับ Application เดียวกัน และระดับ Channel ต่าง ๆ

6. ปฏิบัติหน้าที่อื่นใดตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย

This position is set up to be the assistant of senior facilities manager at construction & facilities division. Its scope of work is to develop, to manage, to co-ordinate and to deliver required projects. Main functions should support company in 3 areas as following: 


Main Tasks of Repair & Maintenance

  • Be of assistance for the successful execution projects as minimum deviation from plan for completion on time, true specification and within budget.

  • A good knowledge of the M&E system in the building.

  • Possessing good communication and time management skills
  • Possessing a hand on management style with good follow-up abilities.
  • An enthusiastic and positive attitude towards difficult tasks and an analytical approach to problem solving.

  • วางแผนเพื่อดูแลและบำรุงรักษาระบบ HCMS ในองค์กรที่มีสาขาทั้งในและต่างประเทศให้สามารถรองรับความต้องการทั้งด้านปฏิบัติการณ์และการเติบโตทางธุรกิจได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
  • ออกแบบโซลูชั่นการพัฒนาและปรับปรุงด้านระบบ กระบวนการทำงาน ให้สามารถรองรับความต้องการได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ และเป็นไปตามข้อกำหนด และนโยบายของบริษัท รวมถึงกฏหมายด้านข้อมูลส่วนบุคคลที่เกี่ยวข้อง (Internal Control and Compliance)
  • ประสานงานกับทีม IT และ supplier เพื่อกำหนดแนวทางด้านเทคโนโลยี และการแก้ไขปัญหาทางด้านระบบ HCMS อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

ด้านการบริหารจัดการข้อมูล และรายงาน

  • บริหารจัดการ และเสนอแนะแนวทางในการดูแลคุณภาพและความถูกต้องของข้อมูลทางด้าน HR ในระบบ
  • เสนอแนะ และทำการออกแบบรายงานเชิงวิเคราะห์ทางด้าน HR เพื่อใช้ในการบริหารจัดการ จากข้อมูลในระบบ HCMS
  • สนับสนุนและจัดเตรียมข้อมูลทางด้าน HR โดยใช้เทคโนโลยีที่เหมาะสมได้อย่างถูกต้อง และรวดเร็ว

ด้านการสนับสนุนการทำงานองค์กร

  • สนับสนุนการดำเนินงานทางด้าน HR โดยใช้ระบบ HCMS
  • สนับสนุนโครงการ Digital Transformation ต่างๆ ในองค์กร
  • ให้คำปรึกษาและสนับสนุนเจ้าหน้าที่ HR พนักงาน และผู้บริหาร ในการใช้งานระบบ HCMS
  • เสนอแนะแผนในการนำข้อมูลจากระบบ HCMS และสนับสนุนทีมงาน HR ในการนำข้อมูลเหล่านั้นไปใช้ประกอบการกำหนดกลยุทธ์ในการบริหารจัดการทรัพยากรมนุษย์ขององค์กรได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
  • แก้ไขปัญหาที่ได้รับจากผู้ใช้งาน


คุณสมบัติ:

  • มีประสบการณ์ทำงานในตำแหน่งที่เกี่ยวข้องกับ HCMS อย่างน้อย 5 ปี (ถ้ามีประสบการณ์เกี่ยวกับระบบ Oracle HCM Cloud จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ)
  • มีความรู้และเข้าใจในระบบ HCMS ในระดับองค์กร และเข้าใจกระบวนการทำงานด้าน HR
  • มีความสามารถในการบริหาร วิเคราะห์และแก้ไขปัญหาทางด้านระบบ
  • มีทักษะในการสื่อสารและประสานงานกับผู้ใช้งานในทุกระดับ
  • สามารถแก้ปัญหากรณีเร่งด่วนได้อย่างรวดเร็ว
  • มีใจบริการ เข้ากับผู้อื่นได้ง่าย
  • มีความรอบรู้ในเทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศและการพัฒนาระบบในองค์รวม

rows.title: Account Receivable & Income Auditor
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As Income Auditor, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Audit the daily revenue figures, supporting reports and vouchers as well as audit the daily General Cashier’s Report.
  • Ensure that Daily and Monthly Revenue and Settlement Reconciliation is prepared on a timely basis and all revenue is captured and reported.
  • Ensure all gifts or entertainment voucher are controlled as per the policy.
  • Review all entertainment dockets and officers’ checks, ensuring that all are authorized and signed with the appropriate level of detail.
  • Check that complimentary rooms have been appropriately authorized.
  • Audit the telephone and internet interface reports to ensure all the respective revenue has been posted.
  • Ensure the relevant Front Office and Outlet reports are printed, audited and filed in chronological order.
  • Verify transactions posted in the daily report, including but not limited to credit cards, city ledger, crew allowances, paid outs, allowances and rebates, miscellaneous charges, voiding, car park revenues, and room safe keys.
  • Prepare rebate and allowance summary and rebate journal.
  • Reconcile credit card charges between electronic credit card machine and point of sale system on a daily basis.
  • Prepare daily revenue report for the Director of Finance / Financial Controller.

rows.description:
หน้าที่และความรับผิดชอบ

ขายสินค้า ประสานงานกับลูกค้าที่มีความซับซ้อนในรายละเอียดความต้องการสินค้า โดยใช้พื้นฐานความรู้ด้านการขายและการพัฒนาสินค้าทางด้านอาหารสัตว์ ขยายฐานลูกค้าใหม่ ประสานงานโรงงานเกี่ยวกับปริมาณความต้องการขายสินค้า ติดตามการขายและการชำระเงิน เพื่อให้ได้ตามเป้าหมายยอดขายที่ได้รับ

  • ขายสินค้าตามเป้าหมายและแผนงานการขายประจำปี โดยรับความต้องการซื้อสินค้าจากลูกค้า ตรวจสอบ กฏ ระเบียบ ที่จำเป็นกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • สรรหาลูกค้าใหม่ โดยจัดทำและนำเสนอกลุ่มลูกค้าเป้าหมาย (รายใหม่) เพื่อการขยายตลาด
  • วิเคราะห์และอ่านแนวโน้มทางการตลาด โดยสำรวจตลาด จากการเข้าเยี่ยมแลกเปลี่ยนข้อมูลกับลูกค้า ค้นหาและรวบรวมข้อมูลจากแหล่งข้อมูลต่างๆ เพื่อนำมาวิเคราะห์แนวโน้มตลาดและจัดทำแผนการขยายตลาดของแต่ละโซน
  • ประสานงานกับทางโรงงาน เพื่อการพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ใหม่และ / หรือปรับปรุงกระบวนการต่างๆ ตามแผนงานการขยายตลาด
  • คำนวณราคาขาย และตรวจสอบความสามารถ ความพร้อมของการผลิตและการส่งมอบ เพื่อนำเสนอราคาและเงื่อนไขต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการขายให้กับลูกค้า
  • บริหารจัดการข้อร้องเรียนจากลูกค้า / เคลม ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องเพื่อการแก้ไขปัญหาข้อร้องเรียน รวบรวมแนวทางการแก้ไขปัญหาแจ้งให้ลูกค้ารับทราบจนเป็นที่ยอมรับ
  • งานอื่นๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


คุณสมบัติ

  • ปริญญาตรี สาขาการตลาด, บริหารธุรกิจ, วิทยาศาสตร์อาหาร หรือสาขาอื่น ๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์ในด้านการขายต่างประเทศอย่างน้อย 1-2 ปีขึ้นไป
  • มีทักษะในการสื่อสารและการเจรจาต่อรอง
  • มีทักษะในการวางแผน, วิเคราะห์และการแก้ไขปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี
  • ทักษะการใช้ Computer ธุรกิจ (Microsoft Office) ในระดับดี
  • สามารถสื่อสารภาษาอังกฤษได้ดีเยี่ยม
  • สามารถเดินทางไปต่างจังหวัดและต่างประเทศได้
  • ต้องมีใบขับขี่และรถยนต์ส่วนตัว

rows.description:
Main Objectives and Activities

  • Monitor the availability of our services, follow up on incidents/problems, and provide root cause analyses to define permanent fixes, with a view to continuous improvement.
  • Recommend, deploy, maintain security, and network solutions, such as firewalls, WAF, routers, switches, load balancers, etc.
  • Analyze application flows during incidents (TCPDUMP, WireShark)
  • Analyze and implement traditional firewall rules (Cisco CSM/FMC, Checkpoint Firewall) and “pull-request” firewall rules (Checkpoint Cloudguard, AWS, Azure);
  • Configure, support, and document network access infrastructure such as authentication, authorization, and device profiling. (NAC)
  • Implement content delivery solutions (CDN) and DDOS protection.
  • Implement network solutions for our campuses, branches, and data centers.
  • Analyze and assess the risks and vulnerabilities of various systems.
  • Ensure all the equipment complies with security standards per the enterprise architecture.
  • Analyze infrastructure change requests, assess impacts on existing applications, suggest and make appropriate changes.
  • Identify and automate the processes in place to save time or gain quality for production releases.
  • Provide management with all the information to influence the orientations and strategies related to the network and cybersecurity infrastructures.
  • Perform and maintain documentation of our environments.
  • Able to work outside normal working hours and do standby duty


Experience:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience as Network Engineer in relevant field.
  • Good experience in network technologies/concepts (Switch, Router, VPN, DNS, Load-Balancer, TCP, QoS).
  • Good experience in a Cloud environment, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.
  • Good knowledge of data encryption concepts (SSL, VPN, TLS, PKI).
  • Knowledge of programming languages to perform automation (Python and use of different APIs Cisco or other).
  • Knowledge of network tools (Wireshark, Zabbix, Extrahop, etc.).


Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
