  • Acts as the "virtual Chief Technical Officer (CTO)/Chief Digital Officer (CDO)" or "go-to" person in established, long-term relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or business decision makers (BDMs) at the CIO level, and via direct relationship advises on solutions and position Microsoft capabilities to best meet the customer's needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, on premise).
  • Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), industry, and business strategy knowledge, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Leverages a strong knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., industry-solutions executives, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
  • Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.


Technology Strategy Formulation

  • Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., block identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
  • Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation and driving technology adoption.
  • Creates mid- and long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) technical and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Updates envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Ensures industry focus and alignment with Microsoft strategies.
  • Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives and scenarios in conjunction with industry priority scenarios (IPS), Microsoft sales plays, and solution areas to develop effective Technology Architecture. Ensures that developed architecture influences cloud journey to position all Microsoft clouds and drive consumption, usage, and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).


Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration

  • Develops and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to identify and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand.
  • Lead industry and digital transformation acceleration (IDTA) with the extended account team, customer and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for industry prioritized scenarios (IPSs), sales plays, and solution areas. Increases the number of successful engagements over time, managing engagement pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience
  • OR equivalent experience.


Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
  • 6+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.

rows.title: เจ้าหน้าที่พิจารณาสินไหมสุขภาพ (Claim Assessor)
rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

  • ตรวจสอบเอกสารประกอบการเรียกร้องและพิจารณาค่าสินไหมจากลูกค้า โรงพยาลหรือหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องเพื่อให้เป็นไปตามเงื่อนไขกรมธรรม์
  • ตรวจสอบและรับรองสิทธิ์ค่ารักษาพยาบาลให้โรงพยาบาล (fax claim) 
  • ตรวจสอบประวัติการรักษาของผู้เอาประกันภัย เพื่อวิเคราะห์ประวัติการเคลมเพื่อคัดกรอง fraud claim
  • ติดต่อประสานงานกับลูกค้า หรือ ตัวแทน เพื่อแจ้งสถานะการเคลม และเอกสารใช้ในการเรียกร้องค่าสินไหมกรณีส่งไม่ครบ
  • ออกหนังสือปฏิเสธความคุ้มครองพร้อมแจ้งลูกค้าในกรณีการรักษาไม่เป็นไปตามเงื่อนไขกรมธรรม์


คุณสมบัติ

  • วุฒิการศึกษาปริญญาตรี คณะพยาบาลศาสตร์ หรือสาขาอื่นๆ
  • อายุไม่เกิน 35 ปี
  • มีประสบการณ์ตรงด้านงานพิจารณาสินไหมสุขภาพ (Claim Assessor) อย่างน้อย 1 ปี
  • มีความละเอียดรอบคอบ รับผิดชอบต่อหน้าที่ที่ได้รับมอบหมาย
  • มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่ดี สามารถสื่อสารได้ชัดเจน ตรงประเด็น รับแรงกดดันได้ดี
  • มีทักษะด้านการใช้คอมพิวเตอร์ และสามารถใช้โปรแกรม MS Office ได้เป็นอย่างดี
  • หากมีประสบการณ์ด้านธุรกิจประกันภัยหรือความรู้ด้านพยาบาลจะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

rows.title: Business Data Analyst
rows.description:
Job Description

  • Data Cleaning and Preparation - Need to retrieve data from one or more sources and prepare the data so it is ready for numerical and categorical analysis. Data cleaning also involves handling missing and inconsistent data that may affect your analysis. 
  • Data Analysis and Exploration - Take a business question or need and turn it into a data question. Then, transform and analyze data to extract an answer to that question. Moreover, find interesting trends or relationships in the data that could bring value to a business. 
  • Creating Data Visualizations and Communication - Produce reports or build dashboards on your findings and communicate to business stakeholders and managements.

  • Statistical Knowledge 
  • Mathematical Ability 
  • Programming languages, such as SQL, Python 
  • Analytic tools such as Tableau, Power BI 

 

Soft Skills 

  • Domain knowledge 
  • Problem-Solving skill 
  • Communicate skill in multiple formats 
  • Interpersonal skills 
  • Teamworking skills 
  • Think out of the box 
  • Self Learning 

 

Qualification 

  • Bachelor Degrees in MIS, Business, Economic, Computer Science or related field 
  • At least 2-3 year of experience with Data Analysis  
  • Age between 26 – 35 years

Analyze a large variety of data sets using cutting-edge security technologies to find patterns that will help to defend from the most advanced cyber threats. Build data product, perform statistical profiling, classification, clustering and predictive analysis to extract valuable information and build predictive models to help derive new insights to defend against cyber-attacks and also identification of unauthorized access or use of the system. Identify valuable data sources and automate collection processes, research and prototype new data modeling techniques to enhance the ability to identify and respond to threats.

rows.title: HRBP Specialist
rows.description:
Job Description

Business partnering role

  • Contribute to and support the delivery of Business objectives, Act as Business Consultant & Change Agent of the contact for the employees and Line Function in the business unit.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of all HR systems and policies in line with best practices.
  • Drive and deliver HR initiatives to support business needs such as talent, performance management, talents, employee engagement, employee development and organizational change.
  • Work in partnership with the operational team to identify opportunities and areas of improvement organizational and people performance in line with business needs.
  • Guide and coach managers on employee relations and HR issues in line with company policies and best practices including disciplinary, grievance, performance.
  • Support other roles within the HR team as required with other projects and operational issues i.e. recruitment, payroll.
  • Working with Internal Communication Unit to deliver Communication Pack for Managing Change in Organization to cover risks.

Recruitment

  • Manage the entire recruitment process, from job posting to onboarding, to ensure a positive candidate experience and fast hiring.
  • Work closely with recruiting managers and other stakeholders to understand their hiring needs, identify job requirements.
  • Monitor and analyze recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, and quality of hiring, giving management with regular reports and recommending changes.


Qualification:

  • Bachelors / Master degree in human resources or business related field.
  • At least 8 years of relevant HR experience (generalist or specialist) gained in large complex organization(s) with multiple stakeholders (including matrix relationships).
  • Knowledge of current thinking in Human Resources issues and trends and evidence of Continuing Professional Development.
  • Extensive experience of operating in a business partner model, working with local managers to create positive business outcomes.
  • Communicates challenges and influences a variety of stakeholders effectively. Ability to present sound and well-reasoned arguments to convince others. Can draw from a range of strategies to persuade people in a way that results in agreement or behavior change.
  • Adapts and works effectively with a variety of situations, individuals or groups. Is able to understand and appreciate different and opposing perspectives on an issue, to adapt an approach as the requirements of a situation change, and to change or easily accept changes in one’s own organization or job requirements.
  • Can maintain personal effectiveness by managing own emotions in the face of pressure, set-backs or when dealing with provocative situations.
  • Can demonstrate an approach to work that is characterized by commitment and motivation.
  • Able to simplify complex problems, processes or projects into component parts, explore and evaluate them systematically.
  • Able to identify causal relationships, and construct frameworks, for decision making and problem-solving. Transforms proposals/ideas into practical reality.

  • รายงาน /วิเคราะห์ /จัดทำ รายงานเพื่อใช้ในการบริหารงานฝ่ายขาย
  • พัฒนาและปรับปรุงระบบ Agent Portal ให้มีความถูกต้องและทันสมัย เพื่อฝ่ายขายรับทราบข้อมูลผลงานต่างๆ ได้ทันทีในระบบ
  • จัดทำข้อมูล ให้กับฝ่ายงานต่าง ๆ ตามที่ต้องการ 
  • บริหารจัดการร่วมกันกับสายงานตัวแทนในการคัดเลือกตัวแทนทั้งภายในและภายนอกให้ได้รับการแต่งตั้งเป็นผู้บริหารฝ่ายขายรวมถึงการประเมินปรับตำแหน่งลงเมื่อผลงานไม่ได้ตามเป้าหมาย
  • รวบรวม/วิเคราะห์ข้อมูลผลงาน เอกสารต่างๆ ให้ครบถ้วนตามหลักเกณฑ์ เพื่อนำเสนอผู้บริหารพิจารณา
  • ค้นหาข้อมูลของฝ่ายขายที่จะแต่งตั้ง ให้ได้ข้อมูลมากที่สุด
  • ดำเนินการเรื่องเอกสารการปรับตำแหน่ง และ ปรับปรุงระบบข้อมูล


คุณสมบัติ

  • เพศหญิง-ชาย อายุระหว่าง 23-30 ปี 
  • จบการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรี สาขาเศรษฐศาสตร์, บริหารธุรกิจ, สถิติ และสาขาอื่นที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีความสามารถในการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลและออกแบบรายงาน
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้ Microsoft Office โดยเฉพาะ Excel และสามารถใช้สูตรคำนวณต่าง ๆ ได้
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้ Power Point เพือทำรายงานสรุป และนำเสนอต่อผู้บริหาร
  • มีความละเอียดรอบคอบและสามารถรับแรงกดดันจากการทำงานได้ดี
  • ถ้ามีประสบการณ์ในสายงานดูแลตัวแทน หรือ สายงานประกันชีวิตจะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

rows.title: ผู้จัดการงานบัญชีและรายงาน
rows.description:

  • ปิดบัญชีและจัดทำงบการเงิน รวมถึงวิเคราะห์ ตามมาตรฐานบัญชี IFRS17 ได้อย่างถูกต้องครบถ้วน และภายในกำหนดเวลา
  • จัดทำรายละเอียดประกอบสำหรับการตรวจสอบงบการเงิน ตามมาตรฐานบัญชี IFRS17 ได้อย่างถูกต้องและไม่มีข้อผิดพลาด
  • ตรวจสอบข้อมูลจาก Core System มายังระบบ IFRS17 รวมถึงผลลัพธ์ที่ออกจากระบบ IFRS17 ต้องครบถ้วน
  • จัดทำรายงานส่ง คปภ ตามมาตรฐานบัญชี IFRS17 ได้อย่างถูกต้องครบถ้วน และภายในกำหนด
  • จัดทำภาษี IFRS17 ตามหลักเกณฑ์กรมสรรพากร ภายใต้ข้อกำหนดได้อย่างถูกต้อง
  • งานอื่น ๆ ที่ได้รับมอบหมายเพิ่มเติม รวมถึงประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง ตามข้อกำหนด IFRS17


คุณสมบัติ

  • วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรี สาขาบัญชี ขึ้นไป
  • ประสบการณ์ด้านงานบัญชี GL AP AR ดูแลบริษัทในเครืออย่างน้อย 5 - 10 ปี
  • มีความสามารถในการใข้โปรแกรมสำเร็จรูปบัญชี
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้ Microsoft Office

rows.description:
ลักษณะงาน

  • ควบคุมรับผิดชอบระบบใบรับเงินชั่วคราวทั้งหมดของฝ่ายการเงินเพื่อให้เป็นตามกฎเกณฑ์ระเบียบของฝ่ายการเงินและบริษัทฯ
  • ควบคุมดูแลการเบิกใช้ใบรับเงินชั่วคราวให้ถูกต้องตามระเบียบปฎิบัติของบริษัทฯ
  • ควบคุมและบริหารจัดการ รวมทั้งแก้ไขปัญหาการทำงานภายในทีมเพื่อให้ปฎิบัติงานได้ตามเป้าหมายของฝ่ายการเงิน
  • ติดตามเบี้ยและรับชำระ


คุณสมบัติ

  • เพศหญิง-ชาย อายุระหว่าง 35-40 ปี
  • มีประสบการณ์การทำงานประกันชีวิต, งานติดตามเบี้ยและรับชำระ ไม่น้อยกว่า 5-8 ปี
  • จบการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป, สาขาบัญชี-การเงิน
  • สามารถจัดการเวลาและการทำงานที่หลากหลายได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
  • มีทักษะด้านคอมพิวเตอร์ MS-Office
  • มีวุฒิภาวะทางอารมณ์ สามารถทำงานภายใต้ภาวะงานที่มีความกดดันได้
  • เป็นผู้ร่วมทีมที่ดีและมีความยืดหยุ่นสูง มองโลกในแง่ดี
  • มีความมุ่งมั่นในการเรียนรู้และพัฒนาตนเองอยู่เสมอ

rows.title: เจ้าหน้าที่กิจกรรมการตลาดตัวแทน
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

1. จัดกิจกรรมต่างๆ และประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องในการจัดกิจกรรมเพื่อส่งเสริมการขายให้กับฝ่ายขาย เช่น การจัดกิจกรรมประชาสัมพันธ์การส่งเสริมการขาย และแข่งขันการขายสำหรับฝ่ายขาย การจัดทำ Presentation, วีดีโอ และสื่อต่างๆ ประกอบการออก Event หรือบูธตามห้าง

2. รวบรวมหาข้อมูล ทำเปรียบเทียบบริษัททัวร์ที่จะจัดกิจกรรมทัศนศึกษาให้กับฝ่ายขาย เพื่อนำเสนอผู้บริหารเพื่อพิจารณา

3. รวบรวม ติดตาม ตรวจสอบ เอกสารต่างๆ ให้กับฝ่ายขายในเดินทางไปทัศนศึกษาต่างประเทศ

4. ให้คำปรึกษา แนะนำ จัดทำ และควบคุมดูแลสื่อประกอบการขายผ่านตัวแทนเพื่อให้เป็นไปตามภาพลักษณ์ขององค์กร และนโยบายของบริษัท

5. รวบรวมข้อมูลและจัดทำรายงานผลการปฏิบัติงานของกิจกรรมส่งเสริมการขายที่จัดขึ้น เพื่อเสนอผู้บริหาร

6. จัดส่งเอกสารสื่อประชาสัมพันธ์กิจกรรมต่างๆ ให้กับฝ่ายขาย


Qualifications:

1. เพศชาย , หญิง อายุระหว่าง 22-30 ปี

2. จบปริญญาตรี สาขานิเทศศาสตร์, การตลาด หรือสาขาอื่นๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง

3. สามารถใช้ Microsoft office (Word , Excel , Power point) ได้เป็นอย่างดี

4. มีใจรักในงานบริการ , มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่ดี

5. มีทักษะในการติดต่อสื่อสารได้ดี

6. มีความคล่องตัว สามารถปฏิบัติงานนอกสถานที่ได้

rows.description:

rows.title: Procurement Strategy Specialist
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

Job Summary

Responsible for developing and driving the Procurement vision in the Business Units, and will focus on strategy, execution, and implementation. This role will facilitate the development and execution of long-term strategies that will optimize quality, cycle/response time, technology, risk, and total cost. This role will also mitigate risk, leverage technology, improve processes and systems and reduce overall cost of ownership. Key responsibilities will include strategic vision, operational planning, and execution. This role will be responsible for sourcing and procurement processes, systems and results across the Business Unit to include strategy deployment and implementation, common process definition and deployment, delivery to support the company’s business model, strategies and operating plans


Responsibilities:

• Drive and track compliance, as well as link with sourcing team for policies and procedures

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies for corporate goods and service

• Consolidate, analyze, and report on BU Procurement metrics for business reviews

• Provide BU level input to category strategies (Central Sourcing) and support implementation of aligned strategies

• Collaborate with the Enterprise processes such as Supplier Quality, Supplier Risk and Supplier Management

• Develop strong and effective working relationships with business needs into category sourcing plans, and ensure successful implementation and execution.

• Ensure supplier relationship management, and supplier performance management practices are in place and managed.

• drive financial advantages, product quality, innovation and the sustainability agenda

• Support Procurement implementation, Policy, Procedures, which ensure that Citizen attains cost of value, complies with internal and external regulations and delivers Social Value to the communities in which it operates.

• Lead and manage high value and strategic procurement projects and improvement process, Coordinate for Corporate projects align with the policy

• Develop Excel workbooks and databases to collate, manipulate and analyse spend data and information the Procurement team to make business decisions and inform the business.

• Budget control and review cycle, including tracking of budget, financial activities, and status of each project budget across fiscal years, authorizations, appropriations, and expenditures

• Develop annual program, reconcile and revise plans against actual travel expenditures, and prepare status and affordability report


Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree/Master’s Degree in Supply Chain/Logistics, Business, Statistic or related field, MBA is preferred

• 5+ years of procurement or purchasing experience

• Experience in various roles within Procurement functions

• Excellent skills: verbal, written, presentation.

• Strategic skills with ability to see issues from multiple viewpoints

• Demonstrated skills in communication and complex negotiations

• Good command of English is preferred

• Have computer skills, especially Microsoft Excel (Pivot, VLookup), Access etc.

• Have analytical skills

• Be a responsible person and Flexible working ability

rows.title: Claim Admin (พิจารณาสินไหมเคลมประกันสุขภาพ)
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

1. ดำเนินการตรวจสอบเอกสารและตรวจสอบความคุ้มครองตามเงื่อนไขกรมธรรม์ ดังนี้

1.1 ตรวจสอบผลประโยชน์ที่ลูกค้าได้ซื้อความคุ้มครองไว้

1.2 ตรวจสอบความถูกต้องและความสมบูรณ์ของเอกสารการเคลม

1.3 วิเคราะห์ เพื่อตัดสินใจจ่าย/ปฏิเสธ การเรียกร้องสินไหม พร้อมทั้งบันทึกข้อมูลลงในระบบคอมพิวเตอร์

2. ตรวจสอบความถูกต้อง และอนุมัติสินไหมตามวงเงินที่ได้รับ และทำจ่ายสินไหมตามข้อตกลง

3. จัดทำรายงานการจ่ายสินไหม และจัดส่งให้สถานพยาบาลคู่สัญญาต่างๆ

4. ติดต่อ ประสานงานกับ สถานพยาบาลคู่สัญญาต่างๆ ลูกค้า โบรกเกอร์ กรณีมีข้อสงสัย หรือข้อมูลไม่เพียงพอในการพิจารณา

5. ออกหนังสือปฏิเสธเคลม รวมถึง ออกหนังสือสอบถามข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม กรณีที่ต้องการข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมเพื่อประกอบการพิจารณาการจ่ายสินไหม

6. ให้ข้อมูลเพื่อประกอบการประเมินสถานพยาบาลคู่สัญญา

7. ตอบข้อซักถามต่างๆของสถานพยาบาล ลูกค้า หรือโปรกเกอร์ เกี่ยวกับข้อสงสัยต่างๆ , ความไม่เข้าใจในการจ่ายสินไหม หรือข้อสงสัยในรายละเอียดกรมธรรม์ เป็นต้น


Qualifications:

1. จบการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป

2. ประสบการณ์ด้านการเคลมอย่างน้อย 1 ปีขึ้น หากมีประสบการณ์ด้านธุรกิจประกันชีวิตจะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

3. มีทักษะในการคิดวิเคราะห์ การสื่อสาร การประสานงาน มีใจรักบริการ มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่ดี ขยัน อดทน สามารถอยู่ล่วงเวลา และปฏิบัติงานวันเสาร์-อาทิตย์ และวันหยุดนักขัตฤกษ์ได้

4. มีความสามารถในการใช้ภาษาอังกฤษ และโปรแกรมคอมพิวเตอร์พื้นฐาน

5. มีความสามารถในการคิดวิเคราะห์เกี่ยวกับงานประกันสุขภาพ

*** หากเคยทำงานบริษัทโบรกเกอร์มาก่อนจะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ ***

rows.title: Business Development & Partnership Management
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and Establish Partnerships: Build relationships with relevant brands that resonate with American Express cardmembers' lifestyles, crafting immersive and exciting campaigns.
  • New Business Opportunities: Establish and execute new business opportunities with other premium brands.
  • Enhance Cardmember Engagement: Develop and execute strategies to enhance cardmember engagement, brand visibility, and portfolio growth.
  • Product Team Support: Collaborate closely with the product team to construct core value propositions with partnership-added values.
  • Acquisition Team Support: Work closely with the acquisition team to grow the cardmember base through external partnership opportunities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and creative teams to ensure partnership initiatives align with American Express’s broader business objectives. Lead external agency teams, including activation and event organizers.
  • Compelling Presentations: Create compelling pitches, proposals, and presentations to attract new strategic partners and campaign ideas.
  • Foster Brand Love: Lead activities and partnership strategies to foster cardmember love and brand consideration.
  • Industry Monitoring: Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to keep American Express at the forefront. Analyze and report on partnership and campaign results, refining strategies using data-driven insights.
  • Support Leadership: Support the Head of Partnership and Business Operations.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in business development, partnership management, and campaign marketing.
  • Strong communicator with excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Established network with premium brands is an advantage.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights for strategic decision-making.
  • Innovative and creative mindset with a track record of executing successful marketing campaigns.
  • Strong leadership skills to manage external agency teams effectively.
  • Passion for staying up-to-date with industry trends and emerging opportunities.

rows.title: Compliance Analyst
rows.description:
How will you make an impact in this role?

Play a critical role in the market compliance team to support the Market Compliance Officer - Thailand in implementing the Thailand Compliance program.

  • Maintains oversight of key regulatory changes and support the implementation of new regulations. This involves working closely with the business to design new processes in accordance with regulatory requirements.
  • Supports the implementation and maintenance of ongoing AML programs across the business, this includes performing transaction monitoring investigations, filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs), PEP/Sanction/SIP screenings and investigations.
  • Performs the review of advertisements, marketing materials and sales scripts for compliance implications.
  • Drafts compliance policies and follows through to ensure implementation of procedures and monitoring programs by relevant business units.
  • Assists with managing internal audits, regulator examinations and other related reviews.
  • Provides compliance support and advice to business concerning compliance related matters as well as laws & regulations implementation
  • Assists with drafting compliance reports
  • Performs compliance monitoring and testing according to a risk based plan. Identifies compliance gaps and work with the business to remediate the gaps.
  • Supports business initiatives and compliance programs.


Minimum Qualifications

We seek a highly motivated individual, who is keen to further develop his/her career and expertise within the compliance field.

  • The individual in this position must be a self-starter and must have the ability to multi-task.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple business units and to interact with all levels of management and staff.
  • Experience in project management, tracking tasks against milestones and handle various stakeholders.
  • Independent worker with a keen interest to learn new task.
  • At least 3-5 years Compliance experience
  • Knowledge and experience in AML Laws and Credit Card regulations is highly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Credit card business / Banking industry background is an advantage.
  • Language: English and Thai (speaking, writing, and listening)

company.name: Hilton Hotels & Resorts
company.introduction: Hilton Hotels & Resorts is a global brand of full-service hotels and resorts and the flagship brand of American multinational hospitality company Hilton.

rows.title: Floor Manager
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Floor Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Work closely with the Front Desk team to ensure correct room status at all times.
  • Maintain good communication with other departments.
  • Ensure the work at guest floor areas are according to the department’s procedures and that guest floor areas are clean and well maintained.
  • Deliver high quality service to guests.
  • Personally inspect VIP rooms.
  • Offer personalized service and assistance for regular and long stay guests.
  • Ensure guests’ needs and reasonable requests are met.
  • Seek opportunities to improve guest service consistently from guests’ comments.
  • Take appropriate action to resolve guests’ complaints promptly.
  • Ensure proper handling of lost and found items.
  • Responsible for key controls of guest floors and the master key control.
  • Supervise and control all guest floor operations, supporting and supervising the supervisors or captains in their work, and providing assistance if required.
  • Handle and record guest supplies including guest on loan items and conduct monthly inventories and related reports.
  • Manage the minibars in guestrooms, ensuring food and beverages are safe for consumption and keep revenue optimized.
  • Record and supervise the daily attendance of team members and outsourced staff.
  • Submit monthly room cleaning credit reports for guest floor team members and outsourced staff.
  • Train, motivate and evaluate team members.
  • Adhere by the hotel’s policies and procedures, Hilton code of business conduct, the hotel’s team member handbook, security and emergency policies and procedures.
  • Perform duties assigned by the Management team deemed necessary.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

A Floor Manager serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Minimum of 3 years in supervisory positions in the Housekeeping department.
  • Good written and verbal skills.
  • Possess strong training, leadership and people management skills.
  • Guest oriented and able to confidently build and exceed service standards.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and possess an attention to details.
  • Possess quality improvement skills.
  • Good knowledge of all housekeeping areas, i.e. guest floor areas.
  • Actively listen to others and build on good ideas.
  • Effectively understand and utilize resources.

company.name: Hilton Hotels & Resorts
company.introduction: Hilton Hotels & Resorts is a global brand of full-service hotels and resorts and the flagship brand of American multinational hospitality company Hilton.

rows.title: Hostess Horizon
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Outlet Hostess, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Confidently know the food and beverage menu contents and explain them in detail to guests.
  • Understand dietary requirements and offer appropriate suggestions.
  • Correctly label buffet dishes.
  • Keep buffet areas clean at all times.
  • Complete TBS checklists on product knowledge.
  • Make suggestions on the menu that might suit guests of different nationalities.
  • Familiarize with menu items of all other outlets to recommend guests to other outlets.
  • Ensure that everything is clean and tidy, ready for guests to enter the restaurant.
  • Undertake steps to ensure that the cashiers’ desk is ready and set for service.
  • Check reservations with the Supervisor / Manager and confirm any large bookings for the next service period.
  • Assist Bar Attendants and kitchen staff where required and carry out any reasonable duties requested by the Supervisor / Manager.
  • Complete the TBS checklist on preparing the restaurant for service.
  • Greet guests with smiles and offer assistance with coats, bags, etc., introducing yourself.
  • Escort guests to a table and ask if they would prefer a smoking or non-smoking table.
  • Greet all guests who walk past your outlet and offer them menus to view when appropriate.
  • Offer the newspapers to all breakfast guests and any single diners.
  • Ensure that all service procedures are carried out to the standards required.
  • Accommodate any guest request or offer appropriate alternatives.
  • Take personal responsibility for the service experience of all guests in your designated area.
  • Follow-up on any guest questions or queries immediately, and if you don’t have the answer, check with your Supervisor / Manager.
  • When passing by guest tables, check if they require service.
  • Smile and greet all guests as they enter and exit the restaurant, even if they are not designated to your section.
  • Make sure that all areas are cleaned and maintained in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Positively end the guests experience by checking on their satisfaction.
  • Assist with guests’ coats and bags as they leave, thanking all guests and wishing them a pleasant day.
  • Understand relevant OH&S legislations and their implications on the operation of the department.
  • Ensure that safe and healthy working practices are observed throughout the service.
  • Report any accidents / incidents to the Supervisor / Manager.
  • Ensure that the Food & Beverage mission is established and instilled in you and all team members.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

An Outlet Hostess serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seize opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.
  • Flexible and responds quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
  • Maintain high team focus by showing cooperation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
  • 2-4 years managerial position in a 4 / 5-star category hotel.
  • Good English skills, both written and verbal to meet business needs.
  • Strong leadership and training skills.
  • Outgoing personality and willing to work for long hours.

rows.title: Team Lead, Merchant Strategy

  • Capability to organize and integrate overarching plan into project-related
  • Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills, with the ability to identify and provide win-win solutions for stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capacity to collaborate with cross-functional teams in an efficient manner

Benefits and Wellness Programs:

  • Design, implement, and manage employee benefits programs, including health, wellness, retirement, and ancillary benefits.
  • Monitor and assess the effectiveness of wellness programs, recommending enhancements to improve employee well-being and engagement.
  • Ensure that benefits programs comply with regulatory requirements and are aligned with industry best practices.

Employee Recognition and Rewards:

  • Develop and implement recognition and reward programs that celebrate employee achievements, promote engagement, and reinforce company values.
  • Design innovative reward programs that cater to diverse employee preferences, focusing on both monetary and non-monetary rewards.
  • Collaborate with HR business partners to ensure recognition programs are aligned with performance management systems.

Total Rewards Analytics:

  • Use data analytics and reporting tools to assess the effectiveness of total rewards programs and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership based on data related to compensation, benefits utilization, employee turnover, and engagement metrics.
  • Prepare reports and dashboards on key total rewards metrics for management review.

Compliance and Risk Management:

  • Ensure total rewards programs comply with relevant federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
  • Conduct audits to maintain compliance and mitigate risks related to compensation, benefits, and rewards programs.
  • Ensure proper governance of retirement and equity plans, collaborating with legal and finance as needed.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management:

  • Work closely with senior leadership, finance, and HR business partners to align total rewards programs with broader business goals.
  • Collaborate with the talent acquisition team to ensure total rewards offerings are effectively communicated to potential hires and are a key part of the employer brand.
  • Engage with external consultants and vendors to manage compensation and benefits surveys, benchmarking studies, and benefits plan renewals.

Communication and Employee Engagement:

  • Develop and execute communication strategies to educate employees on their total rewards package, ensuring they understand and value the full scope of compensation and benefits.
  • Organize workshops, webinars, and other events to help employees navigate their benefits and reward programs.
  • Gather employee feedback on total rewards programs through surveys and focus groups, using the data to drive continuous improvement.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master’s degree or relevant certification (e.g., CCP, CBP) preferred.

  • Strong understanding of compensation analysis, salary benchmarking, and benefits administration.
  • Experience with HRIS systems, compensation tools, and data analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of labor laws and regulations affecting compensation and benefits.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong leadership and project management abilities, with experience working cross-functionally.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Compensation and Benefits Expertise
  • Analytical Skills and Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Leadership and Influence
  • Communication and Presentation Skills

rows.title: AVP - Technology, Cyber, Data and Digital Audit
rows.location: Bangkok Office B.Grimm Power Public Company Limited, 5 Krungthepkreetha Road, Bangkok 10240, Thailand
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Provide both IT Audit assurance for IT/user (e.g., IT General Control & Application Controls Review, IT Compliance Review, IT Risk, IT Governance & Security Audit, IT Audit follow regulatory, Data Analytic for Auditing, etc.)
  • Coach the team, and demonstrate leadership roles and certain skillsets to support our end-to-end processes of each assignment
  • Facilitate use of Audit or other technology-based tools/techniques to support auditing
  • Ensuring an efficient and effective IT Internal Control Framework for the company
  • Assisting in preparing “IT risk-based internal audit plans including audit scope for the company
  • Perform and control the full audit cycle including risk management and control management over operations-effectiveness, financial reliability and compliance with all applicable directives and regulations
  • Performing on-field audit operation as planned and preparing internal audit report including findings, implication and concrete recommendation in a timely manner
  • Follow up the management’s action implementation for previous audit issue
  • Prepare audit work program and audit work papers, as well as document of all audit work papers properly
  • Advise and provide consultancy about planning, improvement to related parties
  • Undertaking special projects in order to identify opportunities for increasing excellence, standardization and automation, with an eventual view of strengthening internal controls while reducing inefficiency, inaccuracy and overall workload
  • Continually improve the professional knowledge and skills as needed
  • Can perform the admin task or prepare admin work to support team/as assigned


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree or higher in IT, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Accountancy, MIS, AIS or related field
  • More than 7-8 working experience in IT Auditing, or IT risk advisory, IT consultant, auditing, accounting, internal controls, IT risk assessment, data governance, corporate governance or compliance
  • CISA, CRISC, CISSP. ISO27001, CIA or another certificate related with IA/IT audit would be advantage
  • Experience in risk-based audit, IT audit, internal financial control processes, IT/data governance frameworks, IT regulatory requirements, enterprise-wide risk management
  • Experience in basis of IT audit/IT system review/basis or advance data analytic would be advantage
  • Knowledge of Audit concept, IT regulatory requirements (e.g., SEC, PDPA, Cyber law), and IT-related controls & standards (e.g., ISO27001, COBIT, ITIL, NIST)
  • Experience in using Data Analytic & Visualization tools would be advantage
  • Good analytical skills, pro-activeness, hardworking, flexible, communication and dynamic
  • Advanced computer skills on MS Office, accounting software and databases
  • Good command of English and presentation
  • Ability to interact with executive levels of firm management
  • Ability to travel in oversea and upcountry frequently
  • Ability to work under pressure, short lead-time and less supervision
  • Experience in power plant business would be advantage
  • Open mind to learn every new experience and work area
  • Good mindset and open mind to work as a team

rows.title: งานภาษีอากร (Sr.officer - AVP)
rows.description:

  • มีมนุษย์สัมพันธ์ที่ดีและมีทักษะด้านการประสานงาน
  • มีทักษะในการวิเคราะห์ ประมวลผลข้อมูล และการนำเสนอ
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้ภาษาอังกฤษ

rows.title: Director of Food & Beverage - Melia Pattaya
rows.description:
Main Responsibilities:

  • Provide a professional, advisory, and executive support service to the General Manager to assist in meeting the strategic goals of the establishment.
  • Develop and implement Food and Beverage promotions, strategies, and special events in conjunction with the Executive Chef and the Director of Sales and Marketing.
  • Liaise with the Executive Chef on menu engineering and portion control, ensuring the highest food standard is achieved whilst selling at the correct prices.
  • Maintain all equipment within the outlets eg. Menus, linen, chinaware, glass, electrical equipment, and Point of Sale system.
  • Drive corporate or Hotel specific programs that affect guest satisfaction and profitability in the outlets.
  • Implement control procedures to minimize errors, fraud, and waste.
  • Ensure that the property is seen as being the principal innovator in the market place.
  • Handle Food and Beverage complaints in a timely and effective manner.
  • Prepare monthly outlook/forecast reports.
  • Negotiate Food and Beverage contracts within corporate guidelines.
  • Conduct development and performance reviews, identifying key personnel for further development and structured career pathing.
  • Implement and maintain training systems to ensure that associates have the necessary framework and skills to perform their job efficiently and effectively.
  • Participate in the preparation of the Strategic Business and Operating Plans.
  • Ensure compliance with legislated health and safety requirements within the workplace.
  • Comply with all Corporate and Hotel Standards and Procedures
  • Actively promote a work environment, which cares for guests and associates alike.
  • It is not the intent of this job description to cover all aspects of the position but to highlight the most important areas of responsibility.


Main requirements:

  • 3 years of progressive experience in 4-5 stars hotel.
  • Passion for leadership and teamwork
  • Eye for detail to achieve operational excellence.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Hotel Management or related field.

company.name: Siemens
company.introduction: Siemens AG (Berlin and Munich) is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to cleaner and more comfortable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, the company creates technology with purpose adding real value for customers. By combining the real and the digital worlds, Siemens empowers its customers to transform their industries and markets, helping them to transform the everyday for billions of people. Siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company Siemens Healthineers, a globally leading medical technology provider shaping the future of healthcare. In fiscal 2023, which ended on September 30, 2023, the Siemens Group generated revenue of €77.8 billion and net income of €8.5 billion. As of September 30, 2023, the company employed around 320,000 people worldwide.

rows.title: Logistics Buyer
rows.description:
You can make an impact with:


  • Commodity Sourcing & Procurement: Lead the sourcing, negotiations, and procurement of logistics services (air freight, sea freight, courier, inland transportation, etc.), developing a regional commodity strategy aligned with the global category strategy to ensure efficiency and productivity.
  • Strategic Procurement & Cost Control: Implement procurement activities to secure quality goods at competitive prices, while identifying and executing cost-reduction initiatives to improve material cost efficiency.
  • Vendor & Supplier Management: Reevaluate existing vendors, develop alternative sources, and lead supplier negotiations using bottom-up costing to establish optimal contracts, ensuring alignment with the business strategy.
  • Logistics Supplier Development: Investigate and recommend new regional logistics service providers, using sophisticated negotiation techniques to secure the best total cost contracts.
  • Contract & Performance Management: Establish and manage rate/frame contracts with vendors, monitor supplier performance, and ensure on-time delivery to meet business goals.
  • E-Sourcing & Collaboration: Utilize e-sourcing tools and collaborate with internal and external teams to pool commodities and achieve best results for the business.
  • Savings Generation & Documentation: Generate, document, and implement cost-saving initiatives, ensuring measurable results and contributing to business success


You're excited to build on your existing expertise, including:


  • Bachelor’s Degree: A degree in a relevant field is required.
  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience in procurement and logistics.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Language Proficiency: Good command of English, both written and verbal.

rows.description:

  • Target Success: Focus on key accounts for communication & networking products, driving opportunities through the sales cycle to closure.

rows.description:
Financial Operations & Key responsibilities/ tasks:


  • Lead the AP team and oversee invoice matching, verification, coding, and payment processes.
  • Ensure accurate VAT and withholding tax compliance.
  • Reconcile unallocated payments and manage balance sheet schedules.
  • Coordinate with payment teams for timely vendor payments and resolve discrepancies.
  • Steers and oversees the relevant tasks to perform the order to cash activities e.g. all commercial aspects during project realization, contract clarification (terms & conditions, legal review), SD contract processing, monitoring of order and non-conformance costs
  • Provides backlog transparency and forecast accuracy in close alignment with the Business Areas / Business Horizontals counterparts.
  • Drives revenue forecast and budget roll up in collaboration with business units
  • Responsible for end-to-end order processing (Sales order creation & confirmation, including change order, invoice and payment follow-up)
  • Accountable and drives cycle time reduction from order to the factory to invoicing
  • Safeguard that financial data are reported according to the required standards (local GAAP and IFRS)
  • Perform period-end closing e.g. accruals, provisions, and write-off
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and archiving
  • Continuous improvement on finance and business process efficiency
  • Any additional/ ad-hoc duties as required by superior or business-related
  • Drive O2C and P2P process improvements, standardization, and automation projects.
  • Identify opportunities for optimization, eliminating inefficiencies and streamlining workflows.
  • Oversee additional GBS functions (AR, GL, Treasury) and ensure compliance with internal controls and regulations.
  • Review and enhance policies to safeguard compliance and mitigate risks.
  • Leadership & Development:
  • Manage and develop the GBS team, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Lead change management efforts and support cross-functional collaboration


Qualifications And Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, or Finance.
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting/finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience in GBS transformations and automation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of AP, AR, GL, and taxation.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and Excel.
  • Fluent in Thai and English, with excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Strong computer skills, proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Good knowledge of accounting standards and business process
  • Accountability & Responsibility - capable of planning, organizing, and prioritizing work to commit and deliver high-quality work promptly
  • Teamwork mindset: the ability to work collaboratively under time constraints
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Adaptability to process transition and organizational change

rows.title: Head of Capability Development APAC MEA
rows.description:
Your Role


  • You will be expected to align with product lines, sales, and marketing on a yearly product launch plan, identify training needs, prioritize, and plan deliverables accordingly to support reaching business goals.
  • You will be also asked to prepare a detailed plan that would cover timings, target groups, topics as well as the type of training (on/ offline) and deliver it according to the aligned schedule in a professional manner.
  • You will be actively driving training digitalization by launching and rolling out E-lucid platforms as well as capitalizing on other e-learning technologies for ex. webinars for reach, scale, and retention.
  • You must be able to evaluate training's effectiveness using different tools that include but are not limited to: tracking training completion, conducting surveys, creating effective tests, and assessing learners through observable behavioral changes.
  • Following performance trends, determining learning needs, and evaluating of learning program’s ROI (return on investment) will be an important part of your job.
  • You need to be able to manage the allocated budget, work every year in the budget process to define the training budget, actions, resources needed.
  • Essential element of your daily work will be helping create training materials, presentations/ demonstrations/ e-learning content using diverse types of software (ex. PowerPoint, Easy Generator) incorporating a variety of audio-visual materials (ex. animations, videos, augmented reality) to enhance the training and reinforce learning.
  • Your creation work will be supported by centrally developed materials that will require localization of your local language and adjustments based on the current market situation and competitors. You will need to be ready to develop your materials from scratch in case no central materials are available.
  • We will expect from you high-quality materials, aligned with Electrolux brands messaging and stories, having the end consumer always in mind.
  • Trade Presentations for the various commercial launches happening at country level for A brands
  • You will be required to work closely with the markets to track all trainings delivered, the feedback/assessment scores
  • Setup of Mystery Shopping programs in key markets and benchmark the performance over time
  • Implementation of Performance Improvement Plans for low performers
  • Rewards and recognition to retain top talent
  • We want you to actively support your colleagues from other functions when it comes to product knowledge-related topics to ensure full understanding of product benefits and consistency in its communication (that could mean giving feedback to product catalogs, brochures, POS (Point of sales) materials if needed).
  • We are creating a Training Professionals Network in our Region, and we want you to be an active member of this community seeking and sharing best practices.
  • From time to time, you will be tasked to oversee the completion of a project or be given temporary additional role/s to stretch your capabilities for growth and development within Electrolux.

rows.title: Expansion Planning & PMO (SPX Express)
rows.description:
Job Description


  • Oversee physical expansion planning, ensuring organizational growth targets for 2024 and beyond are met.
  • Lead project management efforts for new facility openings, including progress tracking, process optimization, and operational improvements.
  • Manage the monthly network expansion plan, focusing on capacity utilization and cost efficiency.
  • Track and report on performance against targets, with an emphasis on operational capacity and optimization.
  • Conduct special projects such as lead time analysis, space utilization assessments, and capacity evaluations.
  • Optimize the existing network using data-driven insights to improve efficiency, speed, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Contribute to last-mile enhancement initiatives by analyzing capacity and developing strategies for operational improvements.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related fields.
  • 2-5 years of experience in business development, project management, or management consulting.

rows.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
rows.description:
An exciting aspect of this role will mean you are involved in a number of new business projects. This will see you taking the lead in ensuring our new sites have the correct people to ensure we achieve our clients’ ambitions. Your exposure to volume recruitment will bring new ideas and methods of working to ensure our projects are successfully delivered.


Being Proactive Approach

You’ll be the lead in performing searches for passive talent through sourcing, cold calling, personal networking, and social media. Your multi-faceted research will lead to the successful development of candidate market intelligence reports and talent mapping. You will actively support the wider TA team in collating and analysing key metrics and maximizing the effectiveness of the recruiting process.


A ‘can do’ attitude

This role sits within a highly dynamic part of a highly dynamic business. It’s a fast paced environment and you’ll need to be fast paced as well. You’ll need a positive mind set and a ‘can do’ attitude. We have a continuous improvement mentality across our business and we’ll be looking for you to have the same. We want somebody with an entrepreneurial mind-set and an internal drive to continuously hit goals and succeed.


Collaboration

You’ll work closely with the wider Talent Acquisition team to ensure successful delivery of talent. In addition, you will communicate regularly with business line leaders to clearly understand requirements and expectations of the diverse positions. At JLL, we foster a spirit of collaboration and your professional voice will be heard


Managing the full process

Are you an experienced recruiter? You’ll need to be. In this role, you will be fully involved in the end-to-end recruitment process managing requisitions from creation through to on-boarding. Taking control of the entire process will mean your responsibilities will include administration and documentation related to the hire process as well as HR system monitoring and management.


To apply you need to be:-

Experienced

Not a job for the feint hearted, you will need at least 4 years’ experience within talent acquisition, recruitment or executive search. You’ll understand the methodology and stages of the Talent Acquisition process especially and be comfortable working on mandates at various levels.


Task Oriented

Have you worked in a task driven role? You will need to have this type of experience to succeed in this role. Your work in a high volume, high turnover environment will have perfected your time management and organisation skills.


A problem solver

You’ll need a strategic mind-set, outstanding problem solving ability and a creative flair to produce the most detailed and highest quality research and mapping results. As an Ambassador of JLL we expect the utmost professionalism at all times, including integrity & ethics.


A team player

You’ll be a person that collaborates with others regardless of role, business unit or location. At JLL, we work together to help achieve our ambitions and that of our clients. You’ll be prepared to get involved and provide support in the wider HR team.


A great communicator

Can you get your ideas across clearly both verbally and in writing? You’ll be working with many diverse interest groups so the way you share information and your ability to persuasively convey information is highly important. Strong interpersonal skills are key to this role to establish credibility and respect with internal stakeholders and potential external talent.

Legal and Compliance

  • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.
  • Good team player.
  • Good planning, analytical, coordination and presentation skills.

  • Developing and executing a comprehensive compensation strategy that aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives. This involves setting competitive salary structures, bonus programs, and other incentives to attract, retain, and motivate employees.

ทําหน้าที่ วิเคราะห์ลูกค้าใน การจัดประเภทรายได้แล้วยื่นต่อสหกรณ์ให้คําปรึกษาลูกค้าในการพิจารณายื่นสินเชื่อ ตรวจสอบ เอกสารลูกค้า ติดตามผลพิจารณาอนุมัติสินเชื่อกับสหกรณ์และติดต่อประสานงานกับเจ้าหน้าที่ สหกรณ์และลูกค้า


Job Description

1. ตรวจสอบความถูกต้องรายละเอียดในสัญญาเงินกู้ต่าง ๆ ตามที่มีระบุไว้ในแบบฟอร์มสำหรับส่วนของเจ้าหน้าที่

2. ตรวจสอบและติดตามเอกสารการกู้เงินต่าง ๆ และหลักทรัพย์ค้ำประกัน ให้ครบถ้วน ถูกต้อง 3. นำเอกสารในการให้สินเชื่อต่าง ๆ เสนอต่อหัวหน้าฝ่ายสินเชื่อหรือผู้จัดการเพื่อดำเนินการตรวจสอบ และนำเสนอคณะกรรมการผู้มีอำนาจ

4. สืบค้นข้อมูล และรายละเอียดเกี่ยวกับสมาชิกที่กู้เงิน เพื่อแจ้งให้หัวหน้าแผนกสินเชื่อทราบ และนำเสนอผู้จัดการ

5. จัดทำสรุปข้อมูล และรายละเอียดต่าง ๆ เกี่ยวกับการขอกู้ และการให้สินเชื่อ รวมทั้ง จัดทำข้อมูลการจ่ายเงินกู้ให้แก่หัวหน้าฝ่ายสินเชื่อหรือผู้จัดการ เพื่อให้ฝ่ายการเงินดำเนินการ

6. ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง รวมทั้งกำกับดูแล และตรวจสอบให้สมาชิกใช้เงินกู้ให้เป็นไปตามวัตถุประสงค์

7. ดำเนินการประสานงานกับบริษัทประกัน สำหรับการทำประกันวินาศภัยที่จดจำนองเป็นหลักประกันกับสหกรณ์

8. ดำเนินการจดจำนอง และไถ่ถอนหลักทรัพย์ที่ใช้เป็นหลักประกันเงินกู้ รวมทั้งดำเนินการเกี่ยวกับเอกสาร และสัญญาการกู้เงินให้ครบถ้วน

9. สามารถให้คำปรึกษาแก่สมาชิกผู้มาขอกู้ในเรื่องสินเชื่อ หรือสินเชื่อของสถาบันการเงินอื่นแก่สมาชิกที่มาขอคำปรึกษา

rows.title: Learning Design and Development Specialist
rows.description:
Job Summary

• Training need analysis, interpret learning objective

• Learning content & solution’s framework design

• Implement talent development & succession planning


Job Description

  • Responsible for leading in designing for learning content & solution’s framework and implementation steps to ensure the alignment of learning and development solutions to meet business needs/ requirements.
  • Leading the implementation of talent development & succession planning, leadership development planning and annual organizational development readiness plan.
  • Works collaboratively with the organization leadership team and HR team to develop a healthy leadership pipeline for the organization
  • Acts in support of the generation leadership development programs by presenting, facilitating, and/or developing content or support materials for talents & successor development programs
  • Actively engages, educates leaders and HR in the team effectiveness process including assessments, design and developing leadership off-sites, team make-up and observations/feedback on team effectiveness competencies.
  • Work closely with business unit and HRBP to designs and develop our digital learning platform and learning courses along with transforming our people’s learning behaviors to be self-directed life-long learner that integrates digital and non-digital solutions such as e-learning, knowledge management/ platform
  • Develop assessments to support and analyze learning effectiveness and gather feedback on learning content and revise improve the effectiveness
  • Responsible in writing learning & development program proposal to pitch the customers.


Qualification:

  • Bachelors / master’s degree in human resources or business-related field.
  • 8+ years’ experience in an HR (or related) role responsible for the learning contents & solution design and talent & succession development, blended learning environments.
  • Strong pipeline tracking and management abilities.
  • Excellent analytical, interpersonal, problem-solving skills and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal Thai & English communication skills.

rows.title: Data Governance and Data Analytics Audit Specialist
rows.description:
Job Summary

A Data Governance and Data Analytics Internal Auditor is responsible for evaluating and improving the effectiveness of an organization’s data governance and data analytics processes. This role involves ensuring data integrity, compliance with regulations, and the optimization of data usage across the organization.


Job Description

  • Develop and implement data governance policies and procedures.
  • Conduct data quality audits and assessments.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to establish data standards and resolve data-related issues.
  • Analyze data to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and metrics for data quality.
  • Support data-driven decision-making processes.
  • Plan and execute internal audits focused on data governance and data analytics.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of data management and governance frameworks.
  • Identify risks and provide recommendations for mitigating them.
  • Prepare audit reports and present findings to senior management.

rows.title: Head of Operations
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage all operational functions, including custodian services, settlement processes, operations support, account opening, and customer services, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals.
  • Collaborate with the CEO and executive team to develop and execute business strategies that support the company’s long-term growth and sustainability.
  • Ensure the firm’s operations comply with all regulatory requirements and industry standards, particularly those established by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of Thailand.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service delivery across all operational areas.
  • Oversee the integration of technology solutions to enhance trading capabilities, improve customer experience, and streamline operational functions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing operations team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support the customer service teams in delivering exceptional customer experiences and maintaining strong customer relationships.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in the securities business, with at least 5 years in a senior operational management role.
  • Strong understanding of the securities market, trading processes, and regulatory environment in Thailand.
  • Proven leadership and management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Strong strategic planning and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to make high-stakes decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with process optimization and change management.
  • Familiarity with financial technology and systems.

rows.description:

  • Organize regular training sessions with ICs and seminars with clients on derivatives products to enhance their investment decision-making.

  • Collaborate with traders and research teams to deliver market insights and innovative solutions.
  • Develop and implement strategic sales initiatives to drive product adoption and revenue growth.
  • Create engaging marketing content that highlights the advantages and applications of our derivatives products.
  • Monitor market trends and regulatory changes, providing timely advice and updates to clients.
  • Prepare and deliver persuasive presentations and product demonstrations.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees or professional certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM) are a plus.
  • 2 years of experience in derivatives sales or a related field, with a focus on structured products
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing client relationships effectively.
  • Strong understanding of equity derivatives and structured products.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Highly motivated with a proactive approach to sales and client engagement.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

rows.title: APAC Marketing Manager
rows.description:

Brand Strategy & Implementation:

Product Launch & Promotions:

- Support the development of regional KOLs in collaboration with executing the global product launch plan, including value proposition, product positioning, pricing strategy, awareness & advocacy strategies, and sales enablement.

- Adapt global product launches to the APAC market according to specific needs.

- Oversee product management responsibilities, including product launch planning and execution, marketing communication content generation, documentation, and pricing activities.

Marketing Campaigns:

- Utilize market analysis, customer needs analysis, and competitive positioning to develop differentiated positioning of product solutions and services.

- Collaborate with Advertising & Promotion and Communications to develop a communications plan in support of the marketing objective.

- Manage all marketing efforts, including branding, conference planning and execution, public relations, and digital marketing.

- Provide the global marketing team with APAC market-specific messages and materials to include in the global digital marketing strategy.


Partnerships and Engagement:

- Develop and execute marketing strategies to effectively communicate key messages, product introductions, and technology updates to external KOLs and customers.

- Adapt the global marketing strategy to effectively communicate key messages, product introductions, and technology updates to external KOLs and customers.

- Leverage KOL/customer insights, global team collaborations, and industry trends to develop and execute integrated campaigns/programs.

Content Creation:

- Possess a deep understanding of product technologies, solutions, and services to effectively differentiate and position Genea Biomedx in the APAC market.

- Adapt the global marketing visual content in various formats, such as PowerPoint presentations, infographics, or supporting videos, to visually represent our narrative and engage our KOLs & customers.

- Craft compelling narratives for industry events, showcasing thought leadership in product innovation, product strategy, and services.

Budget Management:

- Manage the local marketing budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to maximize ROI, subject to the approval of the Global Marketing Director.

- Track expenditures, forecast budget needs, and report on financial performance to senior Marketing leadership.


Job Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is required.

- Experience in the IVF or related industry is highly desirable.

- 4+ years of regional marketing leadership experience is highly preferred.

- Client-facing with some travel will be required.

- Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills with the ability to use numbers, data, and visual content to tell a story, influence decision makers, and explain complex concepts clearly to a variety of audiences.

- Proficient in visual content creation using tools such as PowerPoint, Adobe, Photoshop, and infographics.

- Demonstrated strategic thinking, problem-solving, analytical critical thinking, leadership, and communication skills used effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at various levels in a matrixed environment.

- Demonstrated success in establishing, developing, and maintaining business relationships.

- Demonstrated ability to develop and execute brand and customer marketing strategies to include innovative approaches and digital engagement.

- Experience developing and executing digital marketing media, paid media, social media, and press release strategies.

- Strong knowledge of marketing principles and utilizing market research insights to effectively translate market trends and customer needs into actionable resources and tactics.

- Creativity, innovation, high standards, and attention to detail.

- Strong self-starter mentality, with the ability to proactively generate ideas and drive efforts.

rows.title: Securities Services Product Manager (ผู้จัดการผลิตภัณฑ์บริการธุรกิจหลักทรัพย์)
rows.description:
หน้าที่และความรับผิดชอบ:

  • กำหนดแผนงานผลิตภัณฑ์ในความรับผิดชอบให้เป็นไปตามเป้าหมาย
  • บริหารกำไร/ขาดทุนของผลิตภัณฑ์รับผิดชอบ
  • กำหนดแผนงานการตลาด แผนธุรกิจ สำหรับผลิตภัณฑ์ที่รับผิดชอบ
  • ให้คำแนะนำ / ปรึกษา กับ ผู้รับผิดชอบงานบริการรับฝากทรัพย์สิน ในการพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ หรือ บริการด้านบริการรับฝากทรัพย์สิน เพื่อให้ได้ Solution ที่เหมาะสมกับความต้องการของลูกค้า
  • รับผิดชอบในการบริหารช่องทาง / กระบวนการทำงานที่เกี่ยวกับบริการรับฝากทรัพย์สินเพื่อสร้างความพึงพอใจแก่ลูกค้าทั้งภายในและภายนอก
  • ร่วมกับผู้รับผิดชอบงานบริการรับฝากทรัพย์สินในการศึกษาการพัฒนาของตลาด รวมทั้งกฎระเบียบต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับธุรกิจหลักทรัพย์ เช่น ธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย สำนักงานคณะกรรมการกำกับหลักทรัพย์ตลาดหลักทรัพย์ ศูนย์รับฝากหลักทรัพย์ และทำการวิเคราะห์ ประเมินถึงผลกระทบที่เกิดกับผลิตภัณฑ์/ลูกค้า และทำการแจ้งให้ผู้บริหารงาน/ทีมงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง/ลูกค้าทราบถึงผลกระทบดังกล่าว (ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย)


คุณสมบัติ :

  • ปริญญาตรี / โท คณะวิศวกรรม,บริหารธุรกิจ,การเงิน, เศรษฐศาสตร์,การจัดการ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีความรู้เบื้องต้นเกี่ยวกับธุรกิจ ผลิตภัณฑ์และบริการต่าง ๆ ของธนาคาร
  • มีความรู้พื้นฐานเกี่ยวกับหลักทรัพย์และธุรกิจหลักทรัพย์จะเป็นประโยชน์
  • มีทักษะในการติดต่อสื่อสาร การเจรจาต่อรอง โน้มน้าวชักจูง การบริหารจัดการทีมงาน และการรักษาความสัมพันธ์กับลูกค้า
  • มีทัศนคติในเชิงบวก กระตือรือร้นในการทำงาน มีความรับผิดชอบสูง และมีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่ดี
  • มีทักษะคอมพิวเตอร์โดยเฉพาะ MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint

rows.title: Product Manager - Lending product (AEC Market)
rows.description:
Job Scope:

• Research and analyze market, competitors and understand customer needs to serve the business and product development including product features, process and pricing.

• Study and analyze the impacts of changes in the banking industry and regulatory requirements on the products to ensure that the products meet the criteria and conditions set by relevant regulatory bodies, such as central banks (BOT, SBV, etc.), and the bank’s internal policies.

• Lead an end-to-end product development, management and delivery product into the market including product design, touchpoints for sale, customer onboarding and servicing process, risk management and underwriting, in accordance with the set goals and business plan.

• Evaluate and analyze product performance, profit and loss, and policy in various perspectives and propose initiatives to improve product and process to keep up with set goals and business plan.

• Generate insightful reports on loan performance metrics, aiming to enhance credit product quality and risk management. Innovate reporting methods and systematize credit monitoring for optimal efficiency.


Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering or related field.

• Experience in banking industry or financial service, with a focus on consumer lending.

• Proven track record in Credit Portfolio Management/Credit Monitoring Management

• Self-motivated and willingness to work across different cultures and dynamics working environment.

• Possess strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Good project management skills

รายละเอียดงาน

  • สามารถคิดวิเคราะห์ วางแผนอย่างเป็นระบบ

rows.title: Trade Finance Officer/ Finance Operations
rows.description:
About the job

  • Oversee the end-to-end processing of trade finance transactions, including letters of credit, documentary collections, and trade loans.
  • Prepare, review, and verify trade finance documents to ensure accuracy and compliance with international trade standards and bank policies.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and offering guidance on trade finance products and services.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with trade finance transactions, including credit risk, operational risk, and compliance risk.
  • Work closely with internal teams, including relationship managers, credit officers, and compliance officers, to ensure seamless transaction processing.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in trade finance operations within the banking industry.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Proficiency in trade finance systems and software, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Strong understanding of international trade finance regulations and guidelines.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

rows.title: Fraud Investigation and Risk & Control Management - Senior Specialist
rows.description:
Job Responsibility :

  • Drive fraud risk strategies and policy into execution across all existing, and future, KBank products and or services.
  • Conduct deep investigation of credit/ non-credit fraud incidents covering both external and internal fraud areas as well as breach of internal policies and procedures.
  • Proactively uplift fraud investigation & monitoring end-to-end process and procedures by performing analysis on current practices & past fraud incidents, identify root causes to develop preventive solutions to fraud prevention & metrics.
  • Be able to prepare fraud investigation & monitoring report/dashboard for multi-purpose with data accuracy and transparency.
  • Collaborate with related functions to address and manage fraud case/ issues, and be able to give advisory related to fraud related matter.


Qualification :

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting,Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience in fraud monitoring & investigation of financial institutions is an advantage. Internal auditing or auditing consultation firm and operational risk management are also desirable.
  • Retail credit knowledge such as credit policy/process, credit underwriting or is a plus.
  • Work well in demanding situations with a positive resolution and be able to motivate secrecy.
  • Good computer, interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Keen analytical skills, strong communication and technical proficiency.
  • Ability to perform project management, tracking tasks against milestones and handle various stakeholders

rows.description:
Job Description:

  • Lead and participate in the internal control reviews of operations, processes, and products to ensure the health of the organization and provide reasonable assurance to the stakeholder.
  • Perform tasks to ensure the adequacy and efficiency of the internal control system.
  • Involve in planning, auditing, and evaluating the bank’s operational control and system.
  • Identify and highlight the critical process and risks inherent in the organization.
  • Prepare the findings and recommendation report to management and concerned parties for improving both financial and operation controls.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related fields
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Certified Information System Auditor (CISA) would be a plus.
  • At least 3 years of experience in financial auditing, internal auditing, risk assessment, or corporate governance
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Thai and English
  • Able to leverage data analytics tools to make the data-driven decision would be a plus.
  • Fluent in English
  • Be able to travel.

  • พัฒนาปรับปรุงเครื่องมือ แบบจำลอง หรือ Indicator ต่างๆ เพื่อสนับสนุนการวิเคราะห์ภาวะและประมาณการแนวโน้มเศรษฐกิจ
  • สร้างเครื่องมืออัตโนมัติ (Automation) เพื่อช่วยลดภาระงาน หรือปรับกระบวนการให้เหมาะสม และค้นหาโอกาสในการรวบรวมข้อมูลภายนอกเพื่อการวิเคราะห์ในเชิงรุก
  • นำส่งข้อมูลที่ถูกต้อง (SQL, PYTHON, Excel, in-house tools) และจัดทำรายงานการวิเคราะห์
  • วิเคราะห์ภาวะเศรษฐกิจของประเทศ ภาวะอุตสาหกรรม และพัฒนา Industry indicator ของแต่ละอุตสาหกรรม รวมทั้งประเมินผลกระทบจากปัจจัยทั้งในและนอกประเทศ


คุณสมบัติของพนักงาน

  • สำเร็จการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรีหรือโท สาขาวิชาด้านเทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ วิศวกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์ วิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์ เศรษฐศาสตร์ การเงินการธนาคาร หรือสาขาอื่นที่เกี่ยวข้องกับคณิตศาสตร์ การวิเคราะห์เชิงปริมาณ สถิติ
  • มีทักษะในการจัดทำและวิเคราะห์ข้อมูล (SQL, PYTHON, Excel, in-house tools)
  • มีความรู้เศรษฐศาสตร์ หรือ ความรู้เชิงอุตสาหกรรมเบื้องต้น


ทักษะที่จำเป็น

  • มีความสามารถในการจับประเด็น เรียนรู้งานใหม่ๆ โดยสามารถเชื่อมโยงกับกลยุทธ์หรือนโยบายที่เกี่ยวข้องได้
  • มีทักษะการคิดเชิงวิเคราะห์อย่างเป็นระบบ และทำงานแบบมุ่งผลสำเร็จ
  • มีความสามารถในการคิดแบบองค์รวม มีทักษะในด้านการวางแผนงาน และมีความคิดสร้างสรรค์เพื่อริเริ่มสิ่งใหม่
  • สามารถทำงานภายใต้สภาวะกดดันและเวลาอันจำกัดได้ดี
  • มีความสามารถในการสื่อสาร มนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่ดี ทำงานร่วมกับผู้อื่นได้ดี
  • สามารถปรับตัวต่อการเปลี่ยนแปลงได้รวดเร็วและทันการณ์

  • Working experience in transactional banking field
  • Strong Trade Finance product development skills and well understanding of banking products
  • Good project management and analytical skills with strong logical thinking
  • Good command in English

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills.

  • An ability to practice advanced analytical programs is required.

rows.description:
Job Description

  • Analyze market, liquidity, counterparty credit risk, and develop risk framework for new capital market products and/or businesses
  • Design and review risk management policies and procedures
  • Monitor news and capital markets, assess impact on portfolio, and report risk status to management
  • Conduct research on new regulations, market/accounting standard and practices (both globally and locally, e.g. IBOR discontinuation), new environment, including but not limited to development in digital asset and decentralized finance, analyze impact and make recommendation
  • Partake in capital market and liquidity system testing and maintaining on a user level
  • Provide assistance and advice on risk management aspects for various businesses of local and global subsidiaries in Kasikornbank Group
  • Cooperate with related parties to ensure that risk limits are properly in place
  • Assist on other special assignments as necessary


Qualifications

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in finance, engineering, economics, statistics, science or other related fields
  • Relevant experience with focus on capital-market risk management / product development / ALM / investment would be an advantage
  • Be a self-starter, analytical and critical minded, adaptive, and smart/hard/agile worker
  • Nice to have but not required: CFA/FRM/CISA or other related certificate holder, programming skill
  • Fresh graduates are welcome
