rows.title: Project Management Officer (Banking Business Project)
rows.description:
Job descriptions:

  • Design projects including set goals/target, scope, plan, methodology, tasks, risks & issues, mitigation and deliverables to ensure the success of each project.
  • Continuously evaluating projects to ensure they are meeting company standards, adhering to budgets, quality, resource capacity and deadlines.
  • Manage dependencies and proposing resolutions.
  • Identify emerging risks and develop mitigating actions.
  • Escalate risks and issues to relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide challenge / Review of Deliverables prior to submission to Management and Project Group.
  • Deal with issues and risks escalated by Project Managers, Partners and workstream leads.
  • Identify potential challenges before they materialize.
  • Prepare accurately & effective documents for entire projects: Proposal/Pitching, Memo, Deliverables, Report, etc.
  • Conduct research and analysis to collect required data and information, as well as analyze findings and prepare research reports.
  • Perform other related tasks related to project and team execution as per assigned.


Qualifications:

  • At least Bachelor’s degree with an outstanding record of academic achievement.
  • PMP designation preferred, but not required.
  • Proactive, efficient, inquisitive, solution and delivery-oriented mindset with a love of details and solving problems.
  • Ability to engage IT teams and all working team members to deliver projects and ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization.
  • Logical thinker, analytical capability in analyzing alternate scenarios, communicating and proposing solutions.

rows.title: Guest Service Agent - Executive Floor
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Executive Floor Agent, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Ensure that rooms and services provided by the hotel are correctly accounted for within guests’ statements.
  • Provide food and beverage services to executive floor guests, assisting the Executive Floor GSA in the daily check in and check out as well as the executive floor lounge operation.
  • Greet customers immediately with a friendly and sincere welcome, using a positive and clear speaking voice, listen to understand requests, respond with appropriate action and provide accurate information such on outlet hours, special VIP programs, events, etc.
  • Promptly answer telephone calls, advise other team members of special guests’ needs and pass the information accordingly.
  • Ensure that the Executive Lounge equipment and systems are functioning at all times, and that the area is maintained in a clean, tidy and organized way.
  • Receive special requests from guests and respond appropriately or forward requests to appropriate team members for decisions and actions.
  • Record guests’ complaints, conducting thorough research to develop the most effective solution and negotiate results.
  • Listen and extend assistance in order to resolve problems such as price conflicts, insufficient heating or air conditioning, quality of dishes, etc.
  • Remain calm and alert especially during emergency situations and heavy hotel activity.
  • Plan and implement detailed steps by using experienced judgment and discretion.
  • Take on an active role in the team by being kind, cooperative, and helpful and never forgetting the person behind the guest.
  • Actively take part in training where and when required, attending formal training sessions and on the job trainings to ensure standards and develop skills and abilities.
  • Contribute to the hotel and team by sharing new ideas and suggestions for improvements, being innovative and creative to provide quality service and customer care to team members and guests.
  • Take on an active role in the Executive Floor team, ensuring effective communication and working as a team in order to reach goals and targets.
  • To assist the Executive Floor Guest Service Agents where and when required.
  • Create a warm and welcoming arrival for guests, ensuring that they feel expected and immediately “at-home” when they arrive.
  • Ensure that VIP guests who are to have their amenities replenished are done so according to convenient times for the guest.
  • Ensure that rooms, hallways and back of house areas are free of dirty plates, cutlery and mess from the amenity items.
  • Handle complaints promptly and efficiently, taking necessary action, and informing the Executive Manager or Guest Service Manager to follow-up where appropriate.
  • Follow-up with all guests to ensure satisfaction with problem resolutions.
  • Ensure that VIP guests are treated personally and recognized as an individual.
  • Promote Hilton Honors and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton Honors members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.
  • Set-up meal period displays, ensuring the correct quality and quantity of food and beverage items, as well as attention to details in order to promote the hotel’s daily offerings.
  • Work with a sales attitude, offer refills and accompanying dishes where appropriate, ensuring that opportunities to up-sell food and beverages are maximized and that guests do not feel pressured into a sale.
  • Apply Hilton brand standards in each and every action, acting as a role model and example of how the standards should be carried out in a practical setting.
  • Knowledgeable of the hotel’s facilities and services as well as basic knowledge of Hilton International, MEAP and other properties in China.
  • Up to date with information on facilities, attractions, and places of interests, sights and activities in and around the hotel.
  • Effectively communicate, coordinate and cooperate with Housekeeping, F&B, Room Service and Engineering.
  • Report problems with hotel systems, hardware or facilities to the appropriate party and follow up to ensure that corrective action has been taken.
  • Collect daily requisitions of food and amenity items from Receiving and Stores, ensuring that only quality items are accepted and then prepared.
  • Manage the inventory of food stock, ensuring that items are not wasted and are handled correctly.
  • Pass on information effectively, ensuring that all necessary details are communicated to the intended person and that any pending action is completed, and guest satisfaction is confirmed.
  • Attend daily briefings, shift handovers, meetings and read the logbook on a daily basis.
  • Ensure that the Executive Floor Manager is kept aware and up to date of operational issues.
  • Ensure that the day-to-day functions of the Executive Lounge Butlers are completed, including but not limited to checklists, set-ups for meal periods, daily requisitions, buffet and breakfast services, and replenishments.
  • Handle food and beverages in a safe, hygienic and professional way, ensuring that all caution is taken when handling food and when cleaning in order to prevent sickness and contamination.
  • Adhere to local health and safety regulations.
  • Do up a monthly inventory of food and beverage items, and other service items used in the operation, ensuring that a minimum par level is available and managing requisitions on a day-to-day basis to ensure that the Executive Lounge does not run short.


What are we looking for?

An Executive Floor Service Agent serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • High School degree.
  • Experience in the same position in a 5-star international branded hotel or comparable industry related experience is preferred.
  • Good communication, organization and coordination skills.
  • Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.
  • Able to maintain excellent relations with team member.
  • Able to work under great physical and mental pressures.
  • Understand basic spoken English to meet business needs.
  • Familiar with computer systems preferred.

rows.description:
What will I be doing? ﻿

As the Director of Sales, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Responsible for the promotion and sales of all products of the hotel, including but not limited to banquets, rooms, catering, etc.
  • Lead the team to achieve sales targets and related tasks set by the hotel.

  • Make every employee in the Sales department aware of his / her responsibilities, goals and achievements, and evaluate employees twice a year.

  • Ensure that the department sends the teamwork order in a timely manner and the banquet work order is received by the relevant departments.

rows.title: Manager - Regional Category Material Handling Equipment (MHE) APAC
rows.description:
About the job


1) Category Strategy:

• Develop and implement category strategies for all regional sub-categories in alignment with organizational targets, stakeholders, and senior management, considering market trends, cost drivers, efficiency, supplier capabilities, and risk mitigation. Implement globally defined category strategies on regional level. Approve deviations from category strategies. Setup and maintain Category Cards for main and sub-categories on regional and cluster level. Take the lead for the Category Card implementation with BPO and Procurement organization and manage exceptions.


2) Supplier Relationship Management:

• Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. Drive supplier innovation and value creation.


3) Strategic Sourcing:

• Conduct and support strategic sourcing initiatives, including supplier identification, competitive bidding, fact-based negotiations, contract award and management, and full implementation of buying channel strategy. Drive cost reduction, quality improvement, and efficiency gains.


4) Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and senior management, such as Operations, Finance, Legal and Procurement (Procurement Heads, BPO Steering Manager, Procurement Excellence), to ensure alignment of Procurement strategies with business needs. Understand their requirements and provide Procurement insights and recommendations. Establish and enhance holistic, efficient, and lean order processes on regional level with stakeholders, such as call-offs, marketplaces, and catalogues, to drive operational effectiveness, and improve overall Procurement performance. Manage and resolve escalations on various levels.


5) Demand Planning:

• Propel and conduct demand planning activities together with the business to estimate and forecast future demand for goods and services, leveraging historical data, market trends, and external factors to ensure accurate predictions.


6) Risk Management:

• Identify and assess risks related to the sub-categories, such as supply chain disruptions, market volatility, or regulatory changes. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to ensure continuity of supply.


7) Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

• Track and evaluate supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs). Provide regular reports and insights to management, highlighting achievements, opportunities, and potential risks, taking various tools and data sources into consideration.


8) Continuous Improvement:

• Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements, cost savings, and efficiency gains within the sub-categories. Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging trends in Procurement.


9) Compliance:

• Ensure compliance with relevant legal and regulatory requirements, such as ethical sourcing practices, sustainability initiatives, and international trade regulations.


10) ESG:

• Drive category and suppliers in line with the ESG ambitions of the Company. Develop and establish pro-actively suppliers and solutions that support the company targets with regards to the various dimensions of ESG (Planet, People, Partners).


Experiences:

• Extensive experience in procurement with a deep understanding of the MHE/logistics industry and various MHE types.

• University degree in business, supply chain management, or a related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) in category management, strategic sourcing, Procurement, or supply chain management.

• Strong knowledge of Procurement processes, best practices, and market trends.

• Demonstrated experience in developing and executing category strategies.

• Excellent negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills.

• Extensive expertise in the required category, demonstrating in-depth knowledge and understanding of its dynamics, market trends, and supplier landscape.

• Experienced in utilizing Procurement tools such as SAP Ariba, proficient in data analysis methods including Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and a strong willingness to embrace new technologies.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to utilize data and insights for decision-making and continuous improvement.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at various levels. Capability to manage and resolve escalations.

• Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Complete data entry to monthly metric

rows.title: Client Service Administrator
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities

Key responsibility 1: Maison Ambassador

  • Upholds the ideals of the Cartier Client Experience with a clear understanding of luxury service requirements
  • Embodies the excellence of the service. Responsible for welcoming each client, offering a personal interaction.
  • Complies with the high standards of Cartier sales and service. Respecting and applying the Cartier CS rules, process & policies of the Maison.
  • Implements Customer Service action plan provided by Retail Management.


Key responsibility 2: Client Satisfaction and technical advisor

  • Understand the client request and find proper solutions to satisfy their needs.
  • Explain, in client friendly wording, technical explanations of service. Comfortable working through client objections to mandatory vs. optional services
  • Ensures regular communication with boutique watchmaker and seamless process in place
  • Strong knowledge of Cartier creations, solutions, and service policies.
  • Constantly deals with Retail and Client team in order to find solutions vs. customer issues


Key responsibility 3: RO’s / Clients & notifications management

  • Creates and attributes the notification to boutique or workshop / repair center.
  • Controls of the notification recorded by boutique staff
  • Key-in, generate cost estimate, and contact clients directly about the status of the repair (spare part shortage, repair ready for collection…)
  • Follow-up the clients files in cooperation with the boutique staff, watchmaker, or/and the jeweller. Controls files’ status and lead-times with anomaly report
  • Files, organizes and maintains all documents related to Sales, Stock, Transfers, repairs & other boutique documents.


Key responsibility 4: Stock Management

  • Stock follow-up & inventories (ROs, spare parts, leather strap, etc.)
  • Stock (daily): prepare orders and place orders for in boutique repairs, deliveries follow-up.
  • Stock management: orders, follow-up, receiving, & inventories
  • Deliveries: transfers registrations, transfers to platform, and receptions from Repair centers


Key responsibility 5: Ensure the follow-up of the main indicators linked to after-sales service

  • Ensures proper client data capturing
  • Enhances customer satisfaction by informing the clients, minimizing delay, and reducing complaints.
  • Monitor daily report and control delays (leadtime KPI)
  • Contributes to after sales turnover in reducing return unrepaired rate, discounts and gratuities.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2-3 years of Client service experience in Luxury Brand
  • Experience in watchmaking and jewellery highly appreciated
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Fluent English, third language is a plus
  • Good interpersonal skills, strong solution driver, client focused and good team-player
  • Emphasis on details and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Good Knowledge of MS Office, SAP knowledge is a plus

rows.title: Head of Communications
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITY 1: COMMUNICATION STRATEGY & BUDGET

  • Lead and elaborate the communication strategy to elevate brand equity, focusing on visibility & desirability
  • Support the Marketing & Communication Director for the Strategic plan, leading the Communication part
  • Lead implacable execution of the defined communication strategy and proactively propose optimization when needed
  • Promote the brand image at the highest standard when communicating to third parties
  • Represent the brand in local activities when necessary
  • Participate in various events organized by media and non-competing third parties in order to gain access to market insights & networks
  • Consolidate, track and follow up on the overall Communication budget
  • Assist with the consolidation, input and management of Athena


KEY RESPONSIBILITY 2: TEAM MANAGEMENT

  • Manage Communications team in Thailand: Media Manager, Events Manager, PR Manager, Content Assistant Manager
  • Display team leadership, delegate, mentor and coach the team members to make the most of their expertise, and deliver clear, straight-forward and impactful briefs & reports
  • Participate, empower reporting line Manager and/or lead the conversations/meetings with HQ when the topics are related to Media, PR, Event, Content
  • Create/consolidate/polish presentations in the highest standard
  • Communicate expectations before activations of the plans as well as post-activation results
  • Be vocal to Media, PR, Event, Content HQ and Region teams on knowledge on Thai audience and to develop more universal communication campaigns and actions having better resonance with local audience


KEY RESPONSIBILITY 3: MEDIA

  • Formulate the media strategy according to the brand strategic direction
  • Supervise the Media Manager in media planning & media plan follow-up throughout the year with the media agency
  • Manage relationship with media agency
  • Negotiate and leverage advertising power with impactful editorial, i.e. secure high levels of editorial coverage online / offline


KEY RESPONSIBILITY 4: EVENTS

  • Build event strategy & calendar taking into account worldwide planning and local strategy
  • Supervise the events manager in organizing the events with the highest standards and in line with brand guideline
  • Work on a 360 degrees approach in all events (pre/post coverage, events report, best practices, key learnings) with details reporting and action plan


KEY RESPONSIBILITY 5: PR & CELEBRITY/KOL

  • Build PR & celebrity/KOL strategy & calendar
  • Supervise PR Manager to push for pitching and regular press kit dissemination, corporate and commercial coverage, events maximum exposure (international and local activities)…
  • Manage relationship with PR agency
  • Define the influencers strategy based on brand ambitions and needs, leading to the identification of relevant influencers for Cartier locally and specific action plan
  • Maintain constant communication and relationship with celebrity/KOL, key press & chief editors


KEY RESPONSIBILITY 6: CONTENT

  • Formulate the content strategy according to the brand strategic direction
  • Supervise the content assistant manager in content planning & production throughout the year with the external agencies with the highest standards and in line with brand guideline


KEY COMPETENCIES

  • At least 12-15 years of relevant work experience in Communications & PR, including at least 5-year experience in management. Familiarity with luxury / retail segment is preferred
  • Proven track record in adopting 360˚ approach towards Communication plans (offline and online) Proven track record in multi-tasking environment, working in a matrixed organisation
  • Independent and resourceful with excellent network among related fields
  • Fluent in Thai & English
  • Proficiency in MS office and related analytical tools
  • Strategic mindset & analytical skills
  • Strong interpersonal & managerial skills
  • Digitally-savvy, creative, open-minded, enjoys innovative and new challenges
  • Hands-on, results-oriented with good problem-solving skills

rows.title: Boutique Office Executive - Cartier
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities

STOCK MANAGEMENT

  • Manage all stock transfers (reception, departure, boutique to boutique, boutique to office/warehouse etc.)
  • Controls the quality of all stock and validate the stock deliveries from warehouse
  • Label products when receiving stock deliveries or transfers
  • Manage client reservations
  • Manage consigned products (press shooting, events, to staff, presentation outside)
  • Manage boutique pick-ups and exchanges (product labels, stock movements…)
  • Ensures daily protection and correct manipulation of pieces e.g. wrap watch with film before display
  • Ensure replenishment of pieces on the sales floor
  • Regularly check stock pieces quality and preparation to have them repaired (send to Customer Service platform if necessary)
  • Organise price labelling and changes
  • Support team to manage the annual, cycle and spot stock count (preparation, document, and contact with finance)
  • Consolidate email enquiries on stock before distributing to each boutique member
  • Monitor POSM stock utilization and stock level


CRM ADMINISTRATION

  • Manage CRM gift stock (keep record, contact with CRM team in the office)
  • Help boutique manager to keep and maintain Client Database


PROVIDE BASIC I.T. SUPPORT

  • Report IT issues
  • Follow up on solving IT issues


FINANCE AND BANKING OPERATIONS SUPPORT

  • Petty cash control
  • Exchange information with Finance back-office
  • Submit cash payment reports to Management Control
  • Monitoring red-light report and inform boutique staff and finance team


DAILY BOUTIQUE OPERATIONS

  • Handle boutique supplies such as stationary, beverage and snacks stock for clients

rows.title: Distribution Supervisor
rows.description:
Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Analysing and interpreting transportation cost, OTIF Performance, data and information. Propose improvement to warehouse and distribution manager required to ensure optimized efficiency with distribution operations and overall business efficiency and targets.
  • Coordinate with Warehouse, CSD, Production to arrange and tracking urgent order. Provide suitable solution for urgent case with reasonable cost.
  • Handle with transportation damage, transportation abnormity and complaint.
  • Record and provide required data to superior, including extra transportation fee caused by urgent order or any other needs from customer. Arrange and tracking goods return. Coordinate with CSD, Sale or related parties to smooth the return process.
  • Truck utilization and optimize transportation cost.
  • Providing, training, prepare, implement standardize, work instruction, one point lesson (OPL) for Distribution and Transporters to ensure all safe and comply with HSEQ, transport regulations, safety guideline / compliance. Report any accident/incidents within the standard timeline established. Lead and/participate in any investigations of accidents/incidents and follow up on corrective/preventive actions thereafter.
  • Plan and optimize transport routes
  • Handle transportation of in- and /or outbound finished goods
  • Execute procedures and guidelines in compliance with local laws, regulations, ISO 9001, ISO14001 and ISO 45001, JOS and Jotun’s HSEQ Management system.
  • Executive the shipments from production to the end-user
  • Track orders using functional systems (e.g. barcodes and transport management system)
  • Monitor and report on transportation costs and other relevant KPIs
  • Ensure shipping documents are properly filed
  • Keep organized records of vehicles, schedules and completed orders of vehicles, schedules and completed orders


Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics Management or related fields.
  • Have working experience at least 5 years as Distribution position.
  • High detail as required to work with much paperwork as part of routine
  • Strong understanding of INCOTERMS 2010, Import/Export requirements related to Thai regulations; and supply chain lead and processes
  • Knowledge and familiar with standard warehousing documents and standards; shipping/logistics documents and procedures
  • Reasonable written, spoken and listening skill in English due to required communications with Jotun Global offices and Global customer/suppliers.
  • There must be ability to attend and participate in trainings, workshops, and meetings.
  • Basic email correspondence and forms is desired.


Personal Qualities

  • Acts on own initiative, makes things happen and accepts responsibility for the results.
  • Uses a methodical and systematic approach; plans ahead, defines clear priorities and allocates resources effectively.
  • Quickly understands and analyzes complex issues and problems; comes up with sound and rational judgments
  • Communicates in a clear, precise, and structured way; speaks with authority and conviction; presents effectively.
  • Co-operates well with others; shares knowledge, experience, and information; supports others in the pursuit of team goals.
  • Adheres to company rules and procedures; executes plans with commitment and determination; achieves high quality results.

company.name: Iron Software
company.introduction:
Iron Software produces software libraries for C# / .NET engineers working with PDFs, OCR, Excel, QR & barcodes, and data scraping.


Trusted by single developers, start-ups, and engineers at NASA, Tesla, the US State Department, and more. With over 20 million downloads on NuGet in 95+ countries, Iron Software is an international company with its headquarters in Chicago, USA and an Asia base in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

rows.title: Software Engineer
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize code deployment, configuration management, and release engineering processes.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure system stability, performance, and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, deployment, and software quality.
  • Implement security best practices throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in DevOps, cloud computing, and automation technologies.
  • Document processes, procedures, and configurations to ensure reproducibility and scalability.
  • Deliver on and set deadlines under our monthly product release cycle.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 2 - 6 years of experience as a Software Engineer/Developer or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of software development principles and technologies.
  • Can develop complex and robust software in C#, C++, Java or similar language.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of AWS and Azure cloud computing platforms.
  • Fluent knowledge of version control systems such as Git.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with Open XML, and Microsoft Excel / Word / PowerPoint format.
  • Experience with Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technologies and optimization.
  • Strong knowledge or certification in DevOps or cloud technologies (e.g, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert)
  • Very strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux distros) and deployment targets (Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, Google Cloud).
  • Experience developing and deploying NuGet packages
  • Experience with configuring mobile support, especially with complex runtime libraries involved
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Collect and analyze supply chain data to prioritize disparate business divisions for integration into upstream mapping and product traceability programs
  • Contribute to development of Traceability readiness and supply chain segmentation frameworks
  • Make recommendations for risk-based approaches to expanding Traceability work to divisions
  • Build and manage division onboarding project plans, coordinating with cross-functional teams (Traceability, Brand Responsibility, Data, Sourcing, Compliance, Legal, Trade) to track implementation and trouble-shoot challenges
  • Track program implementation and risk-reduction metrics to contribute to internal leadership-level reporting
  • Develop and refine internal procedures, training, and supplier communications to support compliance with evolving regulatory and customer requirements related to traceability and upstream supply chain visibility
  • Support with data collection for compliance with customer reporting and requirements (e.g., conflict minerals, supply chain disclosures, product traceability)
  • Monitor upstream supply chain risks, staying abreast of industry news and regulatory updates impacting supply chains located in the Eastern Hemisphere, as well as brands and importers in the Western Hemisphere to assess impacts to traceability policy, processes, or programs


Qualifications


  • A passion and commitment to sustainable business practices
  • 5+ years of experience in project management, successfully leading collaboration of global matrixed teams
  • Knowledge of social and environmental compliance risks in consumer goods supply chains, such as raw material traceability, chain of custody, and conflict minerals reporting in apparel and consumer goods supply chains
  • Familiarity with global sustainability and human rights standards and legislation
  • Experience with human rights and regulatory risk assessment of supply chains, leveraging qualitative and quantitative supply chain data analysis, desktop research, and on-site factory engagement, such as with a large brand/retailer or consulting service provider
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail
  • Experience developing and scaling best-in-class social compliance requirements across complex global manufacturing supply chains, including developing delivering clear and engaging presentations in English, and Chinese or Vietnamese
  • Professional working proficiency in English and strong preference for Mandarin Chinese or Vietnamese; additional languages a plus (e.g., Hindi, Urdu)
  • A proven track record of building trust with geographically diverse colleagues and supply chain partners and strong cross-cultural communication skills
  • Strong command of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint), and willingness to learn new software and data management tools (e.g., Airtable, PowerBI, supply chain management and traceability platforms)
  • Sound judgment, resourcefulness, and capacity to deal with ambiguity by engaging stakeholders
  • Ability and willingness to undertake diverse projects
  • Ability to travel when needed

  • Promotions & Event Planning
  • Content Creation & Brand Management

  • Proven experience in F&B marketing or promotions, preferably within the hospitality industry.
  • Strong knowledge of food and beverage trends, customer behavior, and hospitality operations.
  • Proficiency in digital marketing tools, including social media management, SEO, and content creation.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable marketing strategies.

rows.description:
Job Description

The position purpose comprises the key objectives for the position, and functions that this position is responsible for on a day to day basis.

This position is part of the Project & Development team of the Minor Hotel Group, requiring the services of an experienced individual who has good knowledge of practices in the areas of hotel Construction, Design and Building Renovation. Incumbents are often responsible for managing multiple projects simultaneously, protecting the interests and assets of the organization by ensuring compliance to Minor Architectural, Technical and Design standards and the project completion on time and on budget. Work is typically accomplished through interaction and working closely with Minor Hotel Group team, Design


Consultants, Project Managers and Hotel Owners to ensure compliance with Minor standards. Provides assistance with Project delivery as part of new construction and renovation projects. Familiarity with computer- assisted design, drafting and project management software applications is required. Acts as the manager for projects for Project Development for new construction and renovation projects as assigned by the Senior Project Development leaders.


Qualifications

Graduate from a university ideally with a Technical or industry related background.

  • Technical services background.
  • Architectural/ID qualification with PM experience. Minimum 5 years’ experience as a PM.
  • On site construction experience.
  • Experience managing a team.

rows.title: Mathematics Teacher for AIHM College
rows.description:
Job Description

To deliver high-quality instruction in AIHM College's Foundation Programme, preparing young students from Asia for success in universities worldwide. The role involves teaching within a specific subject area while contributing to the overall academic and personal development of students in an English-medium environment.


This position goes beyond traditional classroom instruction. You will play a crucial role in inspiring and guiding the next generation of global citizens, fostering critical thinking, and enhancing students' cultural adaptability. Your expertise will be instrumental in bridging cultural gaps and opening doors to worldwide opportunities for Asia's brightest young minds.


The role will be supplemented with a strong focus on retention, achievement, and student success. You'll provide essential pastoral support, ensuring students' personal well-being and smooth transition to life in Bangkok and future university environments. By maintaining high standards of quality provision, you'll directly impact students' futures, setting them on a path to success in their chosen fields and fostering a new generation of global leaders.

  • Deliver engaging and effective lessons in your subject area within our internationally recognized foundation curriculum, actively participating in teaching activities at all levels.
  • Contribute to integrated teaching across the programme, collaborating with colleagues from other subject areas to enhance interdisciplinary learning.
  • Assess student progress regularly, including formative and summative assessments, and provide timely feedback.
  • Participate in quality assurance procedures and maintain high academic standards.
  • Support students in their preparation for global higher education opportunities, focusing on both academic and personal development.
  • Actively engage in subject-specific activities and contribute to the wider life of AIHM College through participation in large-scale school events.
  • Communicate regularly with other teachers to monitor and support students' language development and overall progress.
  • Adhere to and promote school rules and regulations, ensuring students understand and follow them.
  • Cover lessons for colleagues when needed and complete all aspects of the school's work on time and with high quality.
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct both inside and outside the school, aligning with the school's vision, mission, and values.
  • Contribute to student retention efforts by closely monitoring attendance rates and academic progress.


Qualifications

  • A relevant academic qualification at UK graduate level or equivalent (Essential).
  • For English language teachers: Recognized TEFL qualification (Essential).
  • Relevant teaching experience (Essential). Normally a minimum of two years. (This experience should relate to the delivery of a Western-style syllabus using Western conventions and methodologies. Significant teaching/qualification management experience at a reputable university may also be acceptable.)
  • A recognised teaching qualification in Mathematics (Desirable).
  • The ability to contribute to integrated teaching across the curriculum (Essential).
  • An understanding of UK/western higher education and the needs and requirements of international students (Essential).
  • Direct experience of further and higher education in an international context (Essential).
  • Experience of the development of academic qualifications (Desirable).
  • Experience of academic assessment and standards, and of quality assurance procedures (Desirable).
  • Experience of teaching non-native speakers of English (Desirable).
  • An understanding and appreciation of private sector education (Desirable).


Person Specification:

  • In-depth knowledge of your subject area and its application in an international context.
  • Strong understanding of UK/Western higher education systems and international students' needs.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to teach non-native English speakers effectively.
  • Adaptability and willingness to contribute to various aspects of student development.
  • Cultural sensitivity and the ability to work in a diverse, international environment.


Other

  • Passion for education and student success.
  • Flexibility and creativity in teaching approaches.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.
  • Appreciation for international education in the private sector.

The role involves teaching within a specific subject area while contributing to the overall academic and personal development of students in an English-medium environment.


This position goes beyond traditional classroom instruction. You will play a crucial role in inspiring and guiding the next generation of global citizens, fostering critical thinking, and enhancing students' cultural adaptability. Your expertise will be instrumental in bridging cultural gaps and opening doors to worldwide opportunities for Asia's brightest young minds.


The role will be supplemented with a strong focus on retention, achievement, and student success. You'll provide essential pastoral support, ensuring students' personal well-being and smooth transition to life in Bangkok and future university environments. By maintaining high standards of quality provision, you'll directly impact students' futures, setting them on a path to success in their chosen fields and fostering a new generation of global leaders.

  • Deliver engaging and effective lessons in your subject area within our internationally recognized foundation curriculum, actively participating in teaching activities at all levels.
  • Contribute to integrated teaching across the programme, collaborating with colleagues from other subject areas to enhance interdisciplinary learning.
  • Assess student progress regularly, including formative and summative assessments, and provide timely feedback.
  • Participate in quality assurance procedures and maintain high academic standards.
  • Support students in their preparation for global higher education opportunities, focusing on both academic and personal development.
  • Actively engage in subject-specific activities and contribute to the wider life of AIHM College through participation in large-scale school events.
  • Communicate regularly with other teachers to monitor and support students' language development and overall progress.
  • Adhere to and promote school rules and regulations, ensuring students understand and follow them.
  • Cover lessons for colleagues when needed and complete all aspects of the school's work on time and with high quality.
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct both inside and outside the school, aligning with the school's vision, mission, and values.
  • Contribute to student retention efforts by closely monitoring attendance rates and academic progress.


Qualifications

  • A relevant academic qualification at UK graduate level or equivalent (Essential).
  • For English language teachers: Recognized TEFL qualification (Essential).
  • Relevant teaching experience (Essential). Normally a minimum of two years. (This experience should relate to the delivery of a Western-style syllabus using Western conventions and methodologies. Significant teaching/qualification management experience at a reputable university may also be acceptable.)
  • A recognised teaching qualification in English (Desirable).
  • The ability to contribute to integrated teaching across the curriculum (Essential).
  • An understanding of UK/western higher education and the needs and requirements of international students (Essential).
  • Direct experience of further and higher education in an international context (Essential).
  • Experience of the development of academic qualifications (Desirable).
  • Experience of academic assessment and standards, and of quality assurance procedures (Desirable).
  • Experience of teaching non-native speakers of English (Desirable).
  • An understanding and appreciation of private sector education (Desirable).


Person Specification:

  • In-depth knowledge of your subject area and its application in an international context.
  • Strong understanding of UK/Western higher education systems and international students' needs.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to teach non-native English speakers effectively.
  • Adaptability and willingness to contribute to various aspects of student development.
  • Cultural sensitivity and the ability to work in a diverse, international environment.


Other

  • Passion for education and student success.
  • Flexibility and creativity in teaching approaches.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.
  • Appreciation for international education in the private sector.

rows.title: Sale Support
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Responsible for data preparation of KPI/ SLA and reporting of KPI/ SLA
  • Book and validate Contract Orders in the ERP system and correspond updating to Contracts in the ERP
  • Build a relation with clients and sales representatives and become a point of contact for Customer/ Sales inquiries.
  • Coordinate (phone/ emails) with Service technicians, Logistics teams, and Sales to ensure the right delivery, installation, and confirmation to customers for the orders placed
  • Gather details from customers and sometimes service technicians for proper invoicing (including CN/ DN notes) and ensure to have complete the billing/ invoicing on-time as per the contractual agreements.
  • Administration of customer contracts i.e. update contracts, fixed and variable billing computation as per contact terms.
  • Ensure resolution to customer requests for any queries on Contracts/ order status and billing/ invoicing corrections.
  • Follow-up on pending items with Logistics/ Supply chain team for order delivery status
  • Periodical and ad-hoc report preparation for internal (Sales, Business Controllers etc.) and external (Customers).
  • Archival of the right set of documents for audit and compliance purposes
  • Update ERP regarding Customer Master details, order details, supplies, pricing etc.
  • Gather information from logistic partners and inform customers regarding availability and deliveries.
  • Offer resolutions for internal updating requests: credit/ debit notes, reimbursements, rebates etc.
  • Check and solve potential issues between client purchase orders (PO) and system information
  • Communicate with the warehouse and forwarders and efficiently manage the delivery process to ensure return of goods to the final recipient
  • Prepare the relevant documents for the orders-Export documents (LoC etc.), Proforma invoices, customs documents etc. and coordinate with internal teams for smooth order delivery.
  • Daily monitor the assigned orders and exceptions validations
  • Proper categorize customer issues in the system and correspond responses on ERP systems for various disputes arising from customers in terms of damaged goods, shipment delayed etc.
  • Manage any issues, look for solutions along with all the parties involved.
  • Work with local markets to gather rights details or resolutions and also manage escalations, any problems, delays, inconsistencies etc.
  • Propose resolution for streamlining activities and take part in projects to implement these ideas.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • SAP ERP experience
  • Excellent communication skills (English & Thai) – written and oral
  • Any past transition experience will be added advantage.
  • Familiar with MS-Office (Excel/ Word/ PowerPoint) applications.

rows.title: Skilled Sales Support Administrator​
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:


  • Ensures operational sales effectiveness by establishing relationships with vendors and coordinating everyday interactions, queries and general information sharing with them.
  • Provides quotes for clients either from direct requests or on behalf of the sales team.
  • Influences the price and margin, by suggesting different products dependent on lead times, promotions, alternative suppliers and programs.
  • Provides support capacity required to administer aspects of the purchase order process by generating, distributing and administrating purchase orders.
  • Checks the quotes against raised order to ensure that what has been ordered has been quoted and that the correct terms and conditions have been applied.
  • Checks information on the most current vendor pricing conjunction with commercial colleagues and ensure access to vendor pricing.
  • Supports capacity provided on general sales related documentation through receiving, labelling, sorting, filing and distributing as is required.
  • Captures data and maintains systems as is required by the sales process and sales team.
  • Provides administrative support to the sales force when it is required.
  • Uses the systems and data to produce reports when necessary.
  • May be required to identify and recommend improvements to sales administration processes.


Knowledge and Attributes:


  • Detail oriented and highly organized.
  • Ability to work in a high paced environment.
  • Solid analytical skills.
  • Good communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Must be service oriented and have a positive attitude to work.
  • Skilled knowledge and understanding of sales processes, tools and methodologies would be advantageous.
  • Able to work in a team and independently, applying a proactive approach to work processes.
  • Ability to use judgement to make decisions about work process and apply improvements.
  • High / Secondary School diploma or equivalent qualification.
  • Solid experience with quoting tools would be an advantage.
  • Solid administration experience, particularly quote to cash processes.
  • Solid experience managing work processes.

rows.title: Senior Associate Financial Accountant
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:


  • Under supervision, assists with implementing, controlling, and monitoring of periodic compliance testing.
  • Actively supports the management of overall financial forecasting processes as well as reviewing financial records to ensure they comply with company policies and accounting principles.
  • Undertakes a regular review of the accuracy of regulatory calculations and submissions.
  • Assists with reconciling accounts, resolving discrepancies, and collaborating across various finance and non-finance functions.
  • Supports with analyzing journals, producing data analysis and reports and analyzing past performance of financial data and preparing budgets and forecasts for business unit management.
  • Helps with implementing effective financial controls, including systems reconciliations and ensuring the integrity of reported figures.
  • Proactively supports the activities of the accounts receivable function within the assigned business unit and processes month-end activities which include the preparation and processing of month-end journal entries, processing loan and bank account entries and reconciling these accounts and executing a variety of actions in the accounting system.
  • May assist with reviewing the credit vetting process by ensuring that new accounts are opened in line with financial procedures.
  • Performs any other relevant task as requested by management.


Knowledge and Attributes:


  • Good communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Good interpersonal skills and ability to self-manage.
  • Display good planning and organizing abilities.
  • Demonstrate good attention to detail and deadline driven.
  • Able to cope with stressful situations.
  • Able to deal with different individuals at various levels in the organization.
  • Takes own initiative and has a solutions-orientated approach.
  • Maintains a high standard of accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to work independently and be a knowledge expert
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting or Finance or related field.
  • Moderate level of experience gained in similar role preferably within a similar global organization.
  • Moderate level of financial accounting experience.
  • Moderate level of experience working on financial systems / software.

rows.title: Consulting Associate/Senior Associate – Technical, Risk & Safety
rows.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Provide technical assistance on safety and risk projects involving risk analysis, modeling, calculations, and other studies.
  • Perform robust technically sound analysis based on reasoned argument and defensible data/information. Typical analysis and studies include:
  • Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) models using Excel spreadsheets
  • Fire and explosion modeling using CFD or empirical tools
  • Gas and smoke dispersion modeling using CFD or empirical tools
  • Risk calculations (e.g., probability of unfortunate events occurring)
  • Non-flammable hazard analysis
  • Escape, Temporary Refuge, Evacuation and Rescue Analysis (ETRERA) for offshore facilities
  • Safety Critical Element/Systems Analysis
  • Pipeline risk assessments
  • Cost/benefit analysis
  • Safety integrity level (SIL) studies
  • Suggest improvements/changes to design to reduce risk or improve operations
  • Participate in safety workshops (i.e., HAZID, HAZOP, ALARP), including workshop preparation, scribe, and client reporting.
  • Attend client meeting and preparation of proposal.
  • Prepare safety cases, including facility descriptions, safety management system descriptions, and formal safety assessment summaries.
  • Prepare high-quality reports with clear diagrams and fully explain analysis and calculations.
  • Perform multiple projects within scope/budget/schedule expectations and ensure quality standards on project deliverables.
  • Support ERM Partners-in-Charge and Project Managers to effectively manage projects.


QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering; Master’s degree and/or professional registration is a plus.
  • Possess strong written, verbal communication and data presentation skills in both Thai and English.
  • Good Project Management skills.
  • Strong commitment to safety, including following established Health and Safety protocols.
  • Ability to multi-task, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply

rows.description:
Job Purpose

The Platform Architect is instrumental in shaping the organization's data platform strategy while leading the design, development, and implementation. This role involves understanding business processes, ensuring platform alignment with business goals, and integrating diverse business functions into a unified system. The Platform Architect ensures scalability, reliability, and adaptability of the platform to evolving business needs while upholding data integrity and security standards. Collaborating closely with stakeholders, they facilitate seamless platform deployment and drive continuous improvement initiatives.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Platform Design and Strategy
  • Develop and maintain the organization's data platform architecture, ensuring alignment with current and future business requirements.
  • Define platform standards, best practices, and guidelines to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Infrastructure Management
  • Oversee the selection, deployment, and management of hardware, software, and cloud resources within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Optimize infrastructure configuration for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Security and Compliance
  • Implement robust security measures to safeguard data, applications, and infrastructure within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Ensure adherence to data security and privacy principles, as well as compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to understand technology requirements and constraints.
  • Communicate platform strategies, updates, and initiatives clearly and concisely to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Emerging Technologies
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, particularly within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies that can enhance the functionality and capabilities of the data platform.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement
  • Drive innovation in platform design and architecture, seeking opportunities to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Identify areas for automation and process improvement to streamline platform operations and enhance user experience.


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in platform architecture and cloud technologies, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certifications.


Experience

  • A minimum of 10 years in platform architecture and infrastructure management roles, with a focus on data platforms.
  • Proven track record in designing scalable and secure platforms that support organizational objectives and technological advancements.
  • Expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services related to data management, including BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow, and Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Skills in architecting and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing solutions, database design, and working with large datasets.
  • Proficiency in data integration, ETL processes, and automation within cloud environments.
  • Understanding of data security and privacy principles, ensuring compliance with data governance and regulatory standards.

rows.title: Senior Director - Ambient Engineering & Maintenance
rows.description:
Main purpose of the role:

Provide overall Engineering & Maintenance functional leadership and oversight of machine/utility/technology-related objectives for Ambient operations.

  • Provide overall Engineering & Maintenance functional leadership and oversight of machine / utility / technology-related objectives for Ambient operations.
  • Strategic direction: Drive strategic & tactical decisions for Ambient Engineering & Maintenance and align resources to deliver key functional objectives in alignment with TU strategic goals.
  • Production technology innovation: Shape development and implementation of engineering solutions to improve and innovate production process, achieve sustainable / environmental goals and/or support new product / existing product change designs.
  • Common engineering standards: Ensure engineering and maintenance standards and set-up protocols as well as ensure standardization of machines, equipment, tools and utilities where cost-feasible.
  • Capital project management: Oversee planning and execution of capital projects to ensure technical, quality, regulatory and budget requirements are met.
  • Effective maintenance: Maximize reliability and effectiveness through enforcing effective maintenance, repairs and overhauls practices while optimizing for cost.
  • People and leadership: Motivate, lead and challenge team members to reach / exceed targets and objectives. Improve and sustain employee engagement scores to be within the top quartile. Develop strong internal leadership pipeline and set positive working culture with teams across Thai Union.


Key accountabilities:

1. Set strategic direction

  • Review and approve overall technology roadmap and engineering and maintenance initiatives in line with TU strategic goals.
  • Review and approve budget for engineering and maintenance OPEX, CAPEX and related improvement initiatives.
  • Review and approve Ambient Engineering & Maintenance and Plant Maintenance KPIs and targets.
  • Promote best-practices and knowledge sharing related to engineering and maintenance across Ambient operations.

2. Production technology innovation

  • Oversee design of engineering solutions to improve and innovate production process (e.g., productivity, cost, reliability, etc.), achieve sustainable / environmental goals (e.g., zero-discharge, zero-waste, etc.), and/or support product innovation / new product designs / existing product change designs
  • Support implementation of engineering solutions through internal coordination with relevant stakeholders (e.g., CAPEX investments, Factory of the Future collaboration, zero-discharge / zero-waste, etc.)
  • Facilitate deployment of suitable capability building programs across plants as necessary
  • Support deployment / implementation of engineering improvement initiative across Ambient operations.

3. Common engineering standards

  • Oversee setting of engineering standards (e.g., technical specs, tolerances, necessary regulatory documents/certifications, etc.) and set-up protocols for machines, equipment and tools.
  • Oversee setting of standard processes to conduct preventive maintenance, autonomous maintenance, repairs and overhauls and related protocols.
  • Review and approve overall Ambient BU capital project standards (e.g., minimum NPV, social / environmental impact, accounting standards / useful life, etc.) and stage-gate process for capital project delivery.
  • Review and monitor compliance to global ESG standards and commitments in conjunction with SHE (i.e., energy systems, emission and wastewater treatment) and ensure each plant’s compliance to local laws.
  • Oversee and monitor engineering audits and process / equipment testing to ensure compliance.
  • Support standardization of machines, tools and technology platforms to ensure operational consistency where cost-feasible.

4. Capital project management

  • Participate in concept development, feasibility study and project planning.
  • Provide technical support throughout project design and execution.
  • Support governance of stage-gate process to deliver fit-for-purpose projects (technical, quality, regulatory and budget requirements).
  • Oversee coordination with SHE, Sustainability, Facilities Management and other relevant functions to ensure projects obtain required permits and meet regulatory requirements and compliance.
  • Monitor project progress and report to upper management as required.
  • Ensure implementation of risk-based approach throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Oversee bidding and selection process of construction & engineering contractors.

5. Effective maintenance

  • Review recommendation on and approve in-house vs. outsource decisions on critical maintenance activities
  • Ensure maintenance practices and protocols are being followed across plants
  • Monitor maintenance budget and guide maintenance cost reduction initiatives
  • Oversee spare parts usage to ensure budget and standards adherence and avoid leakages
  • Provide expertise to improve maintenance effectiveness and resolve maintenance issues
  • Oversee assets management (e.g., movements, write-offs, transfers, and registrations)

6. People and leadership

  • Embody a strong culture of collaboration by fostering an environment of open communication and teamwork.
  • Identify high potential talents and coach teams to fully leverage talent of the team.
  • Drive to improve career development paths & performance mgmt. to enhance team motivation and retain quality talent.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and development to enhance employee skills and competencies.
  • Manage people budget for the Ambient Engineering & Maintenance, in collaboration with HR.


Desired candidate profile:

  • Ability to lead and motivate teams, build a diverse and trust-based leadership team, and develop local talent.
  • Displays proficiency in engineering principles, maintenance practices and project management with the capability to identify and analyze complex problems and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to identify and implement new technologies and best practices to develop and improve manufacturing processes, machines, tools, equipment and utilities.
  • Demonstrates strategic thinking and ability to develop / prioritize long-term plans for improving manufacturing processes, equipment, and utilities while maintaining compliance with safety, quality and regulatory standards.
  • Excellent communication skills to effectively convey technical information to team members, stakeholders, and upper management.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to foster a culture of collaboration and effectively drive cross-functional projects.

rows.title: Credit Facility Manager
rows.description:
About the job

Credit Facility Management:

  • Oversee the company's short-term and long-term credit facilities.
  • Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions to secure favorable credit terms.
  • Monitor and evaluate credit facility agreements to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.
  • Maintain and improve the company’s financial credit position by managing relationships and providing good communication on the company credit story to the banks and investors

Funding and Financing:

  • Develop and implement strategies for short-term and long-term financing to meet the company’s capital needs.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to determine funding requirements and to support on optimal financing structures, financing products, and financing features with terms and conditions.
  • Prepare and present financial proposals for funding approvals.

Bond Issuance and Management:

  • Lead the process of issuing bonds, including preparation of documentation and coordination with legal and financial advisors.
  • Monitor bond market trends and manage the company's bond portfolio.

Credit Rating Management:

  • Maintain and improve the company’s credit rating by managing relationships and providing good communication on the company credit story to credit rating agencies.
  • Prepare, coordinate with others, and submit required documentation for credit rating evaluations.
  • Analyze and implement recommendations from credit rating agencies to enhance the company’s creditworthiness.

Project Planning and Leadership:

  • Lead projects related to funding and credit facilities, ensuring they are completed on time and within budget.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and risk management.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and communicate project progress to stakeholders.

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Conduct and co-ordinate with others on financial analysis to support funding decisions and credit facility management.
  • Prepare detailed reports on the company’s credit facility status, financing activities, and credit ratings for senior management.

Risk Management:

  • Identify and mitigate financial risks associated with credit facilities and funding activities.

Develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure robust risk management practices


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as CFA, CPA, or similar (preferred).
  • Experience in credit facility management, banking, or corporate finance.
  • Proven experience in managing short-term and long-term financing, including bonds and credit ratings.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets, instruments, and credit risk assessment.
  • Excellent project management and leadership skills.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficient in financial modeling and analysis tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Best-in-class occupational Safety, Health and Environment training: Design and roll-out up-to-date and comprehensive training programs and communications materials across all plants / offices, working with SHE BU compliance leads as needed to adapt materials to country or BU-specific needs.

  • Work with SHE BU Compliance Leads and Plant SHE Managers to monitor training or certification completion rates, identify key capability gaps and execute appropriate interventions.

  • Design and work with SHE BU Compliance Leads and Plant SHE Managers to roll-out comprehensive and fit-for-purpose Occupational Safety & Health and Environmental training programs.
  • Collaborate with SHE Technical Leads to ensure coverage of best-in-class practices in all training modules.
  • Collaborate with SHE BU Compliance Leads and Plant SHE teams to tailor training programs to BU / plant-specific standards and regulations.
  • Design and implement Train-the-trainer programs for Plant SHE teams to effectively deliver training programs and communications messages to other plant teams.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs by establishing feedback loops and revise materials for continuous improvement.

2.2 Regulatory compliance

  • Partner with Group SHE Technical Leads to monitor changes in global and local regulations relating to Occupational Safety and Health and Environmental manufacturing practices.
  • Collaborate with Group SHE Technical Leads to ensure that latest regulatory and industry requirements, and external best practices are incorporated into SHE training curriculum and materials.
  • Submit and ensure approval of training materials from government agencies in a timely manner as needed, and manage periodic renewal processes.
  • Submit and ensure permit required to operate / conduct SHE training from government agencies in a timely manner as needed, and manage periodic renewal processes.
  • Ensure relevant personnel in Thai Union maintain required certification to deliver government approved training programs.

3. Training execution

  • Work with BU Compliance Leads and Plant SHE Managers to plan and coordinate training schedules across plants / offices globally to ensure that relevant employees receive timely and appropriate SHE training.
  • Conduct select Safety & Health and Environmental Training programs as relevant.
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication with plant-level SHE teams regarding training program schedules and content updates.

4. Other operations

  • Evaluate training program content and delivery effectiveness through KPI performance and feedback loops, making improvements as needed.
  • Create process / system and collaborate with Plant SHE Managers to maintain detailed training completion / certification records of all plant employees.
  • Manage operations of TUF Training Center to service all BUs in Thailand.


Desired candidate profile:

  • Strong proficiency in relevant general and country-specific occupational Safety & Health and Environmental regulations and standards.
  • Instructional experience and expertise in designing and delivering effective training programs.
  • Knowledge on implementation & operation of digital training platforms to scale-up training.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to oversee coordination of multiple training programs, resources, schedules and priorities etc. with Group SHE colleagues and key Manufacturing stakeholders globally.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with external agencies and collaborate across cross-functional teams in Thai Union.
  • Proficient in English.

rows.title: General Ledger Accounting Section Manager (GL)
rows.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Partner and collaborate with other accounting team members to provide accounting services to assigned operating companies in U.S

• Supervise the small team, assist on the routine tasks, solve the difficult and complicated issues and develop the team members.

• Perform monthly close functions, including account reconciliations, accruals and preparation of journal entries.

• Prepare monthly account reconciliations and resolve reconciling items on a monthly basis.

• Ensure that adequate supporting documentation is maintained.

• Ensure all month-end journal entries are recorded following the monthly close schedule.

• Coordinate and collaborate with A/R, A/P, Legal and HR as needed as well as other departments.

• Responsible for reconciliation of intercompany accounts

• Prepare fluctuation of balance sheets and other ad hoc analyses

• Assists with quarterly & annual review analysis as needed.

• Prepare supporting schedules to facilitate audit schedules and collaborate with external auditors to ensure timely and adequate responses to audit requests.

• Assist with preparation of G&A budgets and reforecast for Thai Union North America and USPN

• Identify and improve procedures to achieve efficiencies with month - end close and day to day operations

• Support the Sr. Director of accounting in day-to-day activities and other ad hoc projects

• Document policies and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility

• Preparation of audit and tax schedules for year end.

• Timely prepare state tax filings, property taxes and other regulatory filings as needed

• Promote internal controls, adherence to operating procedures and compliance to financial reporting guidelines

• Assists with ad hoc accounting and financial projects as requested


REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelors in Accounting, Finance or related business field with an accounting concentration

• 3-5 years of combined accounting experience within a medium-to-large business

• Experience in a food manufacturing company and import business a plus

• Ability to work collaboratively across departmental functions

• Strong knowledge of GAAP, internal controls and financial reporting

• Experience with ERP or other accounting applications, especially Oracle, AS400 and SAP

• Advanced Excel skills strongly desired; (i.e. pivot tables, v-lookups, formulas, etc.)

• Excellent English both verbal and written communication skills.

• Exhibits effective organizational and time-management skills.

• Knowledge or familiarity of Cost Accounting is a plus, but not required.

• Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Strong ability to handle assignments within tight timelines

• Strong problem-solving skills
