rows.title: Managing Director - Ambient Quality
rows.description:
About the job

Main purpose of the role:

Provide overall Quality functional leadership and oversight of quality-related objectives for Ambient operations.

  • Strategic direction: Drive strategic & tactical decisions for Ambient Quality and align resources to deliver key functional objectives in alignment with TU strategic goals.
  • Highest quality products: Ensure Ambient products meet all applicable quality requirements of customers, safety, health, environment / sustainability, and regulators through setting and enforcing product and production quality standards and control protocols including involvement in product development process.
  • External quality standards compliance: Decide external (global and local) quality standards (e.g., ISO, IFS, BRC, etc.) and establish processes and procedures to ensure compliance of all Ambient operations including support of internal audits.
  • Quality issue management: Lead resolution of systematic, BU-wide quality issues and escalate to top management where necessary; provide framework and processes to resolve and manage change of quality issues at all levels.
  • Effective customer feedback: Oversee design and management of customer feedback loops to ensure quality issues are appropriately addressed and escalated.
  • Supplier quality and strategic development: Oversee supplier quality standards setting and development and ensure supplier adherence to standards.
  • Unified quality management system: Oversee development and maintenance of quality manual and quality management system and ensure consistency in quality practices across Ambient operations.
  • People and leadership: Motivate, lead and challenge team members to reach / exceed targets and objectives. Improve and sustain employee engagement scores to be within the top quartile. Develop strong internal leadership pipeline and set positive working culture with teams across Thai Union.


Key accountabilities:

Set strategic direction

  • Provide framework for establishing and reviewing quality improvement agenda and objectives
  • Review and approve quality improvement agenda and improvement initiatives across Ambient BU and plants.
  • Review and approve budget for quality improvement initiatives at Ambient Quality.
  • Review and approve Ambient Quality and Plant Quality KPIs and targets.
  • Assess Production, Engineering & Maintenance, Production Excellence strategies and related continuous improvement initiatives at Ambient BU, ensuring quality standards are adhered to promote best-practices and knowledge sharing related to quality within Ambient BU.
  • Continuously incorporate internal best practices and learnings into quality standards.

Highest quality products

  • Establish customer-driven mindset for Ambient Quality to appropriately capture quality-related needs and requirements of customers.
  • Ensure applicable safety, health, environment / sustainability, and regulatory requirements are captured in TU’s product and production quality standards and related control procedures.
  • Oversee Ambient Quality Assurance in setting overall product and production quality standards, tolerance levels, methods of testing, and control framework / thresholds for all Ambient operations within TU.
  • Oversee Ambient Quality Assurance in ensuring product and production (including existing, new, and incremental product development) quality standards, specifications, tolerance, methods of testing, and control set by plants adhere to framework / thresholds and are appropriately transferrable across plants for common products / SKUs.
  • Support production infrastructure / environment (e.g., human resource capabilities, machines, equipment, process, shopfloor sanitation etc.) to enable the achievement of conformity to product and production quality requirements.
  • Ensure Plant Quality teams follow inspection procedures, standards, tolerance levels and methods of testing for raw materials, semi-/finished goods, mass production samples and production infrastructure / environment to ensure compliance with all applicable quality standards.

Product development and innovation

  • Provide quality guidelines to Plant Quality on development of existing, new, and incremental products.
  • Provide support in quality assessment of Innovation Platforms and Disruptive Innovation (i.e., new machines, technology, processes).
  • Ensure previous quality learnings are incorporated in design of all products.

External quality standards compliance

  • Decide applicable external quality standards (IFS, BRC, etc.) to provide customers and consumers with assurance of highest quality in Ambient operations and/or to support overall TU strategic goals.
  • Provide support (expertise, issue resolution framework, etc.) to Ambient Quality Assurance to ensure plants are compliant with all applicable quality standards and regulations (including effective document control, coordination for external audits, and necessary filings).
  • Oversee design of internal audits standards and cadence.
  • Oversee execution of internal and external audits to ensure the quality standards and control protocols are effectively implemented and maintained.

Quality issue management

  • Lead resolution of Ambient BU-wide quality-related incidences (food safety or product quality).
  • Drive / support internal and external communication with relevant stakeholders for Ambient BU-wide quality issues, including escalation to top management where necessary.
  • Ensure effective processes to close out IR / NCP / NC / CAR / other production-specific quality issues including root cause analysis, investigations and internal / external follow-ups and sign-offs.
  • Ensure effective coordination between Ambient Quality Assurance and plants to close IR / NCP / NC/ CAR / other production-specific quality issues.
  • Establish processes to appropriately manage quality-related changes to eliminate reoccurrence of previous quality issues.
  • Ensure change management processes are strictly followed by all Ambient Quality and Plant Quality teams.

Effective customer feedback

  • Oversee design customer feedback loops to assure that quality issues are found, correctly triaged, and appropriate addressed by and/or escalated to relevant parties.
  • Ensure closed-loop communication between Commercial, Production, Engineering, Production Excellence, Quality and other relevant functions to address and learn / improve from found quality issues.

Supplier quality and strategic development

  • Ensure supplier quality standards adhere to applicable external and internal quality standards, in line with quality needs of customers, safety, health, environment / sustainability, and regulators.
  • Oversee design of supplier quality standards, assessment scorecard, and supplier quality audits criteria.
  • Oversee execution of supplier audits across Ambient operations.
  • Oversee resolution of suppliers quality issues, ensuring corrective actions are addressed in timely manner.
  • Collaborate with Procurement / Non-fish Procurement to assess, select and develop suppliers and strategic partners for centrally procured / critical categories (e.g., fish, packaging, oils, freight, etc.)


Desired Candidate Profile:

  • Ability to lead and motivate teams, build a diverse and trust-based leadership team, and develop local talent.
  • Displays proficiency in Quality principles for Ambient production.
  • Knowledge of quality standards and compliance regulations to ensure compliance across Ambient operations.
  • Demonstrate ability to make hard decisions, making the right trade-offs.
  • Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills to conduct root cause analysis for quality issues.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to foster a culture of collaboration and effectively drive cross-functional processes (e.g., customer feedback loop).
  • Proficient in English.

  • หากมีประสบการณ์ในการทำงานจะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ
  • มีความรู้ความสามารถในการฟัง พูด อ่าน เขียน ภาษาอังกฤษได้ในระดับดีมาก
  • สามารถใช้คอมพิวเตอร์ MS Office ได้ดี
  • มีความรับผิดชอบสูง มี Service Mind
  • มีความละเอียดรอบคอบ และสามารถทำงานภายใต้ภาวะความกดดันได้ดี

rows.title: Managing Director, Global SHE
rows.description:
About the job

Main purpose of the role:

  • Strategic direction: Define strategic direction for Group SHE and allocate resources to deliver key functional objectives in alignment with Thai Union Group strategic goals.
  • Best-in-class safety, health and environment: Oversee the design and implementation of Group SHE standards, systems, processes in compliance with regulations (e.g., ISO); ensure overall group wide compliance to standards; define SHE roadmap and incident management communication.
  • People and leadership: Motivate, lead and challenge team members to reach / exceed targets and objectives. Improve and sustain employee engagement scores to be within the top quartile; develop strong internal leadership pipeline and set positive working culture with teams across Thai Union.


Key accountabilities:

1. Strategic direction

  • Define Group SHE strategic direction for Thai Union Group.
  • Collaborate with Group Director (Sustainability and Corporate Communications, Procurement, Finance, Human Resource, and other relevant functions / business units) to align on Group Sustainability agenda for Thai Union Operations.
  • Design and recommend the Group SHE roadmap and improvement plan.
  • Oversee the design of SHE programs focused on health, safety, and environment for all employees, contractors, and plant / office visitors.
  • Oversee the development of plant / BU SHE KPIs between BU Manufacturing Leads, SHE BU Compliance Lead, Plant Managers and Plant SHE Manager.
  • Collaborate with the BU Manufacturing Leads to ensure active performance monitoring and timely mitigation actions taken to deliver concrete improvements.

2. Best-in-class safety & health and environment

2.1 Standards and programs

  • Oversee and be accountable for the development of SHE policies, standards and processes for the Thai Union Group; ensure learnings from past implementations are incorporated into future programs and policies.
  • Drive standardization of SHE practices including policies, standards, processes, and system across Thai Union group.
  • Drive collaboration with Plant SHE Managers to determine certification requirements (e.g. ISO) and ensure required certificates are acquired and maintained.
  • Oversee and be accountable for the design and implementation of groupwide Occupational Health and Safety and Environment impact reduction related programs and initiatives.
  • Jointly develop, maintain, and execute Group level business continuity plan including conducting regular refreshers (with Group Risk and Group legal).
  • Manage the sharing of best practices from Group / other plants to prevent and reduce adverse impacts from poor industrial hygiene / workplace safety standards / environment controls; ensure consistency across Thai Union.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and ensure relevant SHE policies are updated.

2.2 Compliance and audit

  • Drive collaboration between Group SHE functions (SHE Technical Leads, SHE BU Compliance Lead, Plant SHE Managers) and BU / plant management to ensure SHE policy / roadmap implementation and adherence.
  • Oversee the validation of the critical SHE inspection outcomes by SHE BU Compliance Lead for each plant and ensure the implementation of corrective and preventive actions (e.g., emergency response readiness inspection, air emission sampling).
  • Oversee and moderate SHE responses for large scale, Thai Union Group wide external audits.
  • Oversee the design, schedule and execution of SHE internal audits / inspections across plants.

2.3 Incident management and Implementation

  • Supervise and ensure Group support for Plant SHE teams on serious incidents; ensure appropriate investigation, communication and corrective action to prevent reoccurrence (e.g., injury, illness, chemical spills).

2.4 Capability frameworks, training and communication

  • Oversee and be accountable for the evaluation of SHE skills competency requirements and design of appropriate interventions, ensuring consistency across Thai Union.
  • Approve and oversee the design and execution of groupwide SHE training curriculums and SHE communication materials (including onboarding); drive consistency across Thai Union as practically possible.
  • Monitor the rollout of SHE training including Train-the-trainer SHE sessions for key personnel across all plants.

2.5 Other operations

  • Drive SHE due-diligences for new business acquisition.
  • Oversee and be accountable for the selection and management of SHE digital systems and tools globally for Group and Plants.
  • Monitor status of SHE projects with high impact / investment value e.g., on fire protection elements; resolve SHE-related roadblocks when raised.
  • Monitor and give inputs to any Thai Union projects / operational changes that have impact on safety, health, and environment.

3. People and leadership

  • Motivate, lead, and challenge Group and Plant SHE teams to reach / exceed SHE targets and objectives, cultivating a culture of health and safety consciousness across Thai Union.
  • Foster an environment of open communication and teamwork to embody a strong culture of collaboration.
  • Create the culture to attract, develop and retain talent as well as drive employee satisfaction within the SHE function, in collaboration with HR.
  • Identify high potential talents and coach teams to fully leverage talent of the team.
  • Drive to improve career development paths & performance mgmt. to enhance team motivation and retain quality talent.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and development to enhance employee skills and competencies.
  • Build longer term view/ plan around people, prepare succession plans at different levels.
  • Manage people budget for the Group SHE function, in collaboration with HR.


Desired candidate profile:

  • Strong proficiency in SHE standards to ensure employee safety, reduce environmental impact, and ensure compliance across all Thai Union sites.
  • Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills to resolve priority SHE project roadblocks.
  • Ability to lead and motivate teams, build a diverse and trust-based leadership team, and develop local talent.
  • Demonstrate ability to make hard decisions, making the right trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to drive SHE agenda through cross functional collaboration with BU / plant leadership.
  • Proficient in English.

rows.title: Vice President - Group Wide Loyalty
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and execute a unified loyalty strategy in collaboration with the EVP and other senior leaders, ensuring alignment with the overall business goals.
  • Work across business units and regions to design and implement a global loyalty framework that enhances customer satisfaction and lifetime value.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to the EVP on loyalty trends, customer engagement, and program performance.

Program Design & Execution:

  • Lead the development, launch, and management of the company’s global loyalty program, tailoring the strategy to meet local and regional market demands.
  • Oversee a dedicated team responsible for daily operations, program development, and optimization.
  • Ensure that the loyalty program integrates seamlessly across all touchpoints, including digital platforms, in-store experiences, and customer service channels.

Performance Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Drive data-informed decision-making by analyzing customer data, loyalty metrics, and program performance to continually refine the loyalty strategy.
  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs), such as program enrollment, customer retention, repeat purchases, and ROI.
  • Provide regular reports and insights to the EVP, highlighting progress and areas of opportunity for program enhancements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate closely with key departments, including marketing, operations, finance, and IT, to align loyalty efforts with broader business objectives.
  • Partner with product and technology teams to ensure the seamless integration of loyalty features across all customer channels.
  • Lead efforts to secure strategic partnerships with third-party vendors and loyalty platform providers to enhance the value proposition of the program.

Customer-Centric Focus:

  • Foster a deep understanding of customer needs and behaviors to create personalized loyalty experiences that increase engagement and brand advocacy.
  • Implement feedback mechanisms to capture customer insights and continuously improve the loyalty offering.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and competitor strategies to ensure the loyalty program remains innovative and competitive.

Financial & Operational Accountability:

  • Develop and manage the loyalty program’s budget, ensuring that financial goals are met.
  • Provide the EVP and senior leadership with financial performance updates, demonstrating the program’s impact on customer retention, revenue, and profitability.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (MBA preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in loyalty marketing, customer retention, or CRM, with 5+ years in a leadership role, ideally within a global organization.
  • Proven experience working cross-functionally to design and implement successful loyalty programs.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage customer data to drive strategic decision-making.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
  • Experience working with loyalty management platforms, CRM systems, and customer analytics tools.
  • Global or multi-market experience with a clear understanding of regional differences and market-specific needs.

rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

  • ช่วยปฏิบัติการพยาบาลขั้นพื้นฐานแก่ผู้ป่วยนอก รวมถึงการช่วยแพทย์ในการตรวจวินิจฉัยหรือทำหัตถการที่พบบ่อยในหน่วยงานได้ด้วยตนเอง ต้อนรับ ลงทะเบียน จัดเตรียมเวชระเบียน และเอกสารที่เกี่ยวข้อง ให้ข้อมูลการบริการ อำนวยความสะดวกแก่ผู้มาใช้บริการตามมาตรฐานการบริการที่ดี ดูแลรักษาความสะอาด ความเป็นระเบียบเรียบร้อย ความเพียงพอ และความพร้อมใช้งานของสถานที่ อุปกรณ์ เครื่องมือและของใช้ต่างๆภายในแผนก จัดทำข้อมูลสถิติ ตัวชี้วัด และรายงานของหน่วยงาน ปฏิบัติงานในหน้าที่พี่เลี้ยง นิเทศงาน ติดตาม ประเมินผล และให้คำแนะนำในการปฏิบัติงานแก่ผู้ช่วยแพทย์ใหม่ได้

These methods include: conducting observational research, interviews and workshops; undertaking internal and external research activities; formulating insights; communicating findings and in a clear and compelling visual manner.

rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

  • บริหารจัดการ กำกับดูแล ควบคุมการประเมินความเสี่ยงด้านการติดเชื้อในโรงพยาบาล รวมถึงวางแผนการจัดกิจกรรมการป้องกันการติดเชื้อให้สอดคล้องมาตรฐานของโรงพยาบาล
  • กำกับ ติดตามวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลการเฝ้าระวังการติดเชื้อในโรงพยาบาล (Healthcare Associated Infections) และจัดทำรายงานข้อมูลการเฝ้าระวัง เพื่อรายงานต่อหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการดูแลผู้ป่วย
  • กำกับ ติดตาม การสอบสวนการระบาดของโรคติดต่อที่เกิดขึ้นในโรงพยาบาล และจัดทำ ทบทวนนโยบาย ระเบียบปฏิบัติการสอบสวนโรคติดเชื้อตามมาตรฐานงานป้องกันและควบคุมการติดเชื้อให้เป็นปัจจุบัน
  • เป็นวิทยากรอบรมให้ความรู้เกี่ยวกับการป้องกันและควบคุมการติดเชื้อต่างๆ ของโรงพยาบาล และจัดประชุมวิชาการ เพื่อให้บุคลากรได้มีการแลกเปลี่ยนความรู้ ปรึกษา แนวทางปฏิบัติที่เหมาะสม
  • มีส่วนร่วมในการเป็นผู้ตรวจสอบคุณภาพภายในโรงพยาบาล เพื่อประเมินความพร้อมสำหรับการเยี่ยมสำรวจของหน่วยงานขององค์กรวิชาชีพที่เกี่ยวข้องในการรับรองวิทยฐานะและมาตรฐานงานโรงพยาบาล


คุณสมบัติ

  • ปริญญาตรี สาขาพยาบาลศาสตร์/ปริญญาโท พยาบาลศาสตร์ สาขาระบาดวิทยา
  • มีใบอนุญาตประกอบวิชาชีพการพยาบาล และการผดุงครรภ์ชั้นหนึ่ง
  • มีประสบการณ์การพยาบาลป้องกันและควบคุมการติดเชื้ออย่างน้อย 5ปี และงานบริหารจัดการอย่างน้อย 3ปี
  • อบรมหลักสูตรการพยาบาลเฉพาะทาง สาขาการพยาบาลผู้ป่วยโรคติดเชื้อการควบคุมการติดเชื้อ
  • ทำงานเป็นทีมได้ มี Service mind
  • มีความซื่อสัตย์ ละเอียดรอบคอบ
  • มีทักษะด้านคอมพิวเตอร์ ได้แก่ Microsoft Office
  • มีความสามารถด้านการสื่อสารภาษาอังกฤษ พูด และ การเขียนระดับดี

rows.title: Media Plan & Budget Allocation Specialist
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to understand target audiences, media landscape, and emerging trends in healthcare marketing.
  • Develop comprehensive media plans, defining the best mix of traditional (print, broadcast) and digital channels to achieve marketing objectives.
  • Research and compare media vendors, negotiate pricing and contracts to secure the most cost-effective media buys.
  • Allocate marketing budgets strategically across different channels, ensuring optimal resource utilization.
  • Monitor campaign performance using relevant metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions), identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations for budget adjustments, creative refreshes, or channel diversification.
  • Generate insightful reports to track campaign progress and communicate key findings to internal stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest media trends and technologies, assessing their potential impact on MedPark's marketing strategies.


คุณสมบัติ

  • Bachelor's Degree in Digital Marketing, Business, Marketing Communication, or a related field.
  • At least 2-3 years of experience in media planning, buying, or a similar marketing role.
  • Proficiency in Thai and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of various media channels (digital, print, broadcast) and their functionalities for reaching target audiences in the healthcare sector.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to efficiently allocate and manage marketing budgets.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams (marketing, creative) and external vendors.

  • Familiarity with social media management platforms.

rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

The Clinic Strategy Executive plays a crucial role within the team and the hospital by serving as a catalyst for effective marketing and operational strategies that enhance clinic performance. By supporting revenue growth and collaborating with various departments, this position ensures that the clinics are aligned with the hospital's overall objectives and patient care standards. The executive's expertise in executing marketing plans and analyzing performance data helps identify opportunities for improvement and growth, directly impacting patient access to vital services. Moreover, by facilitating communication between clinics and internal teams, the Clinic Strategy Executive fosters a collaborative environment that drives innovation and efficiencies, ultimately contributing to the hospital's success and its commitment to delivering high-quality healthcare.

  • Support the growth of revenue, volume, and key procedures of responsible clinics.
  • Execute marketing plans and ensure smooth marketing operations.
  • Collaborate with other marketing functions to execute marketing plans for hospital products and services.
  • Collaborate with clinics to support development and execution of new products and services
  • Be the point of contact and collaboration between clinics and internal marketing teams
  • Support the Clinic Strategy Managers on end-to-end process of the development of packages and its related operations.
  • Run reports on clinic performance and result of marketing plans.
  • Support the development of new products and services, ensuring smooth operations.


คุณสมบัติ

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, management, or clinical field.
  • Experience working in a hospital or in healthcare industry
  •  Good command of math and use of Microsoft Excel
  •  Good understanding of clinical services within a hospital
  • High resilience, emotional maturity, and sense of urgency
  • Great communication skills in both written and verbal
  • Highly organized and able to work under pressure and tight deadlines

rows.title: Insurance Marketing Executive/Manager
rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

  • Cultivate and manage strong relationships with Thai and international insurance companies, along with their representatives, driving revenue and patient volume growth through insurance channels.
  • Be the first point of contact for insurance representatives and patients, providing troubleshooting solutions, answering inquiries, and ensuring a smooth and positive experience throughout their healthcare journey. Collaborate seamlessly with clinical and non-clinical departments regarding operations and to resolve any concerns.
  • Lead the negotiation and review of contracts with insurance companies, ensuring mutually beneficial and competitive terms for both parties.
  • Develop and execute innovative insurance projects in collaboration with different insurance partners, targeting specific segments to maximize revenue generation.
  • Design, plan, and implement targeted marketing activities for the insurance market, including informative medical knowledge events for representatives, engaging events for patients, and focused marketing campaigns.
  • Provide personalized attention to admitted insurance patients, understanding their unique needs and insurance requirements upon admission. Assist in resolving any issues that arise with empathy and efficiency.
  • Conduct in-depth insurance market analysis, generating insightful reports and actionable recommendations on a regular basis (i.e. monthly and quarterly). Track revenue and patient volume from different insurance providers and devise strategic plans for prioritized targets.
  • Partner with the Corporate Business Development team to propose attractive offers and contracts for corporates with group insurance plans.
  • Actively build and expand MedPark's network of insurance representatives, driving both inpatient and outpatient revenue and patient volume through insurance channels.


คุณสมบัติ

  • You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in business, marketing, clinical fields, or a related area.
  • You possess demonstrable experience working in a private hospital setting, with experience handling insurance or catering to high-profile patients.
  • You have a deep understanding of hospital services, insurance requirements, and the ability to research and analyze market trends and demands.
  • You are a seasoned leader with experience building and managing teams, developing efficient work processes, and implementing best practices.
  • You demonstrate strong emotional intelligence, a sense of urgency, and the ability to prioritize and deliver results under pressure with limited resources.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Thai.
  • Experience in the insurance and/or healthcare service delivery sectors is a significant advantage.
  • You are highly accountable, possess strong leadership qualities, are highly motivated, self-driven, and service-oriented, and consistently achieve desired business objectives.

rows.title: Senior Price Estimation Officer
rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ

  • เพื่อให้ผู้รับบริการทั้งผู้ป่วย และบริษัทคู่สัญญา มีข้อมูลการประเมินราคาค่ารักษาพยาบาลที่ถูกต้องของโรงพยาบาลเพื่อใช้ประโยชน์ในการประมาณการจำนวนเงินที่ต้องชำระให้กับโรงพยาบาล กรณีบริษัทประกัน / บริษัทคู่สัญญา เจ้าหน้าที่ประเมินราคาจำเป็นต้องแจ้งรายละเอียดราคาประเมินการทำหัตถการโดยส่งต่อข้อมูลการประเมินราคาเพื่อขออนุมัติความคุ้มครองจากบริษัทคู่สัญญาก่อนผู้รับบริการทำหัตถการนั้น รวมทั้งตรวจสอบค่ารักษาพยาบาลตามคำสั่งแพทย์ ทำการประเมินราคาค่ารักษาพยาบาลให้ถูกต้อง ประสานงานกับแพทย์ พยาบาล เพื่อทบทวนคำสั่งแพทย์ และนำเอกสารใบประเมินราคาเข้าระบบ HIS
  • ให้ข้อมูลราคาประเมินค่ารักษาพยาบาลแก่ผู้รับบริการที่ติดต่อเข้ามาโดยตรงในแต่ละวัน รวมทั้งทางอีเมล์ โทรศัพท์
  • ให้ข้อมูลราคาประเมินค่ารักษาพยาบาลกับบริษัทประกัน/บริษัทคู่สัญญา เพื่อใช้ในการประกอบการอนุมัติความคุ้มครองจากบริษัทประกัน / บริษัทคู่สัญญา
  • ตรวจสอบค่าใช้จ่ายจริงของผู้ป่วยที่ได้ทำการประเมินราคาหัตถการต่างๆ โดยใช้ข้อมูลการคิดเงินค่ารักษาพยาบาลในระบบ HIS เทียบกับข้อมูลที่ได้ทำการประเมินราคา

To response sensitively to the needs and feeling of others, regardless of status or position, to accept interpersonal difference, and to maintain rapport.

rows.title: Bangkok Direct Sales Executive (Chinese Speaking)
rows.description:
JOB SPECIFIC TASKS


Building and Maintaining Customer Base

  • Answer owner questions regarding use of properties and location amenities; make recommendations given the background information obtained on the owner through discovery.
  • Follow up on referrals/leads from owners.
  • Fulfill requests from owners or prospects regarding pricing, property maps, property descriptions, room locations, and portfolio/network information.
  • Contact owners to monitor satisfaction, make aware of upcoming promotions, and develop business opportunities (e.g., reloads, referrals).
  • Develop and maintain records on customer contacts and use that information to support effective follow-up opportunities.
  • Monitor contract processing to minimize rescission decisions, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.


Giving Sales Presentations

  • Follow and adhere to the Consultative Sales Process when presenting to owners and guests.
  • Establish trust with the prospective owner and Owners throughout the entire sales process to build on-going rapport.
  • Discover the needs of prospective owners and Owners through a series of strategically layered questions/discussion and utilize the information to customize the sales presentation.
  • Provide prospective owners and Owners a Sales Gallery, Property and Model tour specific to their sales distribution site.
  • Explain the features, advantages and benefits of the product and advocate the appropriate amount of points to accommodate the prospective owners and Owners current and future vacation needs.
  • Complete and close the sales contract process by ensuring all required/legal paperwork and documents are signed and notarized.
  • Practice and continue to develop and improve sales script and presentation.
  • Ensure clear understanding of finance options and present as an approach to ownership.
  • Prepare for daily appointments (e.g., review tour sheet, owner history, presentation details, etc).
  • Follow up face-to-face guest interaction with email, phone, or mail correspondence and facilitates use of Vacation Ownership Advisor.
  • Answer Owner and customer questions regarding product information, servicing issues, construction work, financing, maintenance, repairs, and appraisals.
  • Use, demonstrate, and/or coordinate virtual tour (eTour) software for guests.


Conducting and Managing Business Transactions

  • Assure complete and accurate processing of documents pertaining to sales.
  • Review details of contracts with prospective owners and Owners once they decide on purchase.
  • Thoroughly review loan applications and financial documents with the customer and ensure completed properly.
  • Work with Sales Management to minimize cancellations, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.
  • Analyze problems and formulate a strategy and plan to overcome challenges of getting work done quickly with a high degree of quality.
  • Complete purchase summary worksheet at end of each sale.
  • Reach out to and influence Legacy Owners and Every Other Year (EOY) Owners to enroll, upgrade and maximize all reload opportunities.


Providing Service to Others

  • Respond to and monitor the resolution of customer and Owner inquiries in a timely manner with accurate information.
  • Leverage resources for providing service to guests and Owners (e.g., Vacation Ownership Advisors) in an effective manner.


Other

  • Manage time effectively to punctually attend daily team meetings, training sessions, and guest/owner appointments.
  • Demonstrate total understanding of the culture and processes of the organization.
  • Improve sales presentation approach through self-critique, practice, and lessons from the feedback provided by others (e.g., Sales Manager Coaches, Guests, Owners).
  • Participate in formal training sessions offered by management team.
  • Attend daily huddles and regularly scheduled team/manager meetings.
  • Assist in the development and mentoring of other Sales/Membership Executives as requested.
  • Maintain an awareness of current events (e.g., news, sports, pop-culture) and information on site locations to enable and promote customer relationship building.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and abide by state and federal regulation around all sales and/or marketing activity (i.e. Do Not Call Lists, State registrations, Exemptions, etc).


CANDIDATE PROFILE


  • High school diploma or GED
  • Proficiency in English (additional language required for certain positions)
  • Incumbent is required to maintain an active and in-good standing professional Real Estate License where mandated by law
  • One-year related experience
  • Must be willing to work weekends and holidays as required by business needs

5. สามารถใช้ภาษาอังกฤษได้ในระดับดีมาก

6. มีความเข้าใจในงบการเงินและธุรกิจของของธนาคาร รวมถึง dynamic ของธนาคารและสถาบันการเงินเป็นอย่างดี

7. เป็นผู้ที่สามารถรับการเปลี่ยนแปลง พร้อมกับสามารถบริหารจัดการการทำงานใน tight timeline ได้

Digital Transformation:

  • Execute the SC digital transformation roadmap, including SAP ECC, IBP, and other relevant systems.
  • Support the adoption and integration of digital tools across the supply chain.


Process Design and Capability Building:

  • Lead the design and development of supply chain planning processes.
  • Develop and implement tools and solutions to improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
  • Provide training and support to enhance the team's planning capabilities.


SC Business Process Owner (BPO):

  • Act as the Business Process Owner for IT solutions related to supply chain planning and execution.
  • Actively engage with the Planning COE community for improvements and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with IT partners to ensure alignment of business needs with IT capabilities.


SAP IBP Implementation and Enhancement:

  • Serve as the AP regional expert for SAP IBP, SAP P2P, and O2C.
  • Facilitate the increased usage of SAP IBP across the supply chain planning team.
  • Provide recommendations for SAP IBP enhancements based on user feedback and industry best practices.


Engagement with Sales Companies & Internal Factory:

  • Coordinate with sales companies within AP to ensure their needs and forecasts are adequately integrated into SAP IBP.
  • Ensure that the Production Planning view in IBP provides the necessary information for BA and Factory to validate capacity and perform scenario planning within the system.
  • Offer training sessions and workshops for sales companies and internal factories to boost their understanding and effective use of SAP IBP.


Master Data Management:

  • Ensure master data accuracy and completeness for an efficient SAP IBP process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather, refine, and implement detailed master data as needed.
  • Identify gaps and inconsistencies in the master data and take corrective measures.


Continuous Learning & Training:

  • Organize and attend training programs to enhance team skills and knowledge.

  • Strong knowledge and experience with advanced supply chain planning tools, particularly SAP IBP, SAP P2P, and O2C.
  • Extensive experience with SAP IBP and other relevant supply chain planning tools.
  • Proven track record in executing digital transformation initiatives within the supply chain domain.
  • Experience in leading process design, capability building, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and IT partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize master data management and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong background in KPI definition and performance monitoring within a global context.
  • Excellent Project Management skills and ideally experience with Lean six Sigma Continuous Improvement methodology.
  • Fluency in English both verbal and written.
  • Experience in utilizing (SAP ECC, SAP APO/SAP IBP, SAP BI, Power BI) and should be an Excel advance user.

rows.title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
rows.description:
Your day-to-day responsibilities:


Budget preparation:

  • Support annual budget process, coordinating with department heads to ensure comprehensive financial plans.
  • Develop detailed budget model.
  • Analyze and challenge assumptions made during the budgeting process to ensure they align with strategic goals.
  • Present budget proposals to senior management
  • Prepare quarterly and monthly forecasts, updating assumptions based on the latest inputs and strategic objectives.
  • Perform reforecasting as necessary, adjusting financial projections to reflect changes in assumptions.
  • Develop rolling forecasts to provide continuous visibility into future financial performance.


FP&A:

  • Develop detailed variance analysis to explain differences between actual results, forecasts, and budgets (month, YTD, comparable periods)
  • Create management reports and dashboards to provide insights into financial performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data and ensure the accuracy of financial reports.


Financial Modeling:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance complex financial models to support strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
  • Create and update pre-IPO financial models to assess potential valuation, liquidity needs, and capital structure scenarios.
  • Conduct sensitivity analysis to understand the impact of various business decisions and external factors on the company's financial performance.
  • Work closely with the finance team to ensure that financial models are aligned with accounting standards and company policies.


Pre-IPO Readiness:

  • Assist in preparing the financial sections, including historical financial data and future projections.
  • Support due diligence processes by providing necessary financial data and insights to external auditors and legal teams.
  • Participate in the preparation of investor presentations and other materials required for the IPO roadshow.
  • Work with external advisors and underwriters to ensure financial models meet the requirements for going public.


Strategic Support (Ad hoc):

  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
  • Assist in evaluating potential M&A opportunities, including due diligence and integration planning.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to drive financial performance and support key business initiatives.


Your ideal profile:


  • 4+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, financial modeling, investment banking, or corporate finance.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS/TFRS for PAE
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, GSheets, pivot and financial modeling: building three-statement models is a must.
  • Rigorous review processes to identify and correct errors in financial models.
  • Ensuring that financial models produce consistent and reliable outputs over time.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ideally familiarity with data management and visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI, SQL for data extraction and import into , etc.

rows.title: Executive Relationship Manager/ Senior Executive Relationship Manager - Corporate Banking
rows.description:
Job Description


  • Understand client’s needs and identify the opportunities for the bank
  • Manage profitability/performance/and quality of assets in the portfolio according to guidelines of the bank
  • Establish relationships with new clients and maintain strong, long-lasting business relationships with existing clients
  • Design call plan/customer visit plan
  • Create and execute account plans for the clients under one’s portfolio
  • Identify the business needs of clients and perform credit worthiness and risk appetite of portfolio clients in order to introduce them suitable products to maximize portfolio revenues.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of business solutions according to customer needs and objectives.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in business, accounting, finance or other quantitative disciplines (i.e., engineering, economics, mathematics, statistics, etc.). An advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MSc Finance, etc.) or professional certification (e.g., CFA, CPA, etc.) is helpful but not required.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a related field, e.g., Corporate finance, investment banking, investment research, treasury, etc. Fresh graduates with strong credentials and relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated quantitative skills (especially in financial modeling) and proven ability in financial statement analysis.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Ambitious, confident self-starter looking to make positive contributions to the growth of a newly establish team
  • Experienced in valuation, structured corporate finance, project finance, M&A transaction and SEC regulations

  • Design/develop strategic trade finance products both transactional product and financing product
  • Initiate improvements in operational processes of all international trade products including fraud protection process

  • BA in finance, economic, accounting or engineering is preferred

  • Work with commercial team to finalize data requirements and provide creative, data-driven visualization, solutions to support the strategic business decision-making and reporting.

rows.title: Head of Non-transactional Deposit
rows.description:
Roles and Responsibilities :


  • Align blueprint of new product or solution development and innovation roadmap for non-transactional products and align with Retail business strategy.
  • Drive for change as per product strategy and plan by sharing plan with value chain.
  • Evaluate business opportunities and develop new products and services in line with client needs and market outlook.
  • Understand customer’s need and manage the subordinated team to develop and customize product and service to suit customers’ need and competitive to other banks as well as renew and revise product features to keep abreast with market change.
  • Manage the subordinated team and product partners to tailor deposit products and services in terms of product/service feature, pricing and associated benefits that are aligned with customer’s value proposition formulated by Retail Segment Management.
  • Ensure the delivery of product and services contents and get approval according to control framework (e.g., PSAP).
  • Keep abreast of rules and regulations and maintain compliance control and monitoring.
  • Design an in-dept end-to-end journey to deliver a good customer experience since on-boarding until aftersales service.
  • Responsible and keep track of products performance through key indicators e.g., product income, customer adoption, customer complaints.
  • Drive sales performance to ensure the delivery of products as per target.
  • Propose action plan to improve deposits products up and deep sell on client base while increasing client satisfaction.
  • Monitor and review in-depth product comparison to detect opportunities and anticipate risks
  • Cascade KPIs and allocate work targets to subordinates in order to monitor performance and achievements.
  • Allocate and monitor work activities of subordinates in order to align with the operational plan.
  • Coach and advise subordinates on work activities and recommend work-related problem-solving solutions in order to complete the jobs in a timely manner.
  • Evaluate subordinates' performance and identify rooms for improvement in order to continuously improve work outputs.
  • Proactively support and encourage subordinates for further training and development in order to perform at work more effectively.
  • Accountable for keeping regulatory knowledge updated, product monitoring and controlling to comply with regulatory requirement (e.g., BOT, AML, DPA, RD) and audit commentary or guideline.
  • Responsible for all regulations governance and review and being able to share knowledge / guideline to all product managers.
  • Being representative to participate in regulator’s forum (e.g., RD, DPA, AMLO) and being able to interpret into actions for team.
  • Keep track of risk control items and regular review product framework as per defined guideline.
  • Responsible for customers’ problem resolution that are from various channels.
  • Responsible in product communication to all channels and value chain when there is a launch, change of products or regulation or interest rate.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related field MBA or equivalent preferred.
  • Minimum 5-7 years experience in sales leadership roles, with a proven track record of success in the banking, financial services.
  • Deep understanding of retail banking operations, banking products and related regulatory requirements.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate, and empower a diverse team of sales professionals.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and drive execution to achieve results.

company.name: Toll Group
company.introduction: At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries.

rows.title: Business Development Manager - Chonburi
rows.description:
The Opportunity

  • Expand the company's air and ocean freight business/services following the sales strategy, with a particular focus on strategic trade lanes.
  • Act as the primary sales contact for designated customers.
  • Identify, develop, and qualify leads, converting them through the sales process into prospects and customers.
  • Maintain a robust sales pipeline to meet agreed growth targets.
  • Manage customer interactions, including relationship building, customer calls, and closing deals.
  • Increase the company's revenue, market share, and profitability, while professionally representing the company at all levels, including customer presentations and industry events, and documenting sales activities using the Global Sales Platform.


What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales or business development within the freight forwarding industry.
  • Language Skills: Proficient in English, both spoken and written.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Interpersonal Skills: Possess a pleasant personality with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to build and maintain business relationships with networks, customers, and coworkers at all levels.
  • Professional Attributes: Results-oriented, collaborative, dedicated, hardworking, and able to work under pressure. Well-organized, fast learner, service-minded, with strategic thinking, analytical skills, and awareness of market trends. Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.

rows.title: Customer Relation Manager
rows.description:
The Opportunity:

  • Key Account Management & Customer Experience: Act as the primary internal contact for designated key/strategic accounts, ensuring customer expectations are met by coordinating closely with stakeholders across regions and divisions. Manage the gap between customer expectations and company performance.
  • Client Relationship Development: Proactively manage and grow relationships within an assigned portfolio, identifying new sales opportunities (including cross-selling). Regularly conduct business reviews (monthly, quarterly, annually) to ensure key performance indicators (KPIs) are met.
  • Revenue Growth & Strategic Expansion: Develop and implement strategies to increase revenue and profitability from existing clients. Identify and pursue growth opportunities with new strategic clients in the region, participating in rate negotiations and cooperating with global account leads as needed.
  • Operational Excellence & Client Escalation Management: Ensure customer service standards are met by collaborating with operational teams. Handle client escalations (e.g., shipment delays) and actively resolve issues while utilizing the latest IT tools and CRM systems to maintain data compliance.
  • Profit Maximization & Contract Management: Attract new business opportunities, oversee contract negotiations, and ensure compliance with company standards. Support finance teams with daily sales outstanding (DSO) management if required and monitor client developments for escalation as needed.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Build and maintain key contacts within the Toll Network, aligning with the "One Toll" strategy. Serve as the main point of communication for assigned customers, managing service level agreements (SLAs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and contractual obligations while participating in face-to-face meetings and client-centric initiatives.


What you'll need to succeed:

  • Over 5 years of expertise in freight forwarding: Skilled in development, client relationship management, and Key Account Management, with a preference for experience across multiple countries.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of challenges, drive fast, clear resolutions, and maintain strong customer service focus.
  • Collaborative and growth-focused: A team player who is eager to learn, develop, and contribute to team success, while also excelling in virtual environments and diverse settings.
  • Strategic account management: Capable of driving regional or global business as an account owner, with extensive support from top management as part of the business driver team.
  • Customer-centric approach: Results-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to creatively address core issues, operating effectively at various organizational levels.
  • Multicultural experience and communication: Adept at working with a dynamic, diverse team across the Asia region, with excellent verbal and written English skills for clear, effective communication.

rows.title: Case Manager Field Operations
rows.description:
The Opportunity:

  • Client-Centric Approach: Foster strong relationships by delivering tailored solutions, ensuring effective client management and expectation setting throughout the case lifecycle, including critical milestones.
  • Effective Communication & Decision-Making: Maintain clear, concise verbal and written communication tailored to target audiences, facilitating informed, timely decisions that consider relevant risks and constraints.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility: Demonstrate flexibility in adapting to new work structures and environments, while quickly assimilating and applying new information and policies.
  • Compliance & Accountability: Ensure adherence to all relevant policies and procedures, holding yourself and others accountable for meeting commitments and maintaining compliance standards.
  • Stakeholder & Supplier Collaboration: Coordinate with international organizations, government agencies, and third-party suppliers to provide tailored services, address service blockages, and manage regulatory requirements for clients.
  • Proactive Support: Provide dedicated, in-person assistance to refugee clients, managing all aspects of their interaction with local authorities, from immigration procedures to departure logistics, while considering political, social, and cultural sensitivities.


What you'll need to succeed:

  • Extensive experience in case management, customer service, and service recovery in large organizations, particularly in administrative environments.
  • Proven background working with medium to large NGOs in sectors such as International Development, Humanitarian Services, Refugee Resettlement, and Support Services.
  • Familiarity with government protocols, including Royal Thai Government processes, and experience collaborating with agencies such as the Australian Government Department of Home Affairs, humanitarian service providers, and international organizations such as UNHCR and IOM.
  • Competence in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word) and ability to quickly learn specialized tools like MoveMaestro.
  • Proficiency in English and Thai, with additional language skills (Chin, Karen, Rohingya, Burmese, Dari, Hazaragi) being advantageous for working with diverse refugee populations.
  • International work experience, cultural competence, and completion of relevant in-house training and competency assessments for managing global programs efficiently.

rows.title: Supply Chain Manager Asia
rows.description:
The Opportunity:

  • Develop, deliver and grow a network of service providers and suppliers across Asia that support the delivery of services to a unique customer group
  • Be expected to use innovative ways to ensure that service delivery in remote locations is consistent with contractual requirements and expectations. You will also identify and source new suppliers where and when they are required.
  • Ensure the unique needs of our customers in the delivery of all services with the highest standards of safety and customer security.
  • Develop strategic relationships as a key on-ground member of the team. You will work with regional representatives of key major stakeholders and support the Regional Manager Asia in promoting excellent working relationships with them.
  • Have a keen understanding of the local and regional environment. Using this knowledge, you will guide and support the local case management team to deliver services in a way best suited to our customers.
  • As a key representative of Toll in Asia, this role presents a tremendous opportunity to make a difference. You will have scope to take initiative and provide innovative and creative contributions to business design and improvement, and guide, support, mentor and inspire team members to deliver high performance outcomes. You will be working for an organization committed to putting people first. We celebrate diversity and are committed to our customers.


What you'll need to succeed:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of supply chain process fundamentals of purchasing and negotiation skills. Previous experience in managing a Supply Chain and Logistics framework and strategy is a must.
  • Proven track record of building strong working relationships with important stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Excellent nuanced communication skills with business level fluency English (written and oral).
  • Strong awareness of the local and regional environment and customer demographic with a desire to facilitate communication and understanding.
  • Reputation as a strategic thinker with strong business acumen who is solutions focused and can problem solve at short notice.
  • Ability to maintain performance and operate in a range of diverse locations and changing environments.
  • Ability to easily travel domestically and internationally within the region.
  • The ability to live and work in Thailand

rows.title: Case Management Associate - Thailand
rows.description:
What you'll be doing:

  • Build strong client relationships, provide quality service delivery and client-centric solutions, supporting RSC case managers with administrative tasks, to manage service appointments and subcontractor activations, and maintain timely, accurate communication with all clients while being mindful of cultural and social sensitivities.
  • Work in close collaboration with the case managers in our Global Operations Centre (GOC) to ensure travel to Australia is booked as per policy and arrival window requirements.
  • Support the timely activation and co-ordination of all suppliers and vendors who provide Medical, Biometric, Accommodation and Transit Services to clients.
  • Deliver clear, concise, and targeted verbal and written messaging to all stakeholders, that lead to positive client outcomes.
  • Join a high performing team where you'll have the opportunity to contribute to regional and team priorities contributing to team and individual responsibilities, and commitments, while strictly adhering to policies and procedures.



What you'll need to succeed:

  • A can-do attitude and a strong commitment to collaboration and clear, timely communication with members of your team.
  • Extensive experience in office administration and case management.
  • Strong client-focused service orientation, exceptional communication skills, organizational precision, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain high service levels under pressure.
  • Fluency in English and relevant regional languages (this includes the languages of the refugee populations we work with, such as Myanmar languages, Dari, Hazaragi and Pashto). If you are applying for a Mae Sot role you will be fluent in Sgaw Karen and Burmese.
  • High proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and an ability and willingness to quickly learn new technologies and IT platforms.
  • A commitment to provide a quality, responsive, humanitarian response to our clients.

rows.title: Senior Manager - Investment
rows.description:
About the job

To provide the investment advice and analysis service to ensure that the Company’s investment, particularly on the business expansion, are safe and sound.

  • To support Company’s expansion and investment aspiration in term of both strategy and financial analysis.
  • Responsible for end-to-end process for investment analysis function to support management decision.
  • Project management to ensure all deliverables are completed per prescribed deadlines in a proper, accurate and technically sound manner.
  • Lead a team to prepare investment analysis and to provide development support i.e. strategic approach, coaching, resource planning, etc.
  • Gather information and data related to new investment project, conduct independent research to determine appropriate benchmarks and internal/external business and financial factors to arrive at sound business assumptions.
  • Assess and interpret complicated financial information.
  • Liase with management at all level in other disciplines such as Operation, Customer Development, Commercial, Construction, IT to gain support on business and financial targets as well as obtaining required information.
  • Develop and maintain financial model(s) to for store expansion, acquisition and other investment projects to arrive at conventional project return analysis i.e. NPV, IRR, Payback period, etc.
  • Prepare analysis report(s) and proposal document/presentation(s) with recommendation for management decision and also prepare proposal legal board approval.
  • Regularly meeting with investment analysts and concerned parties to discuss financial matters.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge on the current economy, current financial news and financial markets of the Country and business cases/locations to be invested.
  • Keeping knowledge up-to-date about the current economy, current financial news and financial markets of the Country and location to be invested.


Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (Master's degree or CFA designation preferred).
  • At least 7-10 years in investment management or related roles, with a proven track record of successful portfolio management.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets, investment strategies, and risk management.
  • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Leadership abilities and the capacity to manage and mentor a team.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements and compliance standards.
  • Proficiency in financial analysis software and tools.
  • Good presentation skills

rows.title: Manager - Store Recruitment
rows.description:
About the job

  • Implement and maintain all human resources activities relating to Staff movement - recruitment, probation, promotions, transfers, personnel administration
  • Work closely with Head Department and acting like HR Business partner for all HR Recruitment activities.
  • Organize and co-ordinate the recruitment and selection of new staffs
  • Ensure that the recruitment standards are maintained at the highest practicable level and that recruitment processes are professional and vigorous.
  • Search, select and process candidates for Head Office and/or Store position
  • Work closely with C&B team for Job offering process
  • Deal/Advice proper work condition agreement with agencies and job advertising agency for recruitment activities processes
  • Handle hiring process of subcontractor employment for temporary staff included transferring process to be permanent staff.
  • Conduct Mass recruitment in related to new store opening or mini recruitment to support staff shortage during high season
  • Work with OD team to ensure job descriptions/specifications are developed, updated and communicated on a regular basis for all positions
  • Work closely with OD/Training team, C&B, Corporate General Admin and Store/concerned partied to connect the process of on-boarding program for new joiners and OJT program for all new promotions/transfers.
  • Ensure exit interviews conducted and taken into action for all level in Head Office and management position in Store.
  • Prepare and update Staff movement weekly reports for management in relation to new hires, resignations, and OJT tracking. (prepare report to present in Quarterly Area Meeting for staff movement-vacancies/promotions/resignations
  • Co-work with Functional Heads for Selection Test/Promotion Test, etc
  • Train or coach HR stores (together with HR team) to do recruitment as per the company guideline


Qualification:

  • Bachelor or higher degree in Human Resources Management, Law, Political Science, General Management, Psychology or other related fields.
  • At least 5 years of experience in Recruitment (Mass or High Volume) especially in retail business is highly preferable.
  • Have knowledge of principles and procedures for HR recruitment, selection, benefit and welfare,
  • Good attitude, Attention into detail, Maturity, proactive, high responsibility, service-minded, enthusiastic, adaptable/flexible, dynamic, team work, initiative, and well organized. Ability to work multi-task and be able to work under high pressure. Strong leadership, good analytical, interpersonal and problem solving skills.
  • Good communication skill, able to coordinate with all level of people and ability to influence, coach at all levels of the organization. Good command both of spoken and written English.
  • Good computer literacy
  • Be able to travel upcountry from time to time

rows.title: Merchandise Manager - House Brand
rows.description:
Responsibilities :

  • Conducts market research and analysis to identify products that can be developed and adopted as Makro’s Own Brand.
  • Feeds back market information, competition information, projects, sales and profit results to line manager and branded team.
  • Work with branded team to conduct assortment review and identify Own Brand NPD plan.
  • Coordinates with concerned Director, Sr. Buyer and Buyers to identify existing shelf-products that are sellable and can generate desired sales and profits if developed and marketed as Makro’s Own Brand. Identifies suppliers who can co-develop these products.
  • Launch new OB items on time and to targeted cost, to achieve Own Brand new launch budget SKUs and sales
  • Cooperates and maintains good relationship with suppliers who are reliable in providing OB products. Monitors the performance of Own Brand products, identify route causes of shortfall and plan actions to improve performance
  • Check and ensure branded buyer maintains information/ data bank for OB products by encoding in the computerized system all correct articles and suppliers data.
  • Ensures that products being developed match or better quality than branded benchmarks and priced lower than the benchmark according to brand positioning.

The ability to develop and analyze financial models is also important. Ability to critically review and link financial deviations with operational KPI implications

Strong collaboration skills are also important, as the Finance Lead must work effectively with other members of the transformation office and across the organization.

Job Description:

Track project delivery within KBTG including review progress against delivery milestones, produce dashboard reports, manage construction timetables, and collaborate with the PMO team to address issues and risks within agreed timelines.

  • Track overall project delivery within KBTG and report on project utilization, efficiency, and completion
  • Review progress in relation to delivery milestones to ensure that it is on time and within quality and cost estimates
  • Produce weekly/bi-weekly/monthly project dashboard reports and metrics on the health, status, and quality of the projects for a status review of resource capacity
  • Use trackers to update and manage project construction timetables
  • Collaborate closely with PMO team to monitor and address on issues, risks, and the project delivery within agreed quality and timeline


Qualification:

  • Bachelor or Master Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • At least 7 years of work experience as Project/Program Manager, Product Manager/Owner, or Business Analyst for digital products/services. Background in Financial Services, Technology.
  • Ability to manage team and stakeholders with maturity, positivity, and service-mind. Be a role model for open mindset and collaboration.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Thai and English, can communicate complex ideas in simple and impactful manner.
  • Ability to quickly absorb, process, and present information. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Good logic and problem-solving skills with focus on the big picture and real value of work
  • Good understanding of software development lifecycle, project management, and agile methodologies
  • Willingness to act without sticking to roles and adapt well to changing circumstances and environments.

rows.title: CX System and Project Manager
rows.description:
What you’ll Do

Vendor Management :

  • Oversee vendor case performance and ensure adherence to timelines.
  • Manage vendor relationships and handle vendor-related issues efficiently.
  • Handle contract management with vendors, ensuring compliance with terms and condition

Requirement Gathering and Documentation :

  • Create and manage Requests for Proposal (RFPs) to meet business needs.
  • Develop detailed business requirements documentation

Stakeholder Management :

  • Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to manage expectations and project progress.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and understanding of project goals.
  • Control user requests and settle requirements from all stakeholders effectively.
  • Oversee business risks associated with requirements and provide appropriate mitigation.

CX System Management :

  • Review and prioritize sprint backlogs for CX systems, including CRM and Telephony.
  • Ensure the CX systems are optimized for performance and user experience.
  • Monitor system downtime and work to minimize incidents.
  • Implement measures to emphasize and improve system performance

UAT Management :

  • Oversee the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process, ensuring all tests are thorough and comprehensive.
  • Develop, review, and approve UAT test scripts and test cases to validate system functionality against business requirements.
  • Coordinate UAT activities, including scheduling, resource allocation, and issue resolution.
  • Ensure timely execution of UAT phases and track defects to closure

Change Request Managemen :

  • Control and manage change requests, ensuring no unauthorized changes are allowed.
  • Ensure strict adherence to project scope and requirement settlements.

Cross-functional Collaboration :

  • Work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Facilitate cross-team cooperation to achieve project milestones.

Support Function :

  • Act as a crucial part of the support function for the CX team.
  • Ensure the customer support operations run smoothly and efficiently.

Project and Task Management :

  • Manage projects effectively, track tasks, and ensure timely completion.
  • Provide regular updates and reports on project status, risks, and issues.

Team Managemen

  • Manage the team effectively and track daily performance.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to team members to enhance productivity and performance.


What you’ll Need :

  • Proven experience in vendor management and handling vendor performance issues.
  • Strong ability to create RFPs and business requirement documents.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in reviewing and prioritizing system sprints and backlogs, particularly in CRM and Telephony systems.
  • Experience in supporting customer support operations and ensuring seamless CX team functions.
  • Skilled in monitoring system performance and minimizing downtime and incidents.
  • Proven ability to control and manage change requests, ensuring strict adherence to project scope.
  • Ability to oversee business risks associated with requirements and provide appropriate mitigations.
  • Proficient in project management and task tracking.
  • Experience in contract management with vendors, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions.


Preferred Skills :

  • Project Management Certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.Experience in the CX industry or related field.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and sprint management.
  • Personality: Enjoys working with and leading a team.
  • Behavior matters: Professional demeanor and positive interpersonal skills.
  • Can-do attitude: Proactive and willing to take initiative.

rows.title: Engineer, SSHE Support
rows.description:
Key Accountabilities


  • Functional report to Division SSHE on division / department / Asset’s SSHE activities and other SSHE-related issues.
  • Implement and ensure effectiveness of division / department SSHE plan, KPIs and other activities in compliance with Corp. SSHE Strategic plan.
  • Provide advice and support on SSHE issues such as SSHE MS requirements, SSHE regulations, MOCs, etc. to ensure that efficient and effective SSHE management is implemented and in compliance with PTTEP SSHE.
  • Manage SSHE performance of contractors by ensuring compliance with Corporate SSHE Contractor Management Standard requirements.
  • Arrange regular SSHE meetings with contractors to ensure SSHE compliance with contract requirements.
  • Communicate SSHE issues and promote SSHE campaigns based on lessons learned to prevent incident recurrence.
  • Participate in incident investigations. Review and give feedback on corrective actions proposed from site SSHE.
  • Track and analyze division / department and contractors’ SSHE performance (including occupational health, environmental and process safety), statistics and trends for further improvement.
  • Provide advice to field/site operations including contractor SSHE’s performance for further improvement.
  • Ensure line management develop, use and benefit from Major Accident Event Prevention Tool
  • Develop Division SSHE strategic plan in compliance with PTTEP SSHE strategic direction.
  • Be responsible for effective implementation of Division SSHE strategic plan including initiatives / campaigns.
  • Formulate, communicate, cascade and monitor SSHE plan and SSHE KPIs to SSHE Division..
  • Be a focal point for all SSHE activities within Division, give recommendation, advice and ensure alignment with PTTEP SSHE strategy.
  • Perform SSHE compliance check within Division through internal SSHE audits and verification.
  • Facilitate and participate in incident investigations for high severity incidents. Review and give feedback on corrective actions proposed from site SSHE.


Professional Knowledge & Experiences


  • At least 10 years of working experience in Safety, Security, Health and Environmental (SSHE) with intensive knowledge.
  • At least 5 years of working experience in Drilling and Wells operations.
  • At least 3 to 5 years of working experience to manage section or department.
  • NEBOSH certificate IGC or equivalent (advantage)
  • Minimum bachelor degree in engineering or Safety.
  • Able to coach Site SSHE supervisors under responsibility.
  • Capable of teamwork, cooperation and communication.
  • Self-motivation to complete an assignment within set time and achieve good quality of work.
  • Able to receive an urgent call from site to support/advise during non-working hours.
  • Speak fluent in English and very good in writing skill.

rows.title: Safety Specialist
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement safety policies, procedures, and programs to ensure that the employer complies with occupational health and safety laws and regulations and ensure a safe work environment for all employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Conduct regular safety inspections and analyse work processes, plans or projects to identify and eliminate potential hazards in the workplace and ensure compliance with safety plans, projects, or safety measures.
  • Conduct risk assessments to evaluate risks related to occupational health and safety conditions in the workplace and provide recommendations to minimize risks and hazards in the workplace.
  • Advise employees to follow the employer's occupational health and safety work manuals. Provide guidance, training, and education to employees and contractors to perform work safely and without risk to ensure compliance with local, government regulation and law.
  • Inspect, measure, and evaluate work environment together with individuals or legal entities registered or licensed under the occupational health and safety laws or other relevant laws. Make recommendations to the employer for appropriate workplace safety management and continuous improvement.
  • Investigate the causes and analyse accidents, incidents, illnesses, or significant incidents arising from employee work and report the results of inspections. Make recommendations to the employer for problem-solving to prevent accidents without delay.
  • Collect statistics, analyse data, and prepare reports and recommendations on accidents, incidents, illnesses, or significant incidents arising from employee work for the employer.
  • Provide knowledge and training on occupational diseases and the environment to employees before and during work to review knowledge at least once a year.
  • Manage safety-related documentation, including incident reports, inspection reports, and training records.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of safety regulations and best practices.
  • Document staff information, minutes of meetings, and reports compiled for Management.
  • Perform other safety-related duties assigned by the employer.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree of Occupational Health & Safety or Bachelor degree with Professional Safety Officer Certificate (Qualified to be Professional Safety Officer in accordance with Safety law).
  • Minimum of 3-year experience in this position.
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills.
  • Excellent in Thai speaking and writing skills.
  • Fluency in English speaking and writing skills would be an advantage.

rows.title: Legal Officer
rows.description:
Job Responsibilities

Drafting, Negotiation, and Contract Management:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including but not limited to: sales contracts, service agreements, non-disclosure agreements, and joint venture agreements.
  • Develop and maintain standardized templates for various types of commercial agreements, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Provide legal support in complex negotiations, ensuring that the Company's interests are protected.
  • Identify and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial transactions.


Corporate Law and Governance:

  • Advise on corporate governance matters, including board resolutions, shareholder agreements, and corporate restructuring.
  • Manage the incorporation of new subsidiaries and branches, including all necessary filings and registrations.
  • Handle mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, including due diligence, negotiation of transaction documents, and post-closing integration.
  • Stay updated on corporate law developments and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.


Legal Advice and Compliance:

  • Provide strategic legal advice to all departments on a wide range of legal matters.
  • Conduct legal research and analyze legal issues to support business decisions.
  • Implement and maintain the Company's compliance program, including policies and procedures.
  • Liaise with government agencies, external counsel, and other stakeholders on legal matters.


Qualifications

  • Have 3-5 years of working experience in a law firm or in-house corporate lawyer
  • Master/Bachelor’s degree of in Law or related field
  • Holding Thai lawyer license
  • Strong commercial law background especially in the negotiation and documentation of commercial contracts relevant to the business.
  • Ability to draft/write English contracts/ legal documents is a must
  • Good command of English (both writing and speaking)
  • Demonstrating independence and maturity, attention to detail, ability to grasp relevant issues quickly and to understand the commercial context and complex legal concept.
  • Proven expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial contracts.
  • Strong understanding of corporate law, including company formation, governance, and restructuring.
  • Experience in handling mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and other corporate transactions.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and mitigate legal risks.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

As the Italian Specialty Chef, you will be completely responsible for directing, training, supervising, planning, and coordinating all areas within the culinary department, including any projects requested by the Hotel Manager, Director of F&B, or Executive Chef.
