rows.title: Data Scientist - SCB Digital Banking
rows.description:
What you will do:


  • Apply statistical and machine learning methods to large, complex data sets to draw insights and provide actionable recommendations
  • Solve complex problems on both technical and business sides using advanced analytical methods
  • Work with Engineering teams to implement end-to-end process from model development to testing, validation, and deployment
  • Research and develop new quantitative models and frameworks to enhance the company’s data science capability


Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Statistics or other areas that are highly quantitative
  • Experience with statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R, pandas) and database software (e.g., SQL, PySpark)
  • Knowledge in statistics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression) and machine learning
  • Strong analytical problem-solving capabilities
  • Master’s or PhD degree in a quantitative discipline
  • Experience applying machine learning and statistical methods to large datasets
  • Solid understanding of advanced statistics and machine learning practices.
  • Experience in one or more specialized machine learning areas (e.g., NLP, deep learning, recommendation systems, reinforcement learning)
  • Outstanding coding skills or software development background.
  • Ability to think independently and communicate complex ideas to less technical persons
  • Excellent command of English in both verbal and written forms

rows.title: Corporate Legal Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

Corporate Legal

  • Lead and resolve legal disputes, including litigation, arbitration, and alternative dispute resolution processes, involving Zipcode and its affiliated entities.
  • Provide expert legal advice and guidance on all legal matters related to real estate investment activities, including acquisitions, dispositions, leasing, and development projects.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate business agreements or legal documents in both Thai and English including lease agreements, consulting contracts, employment contracts, etc.
  • Identify and mitigate legal risks associated with strategic initiatives and business operations.


Compliance & Policy

  • Monitor and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal laws and regulations affecting real estate operations, such as zoning laws, land use regulations, environmental laws, fair housing laws, and tax laws.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures to enhance legal compliance and streamline legal processes within the organization.
  • Advise on corporate governance matters, including compliance with corporate policies, board governance, and shareholder relations.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.


Due Diligence

  • Conduct thorough due diligence investigations for real estate transactions and business ventures undertaken by Zipcode and its affiliated companies.


Legal Administrative

  • Manage all legal matters and support legal administrative tasks related to the business of the Company and its affiliates.
  • Stay abreast of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards affecting the real estate sector and affiliated businesses.
  • Perform other administrative tasks and duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law.
  • 7 years of legal & compliance management required.
  • Experience in Real Estate Development is preferable.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate law, real estate law, including property rights, land use regulations, leasing, and financing.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbally and written)
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and management skills.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills - for writing and monitoring legal schedules and utilizing time and resources effectively.
  • Self-driven, ability to work independently and manage productivity.
  • Strong attention to detail for conducting site inspections and managing complex contracts.
  • Ability to make decisions under pressure.

rows.title: Head of Leasing
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning and Management

  • Develop and execute leasing strategies to achieve and exceed occupancy targets for commercial/residential properties.
  • Lead and analyze market trends to stay updated on industry trends, consumer preferences, and competitive landscapes.
  • Set annual leasing targets and budget forecasts in collaboration with the management team.
  • Oversee promotional campaigns to encourage customer spending and increase tenant sales.


Leasing Operations

  • Collaborate with marketing and property management teams to enhance property visibility and attract prospective tenants.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with tenants, brokers, and industry professionals.


Legal and Regulatory Compliance

  • Negotiate lease agreements, ensuring terms are favorable and align with company objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with leasing policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.


Financial Management

  • Setting rental rates and lease terms in consultation with stakeholders.
  • Monitoring and optimizing rental income, occupancy rates, and overall leasing performance with financial metrics to ensure targets are met.
  • Manage the Leasing budget, allocating resources effectively to maximize impact and achieve objectives.
  • Analyze leasing data and manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) statements for the properties.


People Management

  • Lead and manage a team of leasing professionals, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure leasing goals are met.
  • Foster a collaborative and results-driven team environment.
  • Perform other administrative tasks and duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields.
  • 7 years+ of experience in progressive experience in leasing management within the real estate industry.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and research skills.
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to draft and execute lease agreements.
  • Leadership skills and an ability to motivate your team to ensure a high standard of work.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage customers and build rapport effectively
  • Self-driven, ability to work independently and manage the productivity.
  • Ability to make decisions under pressure.
  • Positive attitude, enthusiasm, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

rows.title: Executive Assistant
rows.description:
Job Responsibilities:


  • Manage the Director's calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings.
  • Organize travel arrangements, including booking flights, accommodations, and transportation for the Director as needed.
  • Handle phone calls, emails, and inquiries with timely and professional responses.
  • Act as a liaison between the Director and internal staff, as well as external contacts, maintaining strong interpersonal relationships.

rows.title: Web Programmer (Magento)
rows.description:
ลักษณะงาน


- มีประสบการณ์การพัฒนา ดูแล และจัดการเว็บด้วย Magento Framework

- สามารถใช้งาน CSS, Bootstrap, Ajax, JavaScript, JQuery, JSON, XML และ Restful API

- เคยมีประสบการณ์การพัฒนา API - วิเคราะห์ปัญหา และแก้ไขปัญหาเบื้องต้นได้

- มีความรับผิดชอบสูง

- ชอบเรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีใหม่ ๆ

- สามารถทำงานเป็นทีมได้ คุณสมบัติเจาะจง อายุ(ปี) : ไม่เกิน 45 ปี

กรณีไม่มีประสบการณ์ ต้องเป็นคนเรียนรู้ไว้ ไม่ติดปัญหาในการเดินทางมาทำงาน และ ไม่ติดปัญหาเรื่องเวลาการทำงาน ขยัน ซื่อสัตย์ อดทนมีวินัย ตรงต่อเวลา ฉลาด คล่องแคล่ว สื่อสารกับบุคคลอื่นได้ดี สามารถร่วมงานกับผู้อื่นได้

มีความมุ่งมั่นที่จะเรียนรู้ เพื่อพัฒนาตัวเอง มีเป้าหมายที่จะเจริญเติบโตไปพร้อมๆ กับบริษัทฯ


คุณสมบัติ

- พัฒนา และดูแลเว็บไซต์ E-commerce รวมถึงระบบงาน Web Application ของบริษัท และบริษัทในเครือ

- พัฒนา และออกแบบเว็บไซต์เพื่อ support SEO

- พัฒนาเว็บไซต์เพื่อรองรับการใช้งานบนอุปกรณ์ต่าง ๆ ได้เป็นอย่างดี (Responsive)

- พัฒนาแผนและขั้นตอนตรวจสอบซอฟต์แวร์ เช่น Unit Testing

- ส่งมอบซอฟต์แวร์ที่มีคุณภาพและความปลอดภัย

- จัดเตรียมและติดตั้งโซลูชั่นสำหรับ Test Environment และ/หรือ โปรดักชั่น

- อัพเดทเทคโนโลยีต่างๆ รวมถึงดูแลและทำการติดตั้งอื่นๆ เช่น การทำ Deployment ให้ความช่วยเหลือแก่ผู้ใช้ แก้ปัญหาที่ได้รับ และจัดทำคู่มือใช้งาน

rows.description:
Description:

การหาผู้ขายใหม่:

  • หาข้อมูลของผู้ขายรายใหม่
  • ขอเจรจาต่อรองราคาและเงื่อนไขการขาย
  • เสนอขออนุมัติเข้า Supplier Approved List

การดำเนินการจัดซื้อ:

  • ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานผู้ขอซื้อ
  • ควบคุม ตรวจสอบเอกสารการจัดซื้อ
  • เจรจาต่อรองและเงื่อนไขกับผู้ขาย
  • ทำสัญญาหรือข้อตกลงกับผู้ขาย

การส่งมอบ:

  • วางแผนส่งมอบสินค้า
  • ควบคุมและติดตามการส่งมอบสินค้า
  • ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องในการรับและตรวจรับสินค้า

การพัฒนาผู้ขาย:

  • การประเมินผลผู้ขาย

rows.title: Commercial Audit & Compliance
rows.description:
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITY

Part 1: Commercial Audit & Compliance 

  1. Regulatory Compliance: Understand and adhere to relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to commercial activities
  2. Policy Development: Develop, implement and update policy and procedure
  3. 3.Risk Assessment: Identify potential commercial compliance risk and assess potential impact and develop strategy to mitigate risk
  4. Monitoring and Auditing: Monitor commercial operations to ensure compliance and conduct internal commercial audit and identify any compliance issues
  5. Reporting and Documentation: Maintain documentation related to compliance activities
  6. Internal Control: Establish and maintain effective internal controls to prevent and detect compliance violations, e.g. segregation of duties, authorization procedure, etc.
  7. Investigation & Remediation: Investigate any compliance issues, misconduct and recommend appropriate corrective actions

Part 2: Counterpart Registration (KYC)

  1. Data Collection: Gather essential information from potential customers
  2. Pre-screening: Preliminarily assess the credibility of potential customers
  3. Commercial Evaluation: Develop commercial criteria to evaluate potential customers
  4. Documentation: Review customer’s information and ensure completeness
  5. Customer Due Diligence: Assist in due diligence process
  6. Account Setup: Complete the process if approved by authorized bodies
  7. Ongoing Monitoring & Review & Report: Monitor customer accounts and report any suspicious activities, change in risk profile, or potential illicit activities


EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Political Science, Business administration or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • At least 3-5 years experience in audit field, regulatory compliance, risk management and control in Petroleum & Petrochemical business or related
  • Excellent knowledge of general tools and techniques of audit & compliance
  • Ability to think intuitively and strategically in order to mitigate compliance risk
  • Excellence in writen and interpersonal skills in dealing with people
  • Strong communication skill, negotiating skill, and consulting skill

rows.title: Customer Credit Analyst
rows.description:
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITY

  • Assist customer credit evaluations and work closely with Commercial, and Customer Credit Analyst to assess: (a) credit worthiness of customers, (b) appropriate credit structure for sales transactions with customers in various sectors, and (c) appropriate pricing of credit risk
  • Help monitoring credit risk by periodically evaluating payment habits, financial and economic trends, as well as credit bureau reports (Business Online) and headline news.
  • Perform regular review account receivables aging/ overdue accounts and work with Commercial team to collect outstanding debts and to minimize Days of Sales Outstanding.
  • Support credit control and quarterly credit review of customer accounts and ensure compliance with accounting standards and tax regulations.
  • Provide account balances and statements of customers for audit confirmation purposes both internal & external


EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or related fields.


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 1-3 years in Account Receivable Management
  • Demonstrated financial statement analysis is a plus
  • High level of communication and interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with both internal and external customers.
  • Strong customer focused and service minded
  • Flexibility and openness to change, eager to learn and develop
  • Good skill in MS Office program and SAP.

rows.title: Strategist - Business Plan
rows.description:
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITY (FOR RECRUITMENT)

  • Develop medium and long term business plan for TOP Group and wholly owned subsidiaries that align with Strategic Direction (Target & Execution Plan) and submit to board of directors for approval. 
  • Develop monitoring and reporting system for the progress and variable of STS initiatives/Business performance vs plan both medium term and long term in order to ensure that the company will be able to achieve the strategic target in short, medium and long term plan.
  • Develop financial models, prepare sensitivity financial forecast analysis and reporting tools to identify business opportunities, risk and ensure performance better. 
  • Monitor external & internal factors that could impact the business plan
  • Analyze the results of business performance, compile reports, evaluate performance against business plans, provide insights on deviations, and present to the management team.


EDUCATION (FOR RECRUITMENT)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics
  • Master’s degree in MBA, Finance or Business Strategy


EXPERIENCE (FOR RECRUITMENT)

  • 3 - 5 years of working experiences in related field e.g. Business Consultant, Investment Banking, Corporate Planning and/or Analyst background in oil refinery and petrochemical are preferrable.


OTHER REQUIREMENTS (FOR RECRUITMENT)

  • Strong analytical skill and strategic thinking
  • Understanding of basic accounting, finance and having well-rounded knowledge in business management
  • Possessing project management and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities, solving problems on the spot, and delivering work under pressure or tight deadlines
  • Advanced user for Microsoft suite (Excel, Word and Power Point)

rows.title: Technical Safety Specialist
rows.description:
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITY

1.Persuade executive management to continue to demonstrate an exemplary focus on the importance of process safety and devote significant time to process safety improvement efforts and resources

2.Provide technical expertise, consultancy and interpretation of PSM requirement, fire prevention and protection system design code, standard

3.Assess whether process hazard analyses (PHA's) are conducted for each covered process using compiled PS ordered based on a set of required considerations

4.Check the compilation of written process safety information (PSI) including hazard information on Highly Hazardous Chemicals (HHC) standard’s, technology information and equipment information on covered processes

5.Assess impacts of operations on local community based on international standards and measures, such as carbon footprint benchmarking

6.Define a safety review for new facilities and significantly modified work sites to:

•Confirm that the construction and equipment of a process are in accordance with design specifications

•Assure that adequate safety, operating, maintenance and emergency procedures are in place


EDUCATION

  • BSC. In Chemical Engineer, Loss management Engineer or Fire Engineer or Safety Engineering at least 10 years’ experience of practical orientated


EXPERIENCE

1.High level of expertise, experience and judgment to influence current and future company fire protection engineering plans, fire and safety engineering, technical standards, specification and design practices.

2.Positive influencing: ability to convince others, gain agreement or acceptance of plans activities and ability to move others willingly towards a desired goal or course of action.

3.Knowledge of risk analysis, process safety management, major incidents investigation and safety audits.

4.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

5.Strong analytic thinking and problem-solving skills.

6.Proficient in Microsoft, PHAST, PHA-Pro applications

rows.title: Cloud Solution Architecture (CSA) - M365 & Copilot
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Customer Centricity
  • Customer Satisfaction: Drive positive Customer Satisfaction, and become a trusted advisor to customers and partners, by leveraging M365 Enterprise Services (Copilot in M365 App, Exchange online, SharePoint Online, Teams, M365 Apps, Information Governance, Security & Compliance) expertise to enable defined Customer Success Plan outcomes. You will actively listen and respectfully challenge to drive the best outcomes.
  • Customer/Partner Insights: Provide feedback & insights from customers/partners to the relevant MS teams, including Product Groups, to enable continuous improvement.
  • Experience in Customer Success for productivity and business process transformation platforms. Strong technical aptitude and desire to work with both business and IT stakeholders.
  • Executive Stakeholder Value: Experience in building and maintaining executive-level stakeholder relationships and leading value proposition conversations aligned to customer priorities and outcomes. Ability to interpret and dissect the industry and business priorities of customers.
  • Business Impact
  • Usage (Cloud & Support) Growth: Develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results by working with business and technical decision makers to ensure they understand Microsoft's M365 Copilot value proposition and get value from their investment in the Microsoft technology.
  • Resolution of Customer Blockers: Identify resolutions to issues blocking go-live of customer success projects by leveraging deep knowledge of M365 services & technical subject matter expertise. Lead the technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments. Deliver all work according to MS best practices & policies and using repeatable IP.
  • Technical Leadership
  • Learn It All: Demonstrate Self Learner mindset through continuous alignment of individual skilling to team/area demands and Customer Success goals.
  • Accelerate Customer Outcomes: Engage in relevant communities to share expertise, contribute to IP creation, prioritize IP re-use and learn from others to help accelerate your customers transformation journey.
  • Business Process Analysis
  • Depict customer business processes and prepare for the analysis and improvement of business process performance.
  • Articulate, demo, and present complex customer concepts to varying audiences, such as BDMs (Business Decision Makers) & ITDMs (Information Technology Decision Makers).
  • Territory & Pipeline Mgmt.: Experienced in territory management, opportunity qualification, stakeholder communication, and partner engagement, including opportunity and pipeline mgmt. Experience in ensuring customers realize value by consuming technology and services investments.
  • Collaboration & Community Engagement: Experienced in collaborating in virtual teams to develop and drive M365 Copilot usage opportunities through influence. Identify and document best practices and customer references.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years' experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
  • OR equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience working in a customer-facing role
  • 4+ years experience working on technical projects.
  • Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud/collaboration/unified environments.
  • Certification in one or more of the following technologies preferred: Microsoft Azure fundamentals, M365 fundamentals. Cloud Security, Teams Administration, SharePoint Certifications, M365 Copilot fundamentals. PROSCI or Change Management Qualifications.
  • Business Analysis: Identify business needs and determine solutions to business problems, process improvement, organizational change, or strategic planning and policy development.
  • Relationship Building. Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solution/projects.
  • Technical Solution Development: Developing technical solutions and ability to design, customize, or reapply technical solutions based on customer/partner needs or demands.
  • Foundational-level knowledge of cloud services.
  • Fluency in SaaS solutions; particularly all Microsoft 365 offerings.
  • Domain experience Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure solutions, and understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions that can span across these solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.
  • Competitive Landscape knowledge of cloud platforms. Understanding of M365 partner ecosystems and the ability to leverage partner solutions to solve customer needs.
  • Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / SME in two or more of the following M365 solutions.
  • Exchange Online
  • SharePoint Online
  • M365 Copilot
  • Teams
  • Windows & Cloud Endpoint
  • IDM, Information Protection & Compliance.
  • Governance & Risk Management
  • Collaboration and Communication: Acknowledged for driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts and ensuring follow through with exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences.

rows.title: Information Technology Auditor
rows.description:
Job Description

  • Assist IT Audit Leader in performing an independent assessment on inherent risk and control risk of the company’s information systems in order to develop the annual risk-based IT audit plan
  • Gather data from the monthly incident report and perform preliminary review to identify and prioritize risks and key controls over the information systems under review for audit project planning purpose.
  • Develop Audit Planning Memorandum (APM) to identify the audit objective, scope of review, audit approach, audit timeline, audit team member and expected controls and communicate the APM to Head of process under review in the opening meeting.
  • Execute the IT audit engagement to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of IT general controls and application controls; including IT policies/procedures, logical access controls, system development, change management and computer operation.
  • Conduct cyber security review, penetration testing at network, web application and mobile application
  • Provide an advisory service on IT security and controls in relation to digital and infrastructure technology to ensure IT security and controls are appropriately designed.
  • Develop clear, concise and understandable working paper to document work performed.
  • Support and assist Operational and Subsidiary audit engagements.
  • Identify control weaknesses and non-compliance to company's policies, procedures and related regulations, which may result in ineffective and inefficient operations.
  • Prepare Issue Log and participate the Closing meeting to obtain agreement on the results of the audit and management action plan for remediation action and controls improvement actions (detective / preventive controls).
  • Provide oral or written presentations to management during the audit and at the conclusion of each audit or special project.
  • Prepare formal written reports for each audit project expressing an opinion on the adequacy of the internal control structure.
  • Follow-up on the status of remediation action and controls improvement action from management in order to ensure management action is taken in a timely manner.
  • Gather the Post Audit Survey result from key customers after audit engagement completion and make an improvement on suggestion provided by key customers to achieve customer’s requirements and to improve an effectiveness and efficiency of audit work.
  • Perform ad-hoc assignments or any other special requests from management.
  • Coordinate with BAY internal auditors to provide optimal audit coverage to the company.


Qualifications:

  • Thai Nationality.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS, AIS or IT related fields
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in internal or external IT audit, IT/Cyber security, Network security or related fields, preferably in Finance & Banking business
  • Knowledge of IT processes, IT risks, IT security and IT technical knowledge (e.g. network/web application/mobile application penetration testing, network/operating system/database configuration and security review)
  • Familiarity with leading standards/practices (e.g. COBIT, ITIL, ISO27001, PCI-DSS, OWASP) and compliance regulations (e.g. BOT, OIC)
  • Through understanding of audit concept and process
  • IT General controls (e.g., Systems development, Change management, Security, Computer operations) and Application controls (e.g., source data control, input validation routines, data processing and file maintenance controls, output controls
  • Credit card, personal loan and insurance broker product & related business process knowledge

rows.title: CS Product Operations Analyst
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Be a subject-matter expert for our CS environments with the ability to provide solutions and answer questions related to bugs, expected behaviors, and new product launches.
  • Review, troubleshoot, and provide solutions to emerging issues and advocate for fixes.
  • Optimize agent workflows based on new products/initiatives and available tools.
  • Have a direct impact on the Hopper Product roadmap by defining and/or supporting needed changes/improvements.
  • Design and own workflows for all internal agent-facing tools (CRM, custom-built apps, communication platforms and servicing data) collaborating with cross-functional teams such as L&D, IT and WFM where needed.
  • Provide user acceptance testing, quality assurance testing, and operational support for new products or automations, in order to validate and report anomalies/expected behaviors, strategize solutions, create tickets to report said bugs, and test fixes once implemented.
  • Serve as an incident manager as needed for high-impact outages and product issues.
  • Partner closely with key stakeholders to recommend and pilot in-house and third party tools to enhance the experience of customers and agents.
  • Schedule regular reviews with stakeholders of the customer and agent facing knowledge bases and workflows to identify areas of improvement.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation of systems, processes, and settings.


Minimum Expectations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Hands-on experience with JSON for data manipulation and communication with APIs.
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create and modify web interfaces.
  • Experience writing queries in SQL to analyze and validate data-driven hypotheses.
  • Familiarity with Python programming to leverage scripting and data manipulation capabilities for enhanced data analysis.
  • Excellent computer skills, a willingness and an eagerness to approach workflow engineering and low-code automation with a data-driven approach.
  • A passion for Hopper’s mission to build the most customer-centric travel marketplace.
  • Has a high level of operational awareness, exceptional attention to detail and a broad understanding of contact centers, live support tool operations and agent behaviors.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to clarify, analyze and investigate operational needs, identify potential roadblocks and develop viable, working, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Bias for action and drive to work autonomously, take initiative to research problems, find solutions, and communicate with stakeholders.
  • Exceptional ability to grasp, manage, and articulate complex systems.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills in order to manage multiple projects/tasks of varying complexities, taking initiative, meeting deadlines and working well under pressure.
  • Fluent in customer service metrics, SLAs and support health indicators.
  • Excellent judgment; ability to ask smart questions and make quick, impactful decisions.
  • Resilient attitude, ability to stay on your toes and move with any changes that may come your way.
  • Customer, team & company player.
  • Take on delegated tasks with enthusiasm towards the greater good of the company.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Product Operations working with Product teams and Engineering teams preferred.
  • Experience with operation tools like Jira, Confluence, Amplitude, Datadog, Google Sheets.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in customer service operations and product ecosystems.
  • Experience in implementing and maintaining complex contact routing, IVRs, skillset libraries and customer journey flows using technologies such as Calabrio, NICE IEX, Amazon Connect and Kustomer.
  • Ability to effectively influence stakeholders by creating compelling data visualizations that communicate complex insights in a clear and impactful manner.

rows.title: Sourcing Specialist
rows.description:
1. Job Purpose:

The Sourcing and Supply Chain Manager is responsible for assessing and negotiating with existing and new suppliers, managing purchase requisitions and orders, and ensuring accurate cost and product codes. This role involves coordinating with established vendors, searching for new suppliers locally and internationally, and establishing strong supplier relationships. The manager must understand the supply market to ensure efficient management and meet operational needs.


2. Main Responsibilities:

  • Sourcing Solutions: Provide effective sourcing solutions to meet brand requirements.
  • Daily Operations Management: Oversee daily operations including delivery coordination, price/cost analysis, contract negotiation, policy and procedure compliance, and logistical coordination. Serve as a liaison to other company functions.
  • Demand and Supply Management: Ensure accurate demand forecasting and reliable supply for short, medium, and long-term needs.
  • Raw Material Procurement: Manage the procurement of raw materials and develop new products according to the Marketing Calendar, ensuring timely product launches with no supply disruptions.
  • Customer Interaction: Regularly interact with in-house customers to achieve cooperative strategies.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships.
  • Supply Planning: Plan and manage supply levels to maintain adequate stock while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Cost Negotiation: Negotiate with suppliers focusing on total cost rather than just price.
  • Supplier Sourcing: Identify and evaluate new potential suppliers to reduce product costs.
  • Additional Duties: Perform other tasks as assigned by the supervisor.


Other Duties:

  • Compliance: Adhere to company rules and regulations.
  • Training and Participation: Attend and contribute to training sessions, meetings, and other required activities.
  • Representation: Represent the company positively and maintain professional relationships with business partners.
  • Office Maintenance: Ensure high standards of personal presentation and office cleanliness.
  • Flexibility: Be prepared to work on holidays and weekends as needed and carry out any other reasonable duties as assigned.


3. Job Profile:

  • Work Schedule: Flexible hours, typically five days a week.
  • Task Management: Handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Work Environment: Work under time pressure with minimal supervision, manage large volumes of data, documents, and reports.
  • Flexibility: Available for work on holidays and weekends as necessary.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve working processes.
  • Communication: Frequent use of English and computer programs.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Regularly liaise with various stakeholders, including Marketing, Operations, HR, Accounting, Logistics, and QA.
  • Location: Primarily based in Bangkok with occasional travel to stores and supplier sites as needed.
  • Role: Act as a business owner, stand by for critical supply chain issues, and be a trusted partner to brands, suppliers, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers.


Qualifications:

  • Skills: Strong drive for results, excellent interpersonal and outgoing communication skills, proficiency in English, and computer literacy.
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of direct experience in purchasing within the food industry.

The Category Manager will report directly to the Sr. Manager – Direct Sourcing, Supply Chain Management Hotel, and play a crucial role in supporting project-related initiatives across hotel operations. This hands-on position requires managing large and/or multiple projects efficiently, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to specified standards. The Category Manager will also be responsible for contract management, analytical reporting, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Supply Chain Processes: Design and align new supply chain demand processes and policies with existing business processes.

  • Supplier Evaluation: Analyze and recommend suppliers' bids, proposals, and contracts through category analysis and supplier meetings.

  • Contract Management: Manage supply contracts and develop contingency plans for core products.
  • Coaching: Provide coaching and teaching to direct reports.

rows.title: Sustainability Manager – Occupational Health and safety
rows.description:
Job Purpose:

The Sustainability Manager will enhance the company's occupational health and safety (OHS) performance, aligning with national and international laws and regulations. This role involves engaging internal and external stakeholders to meet the company’s long-term goals, particularly focusing on the safety and well-being of employees. The role also includes collaborating with the senior sustainability manager to elevate the OHS performance of upstream supply chain suppliers through education, assessment, and audits, supporting the company’s sustainability objectives.


Main Responsibilities:

In-House Implementation of Occupational Health and Safety:

  • Collaboration: Work closely with relevant functions to implement and enhance occupational health and safety practices within operations to reduce incidents and prevent recurrences.
  • Training: Organize annual workshops and sessions to improve the occupational health and safety capabilities of colleagues.
  • Database Management: Develop and maintain a systematic database to track and report on occupational health and safety indicators.

Supplier Engagement:

  • Education: Conduct educational workshops on occupational health and safety for targeted suppliers.
  • Assessment and Audits: Manage online assessments and perform on-site or remote audits of suppliers. Issue improvement plans where necessary and follow up to address non-conformities.
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly engage with suppliers to support ongoing improvements in their occupational health and safety practices.

Regulatory Compliance:

  • Legal Updates: Stay updated on applicable occupational health and safety laws, regulations, and standards to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Benchmark Response: Respond to national and international benchmark questionnaires (e.g., DJSI, CDP, FTSE4Good, MSCI, SET Sustainability Award) to improve company performance in occupational health and safety.

Model and Tool Development:

  • Model Initiation: Develop practical models, kits, or tools for occupational health and safety practices that can be applied across different regions and target groups to broaden the reporting scope.


Qualifications:

  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication skills, capable of interacting effectively with all levels of the organization.
  • Adaptability: Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to thrive in high-demand situations.
  • Learning: Eager to learn and stay updated on new developments.
  • Team Building: Proven ability to build and manage a team-oriented environment.
  • Trust Building: Ability to foster trust-based relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Networking: Skilled in networking with external stakeholders.


Education:

  • Degree: Bachelor’s Degree in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field; Master’s Degree in a related field is a plus.


Experience:

  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in occupational health and safety implementation and/or auditing.
  • Benchmark Experience: Proven experience in responding to sustainability benchmarks such as DJSI, CDP, FTSE4Good, etc.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated experience in project management.

rows.description:
Job Description

Job Purpose:

Responsible for delivering the development and execution of contract and compliance management for Minor International, including Minor Food brands, Minor Food factories, and Minor Hotels. To serve as the primary point of contact with internal and external parties in relation to contract management, contract compliance and contract issues; provide administration of the sales/procurement contracts, agreements and associated activities.

This requires an intense and broad range of knowledge of both local & international supply chain capabilities and the ability to structurally analyse and influence all business partners to meet corporate objectives on products, quality, and price and service levels.


﻿2. Main Responsibilities:

  • Manages the contracts process, ensures attention to detail and accuracy, monitors for vendor and user compliance, and advises SCM team in pre-award contract reviews and post-award development of contract instruments
  • Monitors, tracks and reviews contract and agreement documents, and notifies regarding required adjustments.
  • Reviews and provides recommendations to the team on all formal solicitations. Assists in writing specifications for goods, scope of work for services. Ensure appropriate performance standards, quality, delivery, life cycle cost and warranty are identified in formal one and two step solicitations.
  • Executes analytical model – use data extensively, quantitative analysis, predictive models and fact-based management to drive actions
  • Provides assistance with the formal bid process for specialized equipment and services. Process reports as required.
  • Supports in drawing up agreement, contract, memorandum of understanding, agreeing internal roles and responsibilities for each contract.
  • Ensures that all contract information is accurate, appropriately filed, current and available to all who use it. Monitor competitive terms. Monitor supplier satisfaction with our terms and conditions and contracting practices. Recommend changes
  • Makes operation staff and/or all relevant parties aware of contract requirement and monitor compliance
  • Ensures all financial and contract issues are properly completed at the close out of contracts
  • Maintains contractual records and documentation such as receipt and control of all contract correspondence, supplier contact information sheets, contractual changes, status reports and other documents for all projects as well as Tracks saving, rebate and/or support which are aligned with the contracts
  • Monitors compliance with established procedures. Identify areas of recurrent pressure.
  • Ensures contract close-out, extension or renewal
  • Other task(s) that may be assign by senior manager
  • Other Duties:
  • Adhere to the company’s employee rules & regulations.
  • Attend and contribute to all training sessions, meetings and activities as required.
  • Exercises responsible behaviour at all times, positively representing MINT.
  • Maintains strong, professional relationship with relevant business partners.
  • Ensure high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
  • Keep the office and working areas clean and tidy at all times.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Strategic thinking ability, with strong leadership and hyper-collaboration skills
  • Strong experience in contract management and end-to-end supply chain execution.
  • Strong knowledge of supply chain management principles, practices and procedures preferred, as well as experience with supply system.
  • Experienced in Food and Non-Food manufacturing process from upstream (raw material) to downstream (processing), Hotel Business or Share Services
  • Strong in people development
  • Strong project management and execution skill.
  • Good command of English and computer literacy.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s or higher in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Supply Chain. MBA is a plus.


Experience:

  • At least 5 years work experience in food or related industries with solid knowledge and direct experience in supply chain, and corporate management in a dynamic environment.
  • Good understanding of monitoring and managing contracts preferably at an international level
  • Good understanding in hotel operation and non-food International procurement/sourcing process
  • 5 years of progressively responsible work experience directly related to the duties of the position
  • Works well under project pressure
  • Flexible and responsive to change
  • Ability to negotiate and sustain networking relationships
  • Advanced English skills (writing, reading etc)
  • Advanced Word/Excel skills (v-lookups, pivot tables, etc.)
  • Writing, reporting and editing skills including the ability to present information in a coherent manner

company.name: Elanco

At Elanco, we work to improve the health of animals through innovative products and services for pets and farm animals around the world. As a global animal health company, we provide solutions that empower our customers to advance a vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life. Since 1954, Elanco has committed to empowering veterinarians, farmers, and all those who care for animals with the tools they need to help animals live healthy lives.


Healthier animals are the key to making our lives better - This is the fundamental belief uniting all global Elanco employees. That’s why we are committed to the idea that our business can be a unique force for good for all in society.

company.name: Elanco
company.introduction:
At Elanco, we work to improve the health of animals through innovative products and services for pets and farm animals around the world. As a global animal health company, we provide solutions that empower our customers to advance a vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life. Since 1954, Elanco has committed to empowering veterinarians, farmers, and all those who care for animals with the tools they need to help animals live healthy lives.


Healthier animals are the key to making our lives better - This is the fundamental belief uniting all global Elanco employees. That’s why we are committed to the idea that our business can be a unique force for good for all in society.


Through our Elanco Healthy Purpose™ framework of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) commitments, we focus on delivering sustainable solutions to advance the well-being of animals, people and the planet. This program also enables our employees around the world to take paid time off to make an impact as a volunteer, offering their time or talent to give back to our customers, causes and communities. #ElancoHealthyPurpose #WeAreElanco

Lead and develop methods for delivery of data in formats required by customers.
  • Perform research of regulations on flight operation related, develops required data and evaluates suitability with customers and regulatory agencies.
  • Communicate with external personnel to learn their expectations and to seek optimized solutions for customers.
  • Participate in the aerospace industry organizational activities.
  • Develop, maintain and enhance the relationship with customers via exchange information/operation data and lead and develop proactive solution recommendations.
  • Assist customers and the Boeing Company to prepare for delivery of new equipment and/or types of operation. Work with external organizations like sales and marketing to provide customer solutions and identify revenue opportunities.

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with customers/partner, internally within the team and with management.

  • Bachelor degree with major in aerospace engineering or related.
  • At least 5 + years flight operation engineering experiences in civil aviation industry or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD, Master+3 years' related work experience).
  • Possess of intensive knowledge on airplane system & structure, airplane performance software & application, airlines operation processes and procedures.
  • Professional skill in Microsoft Office like Excel, PowerPoint and Word applications, and ability in coordination and presentation skill.
  • Fluent in English and demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability working under pressure and be comfortable to work all aspects of complex situations.
  • Good judgment, extreme discretion and flexibility in work hours, travel domestically and internationally may be required.
  • Candidate must be a self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment, and to be good team player.
  • High standard of honesty and integrity.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Airline Performance Engineer with strong footprint on full knowledge on airplane performance and weight and balance.
  • Special procedure development (EOSID, Driftdown and Oxygen Analysis) and airplane performance instructor experience.
  • Instrument Flight Procedure Design background (PBN and/or traditional procedure design).
  • Airplane load control management and loading schedule development.

rows.description:

  • เตรียมวัตถุดิบและสินค้าเพื่อจัดส่งสินค้าให้ลูกค้า ตามขั้นตอนการปฏิบัติงาน
  • ตรวจสอบพื้นที่ปฏิบัติงานให้มีความเรียบร้อยและรายงานเมื่อพบสิ่งผิดปกติ
  • บำรุงรักษาเครื่องมือและอุปกรณ์ที่ใช้ปฏิบัติงานในคลังสินค้าให้อยู่ในสภาพพร้อมใช้งานและมีความปลอดภัย สนับสนุนนโยบายของบริษัทฯ เพื่อให้บรรลุตามวัตถุประสงค์ เช่น ระบบคุณภาพ (ISO 9001) และ ระบบการดูแล ด้วยความรับผิดชอบ (RC 14001) และในกรณีที่บริษัทฯ นำระบบการจัดการด้านความปลอดภัย (OHSAS 18001)


ต้องการทักษะและประสบการณ์

  • เคยผ่านการทำงานในโรงงานอุตสาหกรรมอย่างน้อย 1 ปี
  • สามารถขับรถฟอร์คลิฟท์ได้


คุณสมบัติ

  • จบการศึกษาระดับ ม. 6 หรือผู้มีประสบการณ์การทำงานในคลังสินค้าอย่างน้อย 2-3 ปี
  • ผ่านการอบรมการดับเพลิงขั้นพื้นฐาน
  • ผ่านการอบรมการขับรถฟอร์คลิฟท์
